sentences.en: Lin Hai was a Chinese student who lived far from his home.
sentences.zh: 林海是一名住在远离家乡之地的中国学生。

sentences.en: He lived in a small dormitory near the campus.
sentences.zh: 他住在校园附近一间小小的宿舍里。

sentences.en: This was his first year in America.
sentences.zh: 这是他在美国的第一年。

sentences.en: During the night, he often felt alone in his quiet room.
sentences.zh: 夜里，他常常在安静的房间中感到孤单。

sentences.en: He missed his mother's cooking and his old friends.
sentences.zh: 他想念妈妈做的饭菜和昔日的朋友。

sentences.en: His sleep routine was broken, so he stayed in bed too late.
sentences.zh: 他的作息规律被打乱了，总是在床上赖到很晚。

sentences.en: Slowly, a heavy anxiety grew inside his chest.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，一股沉重的焦虑在他心里滋长。

sentences.en: His health was getting worse week by week.
sentences.zh: 他的健康状况一周比一周差。

sentences.en: The final exam was only two weeks away.
sentences.zh: 期末考试只剩两个星期了。

sentences.en: He also had a big research paper to finish.
sentences.zh: 他还有一篇很重要的研究论文要完成。

sentences.en: The deadline was printed in red on his calendar.
sentences.zh: 截止日期用红色印在他的日历上。

sentences.en: His grades in every class were below average.
sentences.zh: 他每门课的成绩都低于平均水平。

sentences.en: One difficult course worried him most of all.
sentences.zh: 其中一门很难的课程最让他担心。

sentences.en: He spent long hours in the library, but he could not focus.
sentences.zh: 他在图书馆待了很久，却无法集中注意力。

sentences.en: His academic future looked dark to him.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己的学业前途一片黑暗。

sentences.en: Things felt bad, yet he did not know how to change them.
sentences.zh: 情况很糟，可他不知道该如何改变。

sentences.en: His paper was about artificial intelligence.
sentences.zh: 他的论文是关于人工智能的。

sentences.en: He wanted to study how a robot learns to speak.
sentences.zh: 他想研究机器人是如何学会说话的。

sentences.en: For this, he needed to collect a large amount of data.
sentences.zh: 为此，他需要收集大量的数据。

sentences.en: He searched the internet every evening.
sentences.zh: 他每天晚上都在互联网上搜索资料。

sentences.en: He read one long article, then another, but understood little.
sentences.zh: 他读完一篇长文章又读另一篇，却几乎看不懂。

sentences.en: The software on his laptop crashed twice.
sentences.zh: 他笔记本电脑上的软件崩溃了两次。

sentences.en: Modern technology seemed to work against him.
sentences.zh: 现代科技似乎在和他作对。

sentences.en: He closed the digital screen, then rubbed his tired eyes.
sentences.zh: 他关上数码屏幕，揉了揉疲惫的眼睛。

sentences.en: One cold morning, a friendly classmate named Maya noticed his pale face.
sentences.zh: 一个寒冷的早晨，一位叫玛雅的友善同学注意到他苍白的脸色。

sentences.en: "Are you okay?" she asked with real concern.
sentences.zh: “你还好吗？”她关切地问道。

sentences.en: "I am just tired," he said quietly.
sentences.zh: “我只是累了。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: But Maya paid close attention to his shaking hands.
sentences.zh: 但玛雅密切注意到了他颤抖的双手。

sentences.en: "You can tell me anything," she said.
sentences.zh: “你可以告诉我任何事。”她说。

sentences.en: "Anyone can feel lost in a new country," she added.
sentences.zh: “任何人在陌生的国家都会感到迷茫。”她补充道。

sentences.en: Lin could not give her an answer immediately.
sentences.zh: 林一时说不出一个答案。

sentences.en: Then, slowly, he told her the truth behind his smile.
sentences.zh: 然后，他慢慢说出了笑容背后的真相。

sentences.en: Maya said his body needed help before his mind could heal.
sentences.zh: 玛雅说，在心灵痊愈之前，他的身体先需要帮助。

sentences.en: First, she looked at his diet of instant noodles.
sentences.zh: 首先，她看了看他那顿顿方便面的饮食。

sentences.en: "You must eat regular meals with fresh vegetables," she said.
sentences.zh: “你必须按时吃有新鲜蔬菜的正餐。”她说。

sentences.en: She planned short daily runs to build his strength.
sentences.zh: 她还安排了每天的短跑来增强他的体力。

sentences.en: Every morning they jogged along the river together.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他们一起沿着河边慢跑。

sentences.en: The cool river air cleared his tired head.
sentences.zh: 清凉的河边空气让他疲惫的头脑清醒起来。

sentences.en: He could feel his heart beat with new energy.
sentences.zh: 他能感到自己的心跳充满了新的活力。

sentences.en: Sometimes they kicked a ball in the park afterward.
sentences.zh: 之后他们有时会在公园里踢球。

sentences.en: Little by little, his old fear was losing its power over him.
sentences.zh: 一点一点地，旧日的恐惧正在失去对他的控制。

sentences.en: That weekend, Maya suggested a short trip outside the school gates.
sentences.zh: 那个周末，玛雅提议去校门外来一次短途出行。

sentences.en: "Let's travel to the old museum downtown," she said.
sentences.zh: “我们去市中心那家老博物馆旅行吧。”她说。

sentences.en: It stood in the historic district of the city.
sentences.zh: 它坐落在城市的历史街区里。

sentences.en: The bus ride across the city took forty minutes.
sentences.zh: 穿过城市的公交车程花了四十分钟。

sentences.en: Lin watched the streets as they rolled past.
sentences.zh: 车子驶过时，林望着窗外的街道。

sentences.en: The short journey already felt like a holiday.
sentences.zh: 这段短短的旅程已经像一场假期。

sentences.en: Inside, they found rooms full of ancient Chinese art.
sentences.zh: 在馆内，他们发现了摆满中国古代艺术品的展厅。

sentences.en: Each object carried the culture of a long tradition.
sentences.zh: 每件展品都承载着一种悠久传统的文化。

sentences.en: One exhibit showed a famous clay army from China.
sentences.zh: 一个展览展示了来自中国的著名陶土军队。

sentences.en: The soldiers were made more than two thousand years ago.
sentences.zh: 这些士兵是两千多年前制作的。

sentences.en: They once stood ready to attack any enemy of their king.
sentences.zh: 他们曾随时准备攻击国王的任何敌人。

sentences.en: Lin stood still and stared into their silent stone faces for a long time.
sentences.zh: 林静静地站着，久久凝视着那些沉默的石头面孔。

sentences.en: "This is amazing," he whispered.
sentences.zh: “这太惊人了。”他低声说。

sentences.en: In the next area, they saw a beautiful painting of a river.
sentences.zh: 在下一个区域，他们看到一幅美丽的河流画作。

sentences.en: A small boat floated near the green bank of the water.
sentences.zh: 一只小船漂在绿色的河岸边。

sentences.en: Above the boat, white birds crossed a golden sky.
sentences.zh: 小船上方，白色的鸟儿飞过金色的天空。

sentences.en: Maya took photos, saving them in the album on her phone.
sentences.zh: 玛雅拍了照片，存进手机里的相册。

sentences.en: On the way home, Lin spoke of his childhood.
sentences.zh: 回家路上，林谈起了自己的童年。

sentences.en: He showed Maya a baby picture of himself.
sentences.zh: 他给玛雅看了一张自己婴儿时期的照片。

sentences.en: "My grandmother took it when I was that age," he laughed.
sentences.zh: “这是我那个年纪时奶奶拍的。”他笑着说。

sentences.en: For the first time in many months, he felt light, free, and truly happy.
sentences.zh: 许多个月以来，他第一次感到轻松、自在、真正的快乐。

sentences.en: The visit had reminded him why he loved learning.
sentences.zh: 这次参观让他想起了自己为什么热爱学习。

sentences.en: His own history was a base he could stand on, not a weight.
sentences.zh: 他自己的历史是可以立足的根基，而不是负担。

sentences.en: He decided it was time for real action.
sentences.zh: 他决定，是时候采取真正的行动了。

sentences.en: He would no longer let fear act like the boss of his life.
sentences.zh: 他不会再让恐惧像主人一样支配自己的生活。

sentences.en: Back on campus, Lin joined the computer association.
sentences.zh: 回到校园后，林加入了计算机协会。

sentences.en: The group met in a small room near the coffee shop every Friday.
sentences.zh: 这个小组每周五在咖啡店附近的一间小屋里聚会。

sentences.en: Among the members, he found people with the same interests.
sentences.zh: 在成员当中，他找到了志趣相投的人。

sentences.en: A kind senior gave him access to a helpful website.
sentences.zh: 一位热心的学长给了他一个实用网站的访问权限。

sentences.en: He created a new account there that same night.
sentences.zh: 当晚他就在那里创建了一个新账户。

sentences.en: The club's computers were available every evening.
sentences.zh: 社团的电脑每天晚上都可以使用。

sentences.en: In addition, one older member checked his code each week.
sentences.zh: 此外，一位年长的成员每周帮他检查代码。

sentences.en: Their support did not allow him to give up.
sentences.zh: 他们的支持不允许他轻易放弃。

sentences.en: Day by day, his paper grew stronger and much cleaner.
sentences.zh: 一天天过去，他的论文越来越扎实、越来越清晰。

sentences.en: He explained how machines learn from human speech.
sentences.zh: 他解释了机器如何从人类语言中学习。

sentences.en: When one idea failed, he simply tried again.
sentences.zh: 当一个想法失败时，他就再试一次。

sentences.en: He worked ahead of schedule for the first time ever.
sentences.zh: 他有生以来第一次提前完成了进度。

sentences.en: Although the topic was hard, he no longer felt afraid.
sentences.zh: 虽然题目很难，他却不再害怕。

sentences.en: Being busy with a clear goal made his mind calm.
sentences.zh: 带着明确目标忙碌，让他的内心平静下来。

sentences.en: He was slowly becoming a different person.
sentences.zh: 他正在慢慢变成另一个人。

sentences.en: Maya always sent him funny messages to keep his spirits high.
sentences.zh: 玛雅总是发有趣的消息给他打气。

sentences.en: Then came the final night of his project.
sentences.zh: 然后，项目的最后一晚到来了。

sentences.en: He read the whole paper one last time in his room.
sentences.zh: 他在房间里把整篇论文最后读了一遍。

sentences.en: It was almost midnight when he finished checking.
sentences.zh: 检查完时已经快到午夜。

sentences.en: He took a deep breath, then clicked the button to submit his work.
sentences.zh: 他深吸一口气，点下按钮提交了自己的作品。

sentences.en: A week later, the test results appeared online.
sentences.zh: 一周后，成绩公布在网上。

sentences.en: He had passed with one of the highest scores.
sentences.zh: 他以最高分之一通过了考试。

sentences.en: He was able to laugh out loud in his empty room.
sentences.zh: 他能在空荡荡的房间里放声大笑。

sentences.en: Nothing in his life had felt this good for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 他的生活中很久没有什么事让他感觉这么好了。

sentences.en: After the results came out, Lin called his parents.
sentences.zh: 成绩出来后，林给父母打了电话。

sentences.en: He told them the whole story, even the hard parts.
sentences.zh: 他把整个故事都告诉了他们，包括那些难熬的部分。

sentences.en: His growth had not happened by accident.
sentences.zh: 他的成长并非偶然。

sentences.en: It came because good friends helped him build good habits.
sentences.zh: 这是因为好朋友帮他养成了好习惯。

sentences.en: Now he looked around his small room with new eyes.
sentences.zh: 现在，他用全新的眼光环顾自己的小房间。

sentences.en: It no longer felt like a lonely little box.
sentences.zh: 它不再像一个孤独的小盒子。

sentences.en: He knew hard days would return some day.
sentences.zh: 他知道艰难的日子总有一天还会回来。

sentences.en: But this time he knew he would be ready for them.
sentences.zh: 但这一次，他知道自己会做好准备。

sentences.en: People say home is where you were born, and I believe that.
sentences.zh: 人们说，家就是你出生的地方，我相信这句话。

sentences.en: My name is Dr. Amy Lin, and this is my story.
sentences.zh: 我叫艾米·林医生，这是我的故事。

sentences.en: I grew up in a small city in the west of the country.
sentences.zh: 我在这个国家西部的一座小城市长大。

sentences.en: An old church stood in the middle of our town.
sentences.zh: 一座古老的教堂矗立在我们镇子的中央。

sentences.en: It had a tall tower and a bright blue roof.
sentences.zh: 它有一座高高的塔楼和一个亮蓝色的屋顶。

sentences.en: The building was more than a century old.
sentences.zh: 这栋建筑已经有一百多年的历史了。

sentences.en: My brother Ben and I played there as children.
sentences.zh: 小时候，我和弟弟本常常在那里玩耍。

sentences.en: Those were the happiest years of my life.
sentences.zh: 那是我一生中最快乐的岁月。

sentences.en: Last spring, my father called me in the capital.
sentences.zh: 去年春天，父亲往首都给我打了个电话。

sentences.en: His voice sounded a bit shaky on the phone.
sentences.zh: 电话里他的声音听起来有点发抖。

sentences.en: 'A big company wants to buy the land,' he said.
sentences.zh: “一家大公司想买下那块地，”他说。

sentences.en: 'They plan to cut the old trees and build offices.'
sentences.zh: “他们打算砍掉老树，盖起办公楼。”

sentences.en: I felt cold inside when I heard the news.
sentences.zh: 听到这个消息，我心里一阵发冷。

sentences.en: Losing that place seemed crazy to me.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，失去那个地方简直是疯了。

sentences.en: That night I made a quick decision.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我做了一个果断的决定。

sentences.en: I packed a box of clothes and one favorite book.
sentences.zh: 我收拾了一箱衣服和一本最喜欢的书。

sentences.en: Then I got into my car and began the long drive home.
sentences.zh: 然后我坐进车里，踏上了回家的漫长车程。

sentences.en: Ben met me at the front door of our old house.
sentences.zh: 本在老房子的前门迎接我。

sentences.en: His brown dog ran out to greet me too.
sentences.zh: 他的棕色小狗也跑出来欢迎我。

sentences.en: 'I knew you would come,' he said with a tired smile.
sentences.zh: “我就知道你会回来，”他带着疲惫的微笑说。

sentences.en: We drank a hot cup of tea in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 我们在厨房里喝了一杯热茶。

sentences.en: He showed me a letter from the development company.
sentences.zh: 他给我看了那家开发公司寄来的信。

sentences.en: The director of the company had signed it himself.
sentences.zh: 公司的董事亲自在信上签了名。

sentences.en: The letter said the deal was almost complete.
sentences.zh: 信上说这笔交易几乎已经完成。

sentences.en: The land would be theirs by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 到年底，那块地就会归他们所有。

sentences.en: Ben looked down at the floor and said nothing.
sentences.zh: 本低头看着地板，一言不发。

sentences.en: I told him we still had a chance to change things.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他，我们仍有机会改变这一切。

sentences.en: The next morning we crossed the street to see the church again.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我们穿过街道，再去看看那座教堂。

sentences.en: Below the tower, workers had already put up a fence.
sentences.zh: 塔楼下面，工人们已经竖起了围栏。

sentences.en: Grey dust covered the old windows.
sentences.zh: 灰色的尘土盖满了老旧的窗户。

sentences.en: A sign on the fence showed the design for new offices.
sentences.zh: 围栏上的一块牌子展示着新办公楼的设计图。

sentences.en: The picture was a tall glass tower with a black roof.
sentences.zh: 图上是一座黑色屋顶的高大玻璃楼。

sentences.en: 'They want to create something modern,' Ben said quietly.
sentences.zh: “他们想创造一些现代的东西，”本轻声说。

sentences.en: 'But this place has real character,' I answered.
sentences.zh: “可是这个地方有真正的个性，”我回答。

sentences.en: 'There is a difference between old and useless.'
sentences.zh: “陈旧和无用之间是有区别的。”

sentences.en: That evening, we decided to start a campaign to save it.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我们决定发起一场拯救教堂的运动。

sentences.en: First, we needed to bring people together.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们需要把大家召集起来。

sentences.en: We printed cards and handed them out daily at the market.
sentences.zh: 我们印了卡片，每天在市场上分发。

sentences.en: We talked to the reading club and to students from the college.
sentences.zh: 我们找了读书会，也找了大学里的学生。

sentences.en: Many people shared a common love for the old place.
sentences.zh: 许多人对这个老地方怀着共同的热爱。

sentences.en: A couple who ran the bakery gave us free bread for meetings.
sentences.zh: 一对经营面包店的夫妇为我们的聚会免费提供面包。

sentences.en: Their daughter painted a beautiful poster for us.
sentences.zh: 他们的女儿为我们画了一张漂亮的海报。

sentences.en: Even the boy who delivered newspapers joined our cause.
sentences.zh: 就连送报纸的男孩也加入了我们的事业。

sentences.en: Everyone had a different reason, but the goal was the same.
sentences.zh: 每个人的理由各不相同，但目标是一致的。

sentences.en: In one week, our small group became a real movement.
sentences.zh: 一个星期内，我们的小团体变成了一场真正的运动。

sentences.en: Soon the town board agreed to hold a public conference.
sentences.zh: 很快，镇委员会同意举行一次公开会议。

sentences.en: It would take place at the central library on a Friday.
sentences.zh: 会议将在周五于中央图书馆举行。

sentences.en: We checked every fact twice before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 开会前，我们把每个事实都核对了两遍。

sentences.en: Ben prepared our case with great care.
sentences.zh: 本非常用心地准备了我们的陈述。

sentences.en: The content of our speech had to be clear and honest.
sentences.zh: 我们发言的内容必须清楚而诚实。

sentences.en: It was difficult work, and we slept very little.
sentences.zh: 这是件很难的工作，我们几乎没怎么睡觉。

sentences.en: Some nights I felt the blood racing through my body.
sentences.zh: 有些夜晚，我能感觉到血液在身体里奔流。

sentences.en: Still, we continued, because giving up was not a choice.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然坚持，因为放弃不是一个选项。

sentences.en: On the day of the meeting, the library was full.
sentences.zh: 会议那天，图书馆里挤满了人。

sentences.en: The company sent both a lawyer and a planner.
sentences.zh: 公司派来了一名律师和一名规划师。

sentences.en: Their chief lawyer spoke first about jobs and cost.
sentences.zh: 他们的首席律师首先谈了就业和成本。

sentences.en: He said the project was due to start in two months.
sentences.zh: 他说项目定于两个月后开工。

sentences.en: He promised the new offices would double the jobs in town.
sentences.zh: 他承诺新办公楼会让镇上的工作岗位翻一倍。

sentences.en: People from every street had come to listen.
sentences.zh: 各条街上的人都赶来聆听。

sentences.en: Then it was my turn to speak.
sentences.zh: 然后轮到我发言了。

sentences.en: 'This place has seen birth and death for a hundred years,' I said.
sentences.zh: “一百年来，这个地方见证了出生与死亡，”我说。

sentences.en: 'Weddings were held here; babies were named here.'
sentences.zh: “婚礼在这里举行，婴儿在这里得到名字。”

sentences.en: 'You cannot put a price on memory.'
sentences.zh: “你无法给记忆标上价格。”

sentences.en: The room went quiet, and then people began to clap.
sentences.zh: 全场安静了下来，随后人们开始鼓掌。

sentences.en: But the company did not give up.
sentences.zh: 但是公司并没有放弃。

sentences.en: They took the matter to court the next month.
sentences.zh: 第二个月，他们把这件事告上了法庭。

sentences.en: Their lawyers argued that the town had lost control of the land.
sentences.zh: 他们的律师声称镇政府已经失去了对这块地的控制权。

sentences.en: They claimed certain papers gave them full charge of the property.
sentences.zh: 他们说某些文件赋予了他们对这处产业的全部管理权。

sentences.en: A friend from the city law department gave us free advice.
sentences.zh: 一位在市法律部门工作的朋友免费给我们出主意。

sentences.en: Even so, we could not stop the legal bill from growing.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，我们也无法阻止律师费账单越来越高。

sentences.en: We paid part of it on credit, and neighbors helped with the rest.
sentences.zh: 我们用信用赊了一部分钱，邻居们帮忙付了其余的。

sentences.en: There were dark nights when I felt ready to break.
sentences.zh: 有些黑暗的夜晚，我觉得自己快要崩溃了。

sentences.en: Ben always told me to stay cool and keep working.
sentences.zh: 本总是叫我保持冷静，继续干下去。

sentences.en: Then one quiet afternoon, an old woman knocked at our office.
sentences.zh: 后来，在一个安静的下午，一位老妇人敲响了我们办公室的门。

sentences.en: She said she had read about our fight in the newspaper.
sentences.zh: 她说她在报纸上读到了我们的抗争。

sentences.en: She carried a deep wooden box full of yellow papers.
sentences.zh: 她抱着一个很深的木箱，里面装满了发黄的文件。

sentences.en: Inside was a document with a date from 1898.
sentences.zh: 里面有一份注明日期为1898年的文件。

sentences.en: It said the land belonged to the town forever.
sentences.zh: 文件写明，这块地永远属于这个小镇。

sentences.en: The old church committee had signed the paper long ago.
sentences.zh: 当年的教堂委员会早已在文件上签了字。

sentences.en: 'My grandfather helped to build it,' she told us softly.
sentences.zh: “我的祖父帮忙建造了它，”她轻声告诉我们。

sentences.en: 'He died before I ever met him, and he left me these papers.'
sentences.zh: “我还没见过他，他就去世了，这些文件是他留给我的。”

sentences.en: We took the document to the judge the next morning.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，我们就把文件送到了法官那里。

sentences.en: The judge studied the old paper with great attention.
sentences.zh: 法官非常专注地研究了那份旧文件。

sentences.en: In the end, he ruled in our favor.
sentences.zh: 最终，他做出了对我们有利的判决。

sentences.en: The old document was still legal after all these years.
sentences.zh: 这么多年过去了，那份旧文件仍然具有法律效力。

sentences.en: The company's plan was dead, and the land was safe.
sentences.zh: 公司的计划彻底完了，土地保住了。

sentences.en: The town then asked us what to do with the building.
sentences.zh: 于是镇上问我们该拿这栋建筑做点什么。

sentences.en: We turned it into a warm community center for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们把它改成了一个温暖的社区中心，向所有人开放。

sentences.en: Now children take art classes there, and old people play chess.
sentences.zh: 如今，孩子们在那里上美术课，老人们在那里下棋。

sentences.en: Its blue door stands open every morning at nine.
sentences.zh: 它的蓝色大门每天早上九点敞开。

sentences.en: Ben works there every weekend and loves it.
sentences.zh: 本每个周末都在那里工作，乐在其中。

sentences.en: As for me, I went back to my hospital in the capital.
sentences.zh: 至于我，我回到了首都的医院。

sentences.en: But my heart stays close to that little town.
sentences.zh: 但我的心始终贴近那个小镇。

sentences.en: Some fights look impossible, yet love wins them anyway.
sentences.zh: 有些战斗看似不可能取胜，然而爱总能赢下它们。

sentences.en: Lin was a girl who loved football more than anything in the world.
sentences.zh: 林是一个爱足球胜过世上一切的女孩。

sentences.en: She lived with her family in a small town in the east of China.
sentences.zh: 她和家人住在中国东部的一个小镇上。

sentences.en: Her father was a former player who had never reached the top level.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲曾是一名球员，却从未打进过顶级联赛。

sentences.en: He woke her early in the morning so they could run together.
sentences.zh: 他清晨很早就叫醒她，好一起去跑步。

sentences.en: The training was hard, but she never complained about it.
sentences.zh: 训练很辛苦，但她从不抱怨。

sentences.en: She enjoyed each session more than the last one.
sentences.zh: 她一次比一次更享受每堂训练课。

sentences.en: Her best friend Hana trained with her at the same club.
sentences.zh: 她最好的朋友哈娜和她在同一家俱乐部训练。

sentences.en: The two of them shared one dream: to play on a big stage someday.
sentences.zh: 她们俩有一个共同的梦想：有朝一日站上大舞台。

sentences.en: One spring day, a letter arrived that changed everything.
sentences.zh: 一个春日，一封信寄到了，改变了一切。

sentences.en: Their team had been chosen for a youth event in Europe.
sentences.zh: 她们的球队被选中参加在欧洲举办的一项青年赛事。

sentences.en: Everyone in the town talked about the news all week.
sentences.zh: 整整一周，镇上的每个人都在谈论这个消息。

sentences.en: Lin could hardly eat or sleep because of her excitement.
sentences.zh: 林兴奋得几乎吃不下饭、睡不着觉。

sentences.en: She had never visited a foreign country before.
sentences.zh: 她以前从没去过外国。

sentences.en: Her mother worried about the cost, but agreed it was a good chance.
sentences.zh: 妈妈担心费用，但也承认这是个好机会。

sentences.en: The trip would be a great experience, the coach promised.
sentences.zh: 教练保证，这次旅行会是一次很棒的经历。

sentences.en: It would also open her mind and help her education, the coach added.
sentences.zh: 教练还补充说，这也会开阔她的眼界，对她的教育有帮助。

sentences.en: The team flew west for more than ten hours.
sentences.zh: 球队向西飞行了十多个小时。

sentences.en: Through the window, the earth below looked quiet and green.
sentences.zh: 透过舷窗，下方的大地看起来宁静而翠绿。

sentences.en: Lin pressed her face against the glass and smiled.
sentences.zh: 林把脸贴在玻璃上，微笑起来。

sentences.en: She could not forget the last words from her dad at the airport.
sentences.zh: 她忘不了爸爸在机场说的最后那句话。

sentences.en: 'Play with joy, and never be afraid to lose.'
sentences.zh: “快乐地踢球，永远不要怕输。”

sentences.en: The old European city was full of stone streets and towers.
sentences.zh: 这座古老的欧洲城市到处是石板街道和塔楼。

sentences.en: Every corner seemed to hold a new surprise for the visitors.
sentences.zh: 每个街角似乎都藏着给来客的新惊喜。

sentences.en: The girls walked around with wide eyes on their first evening there.
sentences.zh: 到达的第一个晚上，姑娘们瞪大眼睛四处闲逛。

sentences.en: During the first practice, a stranger stood watching near the field.
sentences.zh: 第一次训练时，一个陌生人站在场地边观看。

sentences.en: The man carried a camera and followed the players everywhere.
sentences.zh: 那个人扛着摄像机，走到哪儿都跟着队员们。

sentences.en: His name was Marco, an Italian film director.
sentences.zh: 他叫马可，是一位意大利电影导演。

sentences.en: Marco was making a documentary about young female athletes.
sentences.zh: 马可正在拍摄一部关于年轻女运动员的纪录片。

sentences.en: 'Players like you are the future of this sport,' Marco said.
sentences.zh: “像你们这样的球员就是这项运动的未来。”马可说。

sentences.en: Lin felt shy in front of the camera at first.
sentences.zh: 起初，林在镜头前感到害羞。

sentences.en: But soon she even stopped noticing it.
sentences.zh: 但很快她甚至不再注意到它了。

sentences.en: The camera became part of daily life, like food or water.
sentences.zh: 摄像机成了日常生活的一部分，就像食物和水一样。

sentences.en: Their first game was not easy at all.
sentences.zh: 她们的第一场比赛一点也不轻松。

sentences.en: The other team was fast, tall, and strong.
sentences.zh: 对方球队速度快、个子高、身体强壮。

sentences.en: Lin's group fell behind after only twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 仅仅二十分钟后，林所在的队伍就落后了。

sentences.en: By the second half, they were two goals down.
sentences.zh: 到了下半场，她们已经落后两球。

sentences.en: Some players began to lose hope and energy.
sentences.zh: 一些队员开始失去希望和劲头。

sentences.en: But Lin refused to give up so soon.
sentences.zh: 但林拒绝这么快就放弃。

sentences.en: She won the ball and pushed forward with all her speed.
sentences.zh: 她抢下球，用最快的速度向前推进。

sentences.en: Hana scored first, and Lin scored twice before the end.
sentences.zh: 哈娜先进一球，随后林在终场前连进两球。

sentences.en: They had turned the match around, and the feeling was wonderful.
sentences.zh: 她们逆转了比赛，那种感觉美妙极了。

sentences.en: That night, the whole team sang songs on the bus.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，全队在大巴上唱起了歌。

sentences.en: Then something happened that nobody could expect.
sentences.zh: 接着，发生了一件谁也没有料到的事。

sentences.en: On the third night, a fire started in the hotel kitchen.
sentences.zh: 第三天夜里，酒店厨房起火了。

sentences.en: A gas pipe had broken behind one of the old ovens.
sentences.zh: 一根燃气管在一台旧烤箱后面破裂了。

sentences.en: Thick smoke filled the hallway, and the alarm forced everybody outside.
sentences.zh: 浓烟弥漫了走廊，警报迫使所有人跑到外面。

sentences.en: The girls stood on the cold ground in their pajamas.
sentences.zh: 姑娘们穿着睡衣站在冰冷的地面上。

sentences.en: A few of them were crying, and Lin held Hana's hand.
sentences.zh: 有几个人哭了，林握住哈娜的手。

sentences.en: 'Thank god nobody was hurt,' the coach kept saying.
sentences.zh: “谢天谢地没人受伤。”教练不停地念叨。

sentences.en: Firefighters found the problem quickly, and the danger soon passed.
sentences.zh: 消防员很快找到了问题所在，危险不久就解除了。

sentences.en: Later, the girls laughed about their funny pajamas in the street.
sentences.zh: 后来，姑娘们笑着说起自己穿着滑稽睡衣站在街上的样子。

sentences.en: The next morning, safety officials arrived at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，安全官员来到了酒店。

sentences.en: They collected evidence about the cause of the fire.
sentences.zh: 他们收集了关于火灾起因的证据。

sentences.en: A general report was sent to the local government.
sentences.zh: 一份总体报告被提交给了当地政府。

sentences.en: Some said a federal office would study the case further.
sentences.zh: 有人说联邦部门还会进一步调查此事。

sentences.en: For the players, however, life had to move on.
sentences.zh: 然而，对队员们来说，生活必须继续。

sentences.en: The final match was only two days away.
sentences.zh: 决赛只剩两天了。

sentences.en: Their coach asked them to focus on that one match.
sentences.zh: 教练要求她们把注意力集中在那一场比赛上。

sentences.en: Nothing else mattered now, she told the team firmly.
sentences.zh: 她坚定地告诉全队，现在别的什么都不重要。

sentences.en: Lin called home the night before the big day.
sentences.zh: 大赛前夜，林给家里打了电话。

sentences.en: Her father answered before the phone rang twice.
sentences.zh: 电话还没响两声，父亲就接了。

sentences.en: 'Win or lose, we are proud of you,' he said warmly.
sentences.zh: “不管输赢，我们都为你骄傲。”他温暖地说。

sentences.en: Lin touched her short hair and smiled through her tears.
sentences.zh: 林摸了摸自己的短发，含着泪笑了。

sentences.en: She did not fear losing, but she hated giving less than her best.
sentences.zh: 她不怕输，但她讨厌不尽全力。

sentences.en: In fact, she wanted this win more than anything in her life.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这场胜利是她此生最渴望的东西。

sentences.en: Her extra practice each evening was one example of that spirit.
sentences.zh: 她每晚的加练就是这种精神的一个例子。

sentences.en: She could only guess how strong their opponents would be.
sentences.zh: 她只能猜测对手会有多强。

sentences.en: That team had won the entire tournament the year before.
sentences.zh: 那支球队前一年赢下了整个锦标赛。

sentences.en: The day of the match was bright and cold.
sentences.zh: 比赛那天，天气晴朗而寒冷。

sentences.en: Fans filled the stands, especially on the east side.
sentences.zh: 看台上坐满了球迷，尤其是东侧。

sentences.en: It was the biggest crowd Lin had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 这是林见过的最大的人群。

sentences.en: Both teams walked out and lined up in perfect form.
sentences.zh: 两支球队走出场，以整齐的队形排列开来。

sentences.en: When the whistle blew, Lin felt strangely free.
sentences.zh: 哨声响起时，林奇异地感到一身轻松。

sentences.en: The first minutes were a real fight in the middle of the pitch.
sentences.zh: 开场几分钟，双方在中场展开了激烈的争夺。

sentences.en: Neither side could get past the other's defense.
sentences.zh: 哪一方都突破不了对方的防线。

sentences.en: Lin took a shot, but the ball went just over the bar.
sentences.zh: 林起脚射门，可球稍稍高出了横梁。

sentences.en: 'Not far off!' shouted the coach with a clap.
sentences.zh: “就差一点！”教练拍着手喊道。

sentences.en: Late in the second half, Lin saw a tall figure step out of position.
sentences.zh: 下半场快结束时，林看到一个高大的身影离开了防守位置。

sentences.en: This was her chance to find the open space.
sentences.zh: 这正是她找到空当的机会。

sentences.en: Hana headed the ball down into Lin's path.
sentences.zh: 哈娜一记头球，把球顶到了林的跑动路线上。

sentences.en: Lin shot with her left foot, and the net shook.
sentences.zh: 林左脚劲射，球网应声颤动。

sentences.en: The score stayed one to zero until the last whistle.
sentences.zh: 比分一比零，一直保持到终场哨响。

sentences.en: At the final whistle, the players were happy beyond words.
sentences.zh: 终场哨响时，队员们高兴得说不出话来。

sentences.en: Each player received a gold medal on a red ribbon.
sentences.zh: 每位队员都领到了一枚系着红丝带的金牌。

sentences.en: 'Are you crying?' Hana asked with a laugh.
sentences.zh: “你在哭吗？”哈娜笑着问。

sentences.en: 'I am fine, I promise,' Lin answered, wiping her cheeks.
sentences.zh: “我没事，真的。”林一边擦脸颊一边回答。

sentences.en: That night, the team had a party full of music and dancing.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，全队举办了一场满是音乐和舞蹈的庆祝会。

sentences.en: It was the most fun Lin could ever remember.
sentences.zh: 那是林记忆中最开心的一次。

sentences.en: Marco showed a short cut of his film, and nobody spoke except to cheer.
sentences.zh: 马可放映了他影片的一小段，除了欢呼，没有人说话。

sentences.en: The whole trip had a deep effect on Lin.
sentences.zh: 这次旅行对林产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: She understood now that real growth comes through struggle.
sentences.zh: 她现在明白了，真正的成长来自拼搏。

sentences.en: Talent alone is never enough, her coach liked to say.
sentences.zh: 教练常说，光有天赋是永远不够的。

sentences.en: You must love the work too, either in victory or in defeat.
sentences.zh: 无论胜利还是失败，你都必须热爱这份付出。

sentences.en: At the airport, Lin held her medal and thought of home.
sentences.zh: 在机场，林握着奖牌，想起了家。

sentences.en: Her father would be waiting at the door with their old dog.
sentences.zh: 父亲会牵着家里的老狗在门口等她。

sentences.en: She could not wait to tell him about everything that had happened.
sentences.zh: 她迫不及待地想把发生的一切都讲给他听。

sentences.en: Green Island is a small green place far from the big city.
sentences.zh: 绿岛是一个远离大城市的绿色小地方。

sentences.en: Dr. Mei Lin has lived here for more than ten years.
sentences.zh: 林梅医生在这里生活了十多年。

sentences.en: Her husband, David, teaches at the school near the old port.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫大卫在老港口附近的学校教书。

sentences.en: Every morning Mei walks to the little hospital by the sea.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，梅都步行去海边的小医院。

sentences.en: The people love her because she works with all her heart.
sentences.zh: 人们爱她，因为她全心全意地工作。

sentences.en: Fishermen wave their hands and call, 'Hi, Doctor!' when she passes.
sentences.zh: 她经过时，渔民们挥着手喊道："嗨，医生！"

sentences.en: Life on the island is slow and quiet, and Mei enjoys that.
sentences.zh: 岛上的生活缓慢而安静，梅很喜欢这样。

sentences.en: She hopes it will stay this way for many more years.
sentences.zh: 她希望这样的日子能再持续很多年。

sentences.en: One cold night, a young man knocked hard on her door.
sentences.zh: 一个寒冷的夜晚，一个年轻男子用力敲响了她的门。

sentences.en: His hands were shaking, and his face was white with fear.
sentences.zh: 他的双手在颤抖，脸吓得发白。

sentences.en: 'Please help me,' he said in a weak, broken voice.
sentences.zh: "请帮帮我，"他用微弱而断断续续的声音说。

sentences.en: 'My father fell on the ice near the fishing boats.'
sentences.zh: "我父亲在渔船附近的冰面上摔倒了。"

sentences.en: Mei grabbed her bag and followed him into the dark night.
sentences.zh: 梅抓起她的包，跟着他走进黑暗的夜色。

sentences.en: The wind was high, and the waves hit the rocks again and again.
sentences.zh: 风很大，海浪一次又一次地拍打着岩石。

sentences.en: After half an hour, they found the old fisherman on the wet ground.
sentences.zh: 半小时后，他们在湿漉漉的地上找到了那位老渔民。

sentences.en: He was too weak to stand up by himself.
sentences.zh: 他太虚弱了，无法自己站起来。

sentences.en: Mei asked the young man to hold a light above her head.
sentences.zh: 梅让年轻人在她头顶上举着一盏灯。

sentences.en: She checked the old fisherman's leg and head very carefully.
sentences.zh: 她非常仔细地检查了老渔民的腿和头。

sentences.en: 'We must keep him warm until morning,' she said calmly.
sentences.zh: "我们必须让他保暖到天亮，"她平静地说。

sentences.en: Together they carried the old man inside a small stone house nearby.
sentences.zh: 他们一起把老人抬进了附近一座小石屋里。

sentences.en: A fire made the room hot, and the fisherman slowly opened his eyes.
sentences.zh: 炉火让房间热了起来，渔民慢慢睁开了眼睛。

sentences.en: 'You will not lose your father tonight,' Mei told the worried boy.
sentences.zh: "今晚你不会失去你的父亲，"梅对忧心忡忡的男孩说。

sentences.en: The boy smiled through his tears and thanked her many times.
sentences.zh: 男孩含泪笑了，一次又一次地感谢她。

sentences.en: In that quiet moment, Mei remembered why she loved her job.
sentences.zh: 在那安静的一刻，梅想起了自己为什么热爱这份工作。

sentences.en: A week later, strange news reached every corner of the island.
sentences.zh: 一周后，一个奇怪的消息传遍了岛上的每个角落。

sentences.en: An international company wanted to buy the land near the harbor.
sentences.zh: 一家国际公司想买下港口附近的土地。

sentences.en: Its plan was to build a huge new factory there.
sentences.zh: 它的计划是在那里建一座巨大的新工厂。

sentences.en: The company said the new industry would bring money and work.
sentences.zh: 公司说这个新产业会带来金钱和工作。

sentences.en: It also promised to increase the number of ships every year.
sentences.zh: 它还承诺每年增加船只的数量。

sentences.en: However, the factory would stand exactly where the hospital now stands.
sentences.zh: 然而，工厂将正好建在现在医院所在的地方。

sentences.en: The old hospital itself would have to close its doors forever.
sentences.zh: 老医院本身将不得不永远关门。

sentences.en: When Mei heard this news, she could hardly believe her ears.
sentences.zh: 梅听到这个消息时，简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。

sentences.en: That evening, many angry people came to the main square.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，许多愤怒的人来到了主广场。

sentences.en: David stood beside Mei and held her hand in the cold air.
sentences.zh: 大卫站在梅身边，在寒冷的空气中握着她的手。

sentences.en: 'This hospital is important to every one of us,' Mei said loudly.
sentences.zh: "这家医院对我们每个人都很重要，"梅大声说。

sentences.en: 'It has served our families through all of our history.'
sentences.zh: "在我们的整个历史中，它一直为我们的家庭服务。"

sentences.en: 'If it closes, sick people must travel three hours by boat.'
sentences.zh: "如果它关门了，病人就得坐三个小时的船。"

sentences.en: 'For some of them, that could mean death instead of life.'
sentences.zh: "对其中一些人来说，那可能意味着死亡，而不是生存。"

sentences.en: An old woman shouted, 'This plan will kill our town!'
sentences.zh: 一位老妇人喊道："这个计划会毁了我们的小镇！"

sentences.en: The crowd grew loud, but nobody knew what to do next.
sentences.zh: 人群喧闹起来，但没有人知道接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: Mei could not sleep, and deep in the night she had an idea.
sentences.zh: 梅睡不着，深夜里她有了一个主意。

sentences.en: 'The law may be on our side,' she told David quietly.
sentences.zh: "法律也许站在我们这边，"她轻声对大卫说。

sentences.en: 'There is an old legal rule about public land here.'
sentences.zh: "这里有一条关于公共土地的古老法律规定。"

sentences.en: 'The government cannot sell it without asking the local people first.'
sentences.zh: "政府不先征求当地人的意见，就不能出售它。"

sentences.en: David agreed and said, 'Then we need much more information.'
sentences.zh: 大卫同意了，说："那我们需要更多的信息。"

sentences.en: 'Let me write to a lawyer in the city tomorrow,' he added.
sentences.zh: "让我明天给城里的一位律师写信，"他补充道。

sentences.en: 'At least we can learn what our rights really are.'
sentences.zh: "至少我们可以了解我们真正的权利是什么。"

sentences.en: For the first time in days, Mei felt a little stronger.
sentences.zh: 几天来第一次，梅感觉自己坚强了一点。

sentences.en: The next morning, Mei wrote a long list of family names.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，梅写下了一长串家庭的名字。

sentences.en: She asked every single family to join their peaceful campaign.
sentences.zh: 她请每一个家庭都加入他们和平的行动。

sentences.en: Even the fishing league signed its name at the very top.
sentences.zh: 就连渔业联盟也在最上面签了名。

sentences.en: David collected facts about the hospital's work over the past years.
sentences.zh: 大卫收集了医院过去几年工作的事实。

sentences.en: The numbers showed clearly how much the island needed this place.
sentences.zh: 这些数字清楚地表明这个岛多么需要这个地方。

sentences.en: Last winter alone, the doctors there had saved twelve lives.
sentences.zh: 仅去年冬天，那里的医生就挽救了十二条生命。

sentences.en: Mei put every fact and every line of data into one report.
sentences.zh: 梅把每一个事实和每一行数据都写进了一份报告。

sentences.en: It was the most interesting thing she had ever made.
sentences.zh: 这是她做过的最有意思的东西。

sentences.en: David sent the finished report to the national media.
sentences.zh: 大卫把完成的报告寄给了全国的媒体。

sentences.en: A young reporter found the story and shared it online.
sentences.zh: 一位年轻记者发现了这个故事，并在网上分享了它。

sentences.en: Soon a lot of people were talking about Green Island.
sentences.zh: 很快，很多人都在谈论绿岛。

sentences.en: The level of public interest rose higher day by day.
sentences.zh: 公众的关注度一天比一天高。

sentences.en: One famous singer even wrote a song about the brave doctor.
sentences.zh: 一位著名歌手甚至写了一首关于这位勇敢医生的歌。

sentences.en: He called the hospital 'a small palace where kindness is king.'
sentences.zh: 他称这家医院是"一座善良为王的小宫殿"。

sentences.en: People from far away sent kind messages in every language.
sentences.zh: 远方的人们用各种语言发来了友善的信息。

sentences.en: Mei read them late at night and smiled to herself.
sentences.zh: 梅深夜读着这些信息，独自微笑。

sentences.en: In early March, the government sent a special team to the island.
sentences.zh: 三月初，政府派了一个特别小组来到岛上。

sentences.en: Hundreds of people walked together to the harbor that gray morning.
sentences.zh: 那个灰蒙蒙的早晨，数百人一起走向港口。

sentences.en: They carried simple signs but stayed calm and polite.
sentences.zh: 他们举着简单的标语，但保持冷静和礼貌。

sentences.en: The head of the team was a tall man in a large coat.
sentences.zh: 小组的负责人是一个穿着大衣的高个子男人。

sentences.en: 'I am here to listen to you,' he said simply.
sentences.zh: "我是来听你们说的，"他简单地说。

sentences.en: Mei stepped forward to lead the talk for the whole island.
sentences.zh: 梅走上前，代表全岛主持这次谈话。

sentences.en: 'Please look at these numbers before you decide anything,' she said.
sentences.zh: "在你们做任何决定之前，请看看这些数字，"她说。

sentences.en: She handed him the report with steady hands and waited.
sentences.zh: 她用平稳的双手把报告递给他，然后等待着。

sentences.en: The man read every page slowly, without saying a word.
sentences.zh: 那个男人慢慢地读完每一页，一言不发。

sentences.en: 'These facts truly matter,' he said at last.
sentences.zh: "这些事实确实很重要，"他最后说。

sentences.en: 'This hospital is clearly a key part of island life.'
sentences.zh: "这家医院显然是岛上生活的关键部分。"

sentences.en: 'A major change like this needs far more careful thought.'
sentences.zh: "这样重大的改变需要更加慎重的考虑。"

sentences.en: 'Any new plan must include the hospital, not destroy it.'
sentences.zh: "任何新计划都必须包括这家医院，而不是摧毁它。"

sentences.en: 'This is not just about money,' Mei answered him softly.
sentences.zh: "这不仅仅是钱的问题，"梅轻声回答他。

sentences.en: 'It is about human life and what caring for others means.'
sentences.zh: "这关乎人的生命，关乎关爱他人的意义。"

sentences.en: The official nodded slowly and made a mark in his notebook.
sentences.zh: 官员缓缓点头，在笔记本上做了个记号。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, a letter arrived in a white envelope.
sentences.zh: 两周后，一封装在白色信封里的信寄到了。

sentences.en: The company had decided to leave the harbor plan behind.
sentences.zh: 公司决定放弃港口的计划。

sentences.en: The factory would likely move to an empty area on the mainland.
sentences.zh: 工厂很可能会搬到大陆上一片空地上。

sentences.en: The island had feared a great loss, but now it was safe.
sentences.zh: 岛上的人曾担心遭受巨大的损失，但现在安全了。

sentences.en: Prices at the market stayed low, and the boats sailed out as before.
sentences.zh: 市场上的物价保持低位，船只像以前一样出海。

sentences.en: That evening, the whole village held a happy party by the water.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，全村人在水边举行了一场欢乐的聚会。

sentences.en: There was even a friendly football match on the sandy beach.
sentences.zh: 沙滩上甚至还进行了一场友谊足球赛。

sentences.en: David scored a goal with his left foot, and everyone laughed.
sentences.zh: 大卫用左脚进了一球，大家都笑了。

sentences.en: Very late that night, Mei and David walked home under the stars.
sentences.zh: 深夜，梅和大卫在星空下走回家。

sentences.en: 'Maybe one small voice really can change big things,' David said.
sentences.zh: "也许一个微小的声音真的能改变大事，"大卫说。

sentences.en: Mei smiled and looked back at the quiet building by the sea.
sentences.zh: 梅笑了，回头望着海边那座安静的建筑。

sentences.en: Its warm windows shone softly above the dark water.
sentences.zh: 温暖的窗户在漆黑的海面上方柔和地亮着。

sentences.en: 'We did not fight alone,' she said with a peaceful smile.
sentences.zh: "我们不是独自战斗的，"她带着平静的微笑说。

sentences.en: 'We simply stood together, and that was more than enough.'
sentences.zh: "我们只是站在了一起，而这就足够了。"

sentences.en: Mei lived in a small city in the north of the country.
sentences.zh: 梅住在这个国家北方的一座小城市里。

sentences.en: Every morning, she took the first bus before the sun came up.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，太阳还没升起，她就坐上头班公交车。

sentences.en: She worked part-time at a medical center.
sentences.zh: 她在一家医疗中心做兼职。

sentences.en: Her job was simple: she answered calls in the front office.
sentences.zh: 她的工作很简单：在前台办公室接听电话。

sentences.en: She wrote down every message from the doctors.
sentences.zh: 她把医生们的每一条留言都记下来。

sentences.en: The pay was low, but she never complained.
sentences.zh: 工资虽然不高，但她从不抱怨。

sentences.en: At night she studied hard, hoping to become a nurse someday.
sentences.zh: 夜里她刻苦学习，希望有朝一日能成为一名护士。

sentences.en: It was not an easy life, but it was hers.
sentences.zh: 这样的生活并不轻松，但那是属于她自己的生活。

sentences.en: Oh, and she loved her family deeply.
sentences.zh: 哦，对了，她还深深地爱着自己的家人。

sentences.en: That love gave her strength every single day.
sentences.zh: 这份爱每天都给她力量。

sentences.en: Her mother had been sick for a long period.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲已经病了很长一段时间。

sentences.en: The old woman felt pain in her back every day.
sentences.zh: 老人每天都感到背部疼痛。

sentences.en: The doctors said she would need an operation soon.
sentences.zh: 医生说她很快就需要做手术。

sentences.en: It would cost nearly twenty thousand yuan.
sentences.zh: 手术要花将近两万元。

sentences.en: Mei earned about two thousand yuan per month.
sentences.zh: 梅每个月只挣大约两千元。

sentences.en: She counted her money again and again at night.
sentences.zh: 夜里她一遍又一遍地数着自己的钱。

sentences.en: The number was always too small.
sentences.zh: 那个数字总是太小了。

sentences.en: Mom, everything will be fine, she said with a smile.
sentences.zh: “妈，一切都会好的。”她微笑着说。

sentences.en: But in her heart, she had no answer.
sentences.zh: 但在她心里，她没有任何答案。

sentences.en: Nothing seemed to help, and she felt lost.
sentences.zh: 似乎什么都无济于事，她感到很迷茫。

sentences.en: One Sunday, Mei walked through the city park.
sentences.zh: 一个星期天，梅穿过城市公园散步。

sentences.en: She often went there to clear her mind.
sentences.zh: 她常去那里理清思绪。

sentences.en: The place was quiet, and soft music floated from a small radio.
sentences.zh: 那个地方很安静，一台小收音机里飘出轻柔的音乐。

sentences.en: In the middle of the path, she saw a wooden box.
sentences.zh: 在小路中间，她看见一个木箱子。

sentences.en: It sat under a big tree, half open.
sentences.zh: 箱子放在一棵大树下，半开着。

sentences.en: Inside was an oil painting of a river.
sentences.zh: 里面是一幅画着河流的油画。

sentences.en: The picture looked beautiful and important.
sentences.zh: 这幅画看起来既美丽又贵重。

sentences.en: A white paper card lay under it.
sentences.zh: 画的下面压着一张白色的纸卡片。

sentences.en: It was a note with a name and an address.
sentences.zh: 那是一张写着姓名和地址的便条。

sentences.en: Mei stood there for a long moment.
sentences.zh: 梅在那里站了好一会儿。

sentences.en: She knew she must do the right thing.
sentences.zh: 她知道自己必须做正确的事。

sentences.en: So she carried the box to the police station.
sentences.zh: 于是她把箱子送到了警察局。

sentences.en: A young officer listened to her story carefully.
sentences.zh: 一位年轻警官认真地听她讲述经过。

sentences.en: He turned the painting over and studied the back.
sentences.zh: 他把画翻过来，仔细查看背面。

sentences.en: Then he called two other experts for help.
sentences.zh: 然后他又请来两位别的专家帮忙。

sentences.en: They studied each brush mark with great care.
sentences.zh: 他们极其仔细地研究每一处笔触。

sentences.en: This might be a lost national treasure, an expert said.
sentences.zh: “这可能是一件失踪的国宝。”一位专家说。

sentences.en: The news spread across the city that same day.
sentences.zh: 当天，这个消息就传遍了全城。

sentences.en: Reporters shared it on every social network.
sentences.zh: 记者们把它分享到了各个社交网络上。

sentences.en: By evening, many people knew Mei's story.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，很多人都知道了梅的故事。

sentences.en: The next day, a museum official came to see her.
sentences.zh: 第二天，一位博物馆官员前来见她。

sentences.en: He invited Mei to a formal meeting downtown.
sentences.zh: 他邀请梅去市中心参加一个正式会议。

sentences.en: Even the culture minister planned to attend.
sentences.zh: 连文化部长都计划出席。

sentences.en: Mei had rarely entered such a modern building.
sentences.zh: 梅很少走进这么现代化的大楼。

sentences.en: Glass walls rose up on every side.
sentences.zh: 四面都是高高的玻璃墙。

sentences.en: She felt small, but she stayed calm.
sentences.zh: 她感到自己很渺小，但仍保持镇定。

sentences.en: You found a painting from the past, the man told her.
sentences.zh: “你找到了一幅来自过去的画。”那个人告诉她。

sentences.en: It went missing from our museum thirty years ago.
sentences.zh: “它三十年前从我们博物馆失踪了。”

sentences.en: Ninety percent stay hidden forever, he explained.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，百分之九十的失踪文物会永远下落不明。

sentences.en: You did a great thing for this country, he added.
sentences.zh: “你为这个国家做了一件大好事。”他补充道。

sentences.en: Then a rich businessman appeared and caused trouble.
sentences.zh: 这时，一个有钱的商人出现了，惹出了麻烦。

sentences.en: That painting is mine, he told the cameras.
sentences.zh: “那幅画是我的。”他对着镜头说。

sentences.en: He claimed his father bought it at a private party.
sentences.zh: 他声称他父亲是在一次私人聚会上买下这幅画的。

sentences.en: He waved a yellowed document as proof.
sentences.zh: 他挥舞着一份发黄的文件当作证据。

sentences.en: But he could explain little about the address card.
sentences.zh: 但对于那张地址卡片，他却说不出什么。

sentences.en: The museum asked experts to check his claim.
sentences.zh: 博物馆请专家核实他的说法。

sentences.en: Mei felt worried and slept badly for days.
sentences.zh: 梅心里很担忧，一连几天都睡不好。

sentences.en: Perhaps the truth would stay buried, she feared.
sentences.zh: 她害怕真相也许会被永远埋没。

sentences.en: A single question kept turning in her head at night.
sentences.zh: 夜里，一个问题在她脑海里反复打转。

sentences.en: I only did what was right, she told herself.
sentences.zh: “我只是做了正确的事。”她这样告诉自己。

sentences.en: A week later, the experts finished their long report.
sentences.zh: 一周之后，专家们完成了长长的报告。

sentences.en: The businessman's document was a clumsy fake.
sentences.zh: 那个商人的文件是一份拙劣的赝品。

sentences.en: The true owner was an artist called Chen.
sentences.zh: 真正的主人是一位名叫陈的画家。

sentences.en: He was the very person from the address card.
sentences.zh: 他正是地址卡片上写的那个人。

sentences.en: Chen was a quiet man who lived near the river.
sentences.zh: 陈是个安静的人，就住在河边附近。

sentences.en: He had lost the painting when he moved house years ago.
sentences.zh: 多年前搬家时，他把这幅画弄丢了。

sentences.en: When he finally met Mei, tears filled his eyes.
sentences.zh: 当他终于见到梅时，眼里满是泪水。

sentences.en: You gave me back my youth, he said softly.
sentences.zh: “你把我的青春还给了我。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: He wanted to offer Mei a large reward.
sentences.zh: 他想给梅一大笔酬金。

sentences.en: She shook her head at first, feeling shy.
sentences.zh: 她起初摇了摇头，觉得不好意思。

sentences.en: Please take it, Chen said warmly.
sentences.zh: “请收下吧。”陈热情地说。

sentences.en: I know about your family's trouble right now.
sentences.zh: “我知道你家现在的难处。”

sentences.en: This reward matters little to me at this age.
sentences.zh: “到了这把年纪，这点酬金对我来说不算什么。”

sentences.en: But it can change everything for you.
sentences.zh: “但它能改变你的一切。”

sentences.en: Mei finally accepted with tears in her eyes.
sentences.zh: 梅终于含着泪收下了。

sentences.en: With his gift, she was able to order the operation at once.
sentences.zh: 有了他的馈赠，她立刻就能安排手术了。

sentences.en: The hospital set a date for the following week.
sentences.zh: 医院把日期定在了下一周。

sentences.en: The timing is perfect, the doctor said.
sentences.zh: “这个时机再好不过了。”医生说。

sentences.en: At the hospital, the two women held hands and cried.
sentences.zh: 在医院里，母女俩握着手哭了。

sentences.en: I just followed my own heart, Mei whispered.
sentences.zh: “我只是听从了自己的内心。”梅轻声说。

sentences.en: The operation was a great success.
sentences.zh: 手术非常成功。

sentences.en: Soon the patient could walk outside again.
sentences.zh: 很快，病人又能到外面走动了。

sentences.en: They took slow walks in the fresh air together.
sentences.zh: 她们一起在新鲜空气中慢慢散步。

sentences.en: That evening, the family watched a funny movie at home.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，一家人在家里看了一部有趣的电影。

sentences.en: Later that week, they enjoyed a free street performance.
sentences.zh: 那个星期晚些时候，她们还欣赏了一场免费的街头演出。

sentences.en: The band played a slow, lovely piece.
sentences.zh: 乐队演奏了一首舒缓动人的曲子。

sentences.en: Children danced beside the stage.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在舞台旁边跳舞。

sentences.en: Mei felt a deep peace inside her.
sentences.zh: 梅心中感到一种深深的平静。

sentences.en: I am proud of myself at last, she thought.
sentences.zh: 她想：我终于为自己感到骄傲了。

sentences.en: Life felt normal again, and that was enough.
sentences.zh: 生活又恢复了正常，这就足够了。

sentences.en: Time passed, and life brought new changes.
sentences.zh: 时间流逝，生活带来了新的变化。

sentences.en: The museum invited Mei to become a member of its youth club.
sentences.zh: 博物馆邀请梅成为其青年俱乐部的成员。

sentences.en: She agreed without a second thought.
sentences.zh: 她毫不犹豫地答应了。

sentences.en: She also took part in a school talk about honesty.
sentences.zh: 她还参加了学校一场关于诚实的演讲。

sentences.en: Her teacher asked her to write about the personal experience.
sentences.zh: 老师请她写下这段亲身经历。

sentences.en: She filled page after page with her memories.
sentences.zh: 她把记忆写满了一页又一页。

sentences.en: A particular line at the end made everyone smile.
sentences.zh: 结尾处有一句特别的话，让每个人都笑了。

sentences.en: Doing good is natural when the heart is honest.
sentences.zh: “当内心诚实时，行善便是自然而然的事。”

sentences.en: Her classmates called her a model for them all.
sentences.zh: 同学们称她为大家的榜样。

sentences.en: Mei laughed and waved the praise off.
sentences.zh: 梅笑着摆摆手，把赞美推开了。

sentences.en: I am simply a nice, ordinary girl, she said.
sentences.zh: “我只是一个善良的普通女孩。”她说。

sentences.en: These days, Mei studies more than before.
sentences.zh: 如今，梅比以前更加努力学习。

sentences.en: She still cannot decide: nursing or painting?
sentences.zh: 她仍然拿不定主意：学护理，还是学绘画？

sentences.en: Chen has promised to teach her how to pick colors.
sentences.zh: 陈已经答应教她怎样挑选颜色。

sentences.en: She thanks him very much for that kindness.
sentences.zh: 她非常感激他的这份好意。

sentences.en: At some point, she will make her choice.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，她终会做出自己的选择。

sentences.en: Every day she walks out with fresh hope.
sentences.zh: 每天，她都带着崭新的希望走出家门。

sentences.en: And it all began with a small wooden box under a big tree.
sentences.zh: 而这一切，都始于大树下那只小小的木箱。

sentences.en: Lin Mei worked at a small radio station in the north of the country.
sentences.zh: 林梅在国家北部的一家小广播电台工作。

sentences.en: The town sat beside a wide river, and life there moved slowly.
sentences.zh: 小镇坐落在一条宽阔的河边，那里的生活节奏很慢。

sentences.en: Its population was only about ten thousand people.
sentences.zh: 镇上的人口只有大约一万人。

sentences.en: Most families were not rich, and some were quite poor.
sentences.zh: 大多数家庭并不富裕，有些还相当贫穷。

sentences.en: Even then, the station's morning voice was very popular.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，电台的早间节目依然很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Old men listened while drinking tea, and children listened on the road to school.
sentences.zh: 老人们边喝茶边听，孩子们在上学的路上听。

sentences.en: For many years, nobody thought much about the little station at all.
sentences.zh: 多年来，几乎没有人特别在意这家小电台。

sentences.en: One cold morning, the president of the station called everyone into a room.
sentences.zh: 一个寒冷的早晨，台长把所有人叫进了一个房间。

sentences.en: "The city has a new policy," he began in a serious voice.
sentences.zh: “市里出台了一项新政策，”他用严肃的声音开口道。

sentences.en: "It will cut money for public media at the end of the season."
sentences.zh: “这个季度结束时，公共媒体的经费将被削减。”

sentences.en: Everyone went silent, and Lin Mei felt her heart drop.
sentences.zh: 所有人都沉默了，林梅感到心一沉。

sentences.en: "Without that money, we cannot pay the rent or the staff."
sentences.zh: “没有那笔钱，我们付不起房租，也发不出工资。”

sentences.en: "So the station may have to close in three months," he added.
sentences.zh: “所以电台可能在三个月内就要关门了，”他补充道。

sentences.en: Nobody laughed, because the situation was painfully real.
sentences.zh: 没有人笑，因为这个处境真实得令人心痛。

sentences.en: That night, Lin Mei could not sleep at all.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，林梅完全睡不着。

sentences.en: She remembered her first day at the station, five years before.
sentences.zh: 她想起五年前自己第一天来电台的情景。

sentences.en: Since then, the job had become the center of her life.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，这份工作就成了她生活的中心。

sentences.en: Reading the news each morning felt like talking to old friends.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨播读新闻，就像在和老朋友聊天。

sentences.en: The station gave the whole town a sense of family.
sentences.zh: 这家电台给了整个小镇一种家的感觉。

sentences.en: Losing it would be a huge problem for many lonely listeners.
sentences.zh: 失去它，对许多孤独的听众来说将是个大问题。

sentences.en: There had to be a reason strong enough to fight for it.
sentences.zh: 一定有一个足够有力的理由，值得为它奋力一搏。

sentences.en: The next day, Lin Mei went to see the old man in his office.
sentences.zh: 第二天，林梅去办公室见那位老人。

sentences.en: "Sir, I have an idea," Lin Mei said at the door.
sentences.zh: “先生，我有一个主意，”林梅在门口说。

sentences.en: "What if we run a special program about our own town?"
sentences.zh: “我们办一档关于咱们小镇的特别节目怎么样？”

sentences.en: "Every section of the community could take part in it."
sentences.zh: “社区的每个群体都可以参与进来。”

sentences.en: "People could call in and share their true stories on air."
sentences.zh: “大家可以打电话进来，在节目里分享自己的真实故事。”

sentences.en: The old man rubbed his eyes and asked a simple question.
sentences.zh: 老人揉了揉眼睛，问了一个简单的问题。

sentences.en: "Do you really believe stories can save this place?"
sentences.zh: “你真的相信故事能救得了这个地方吗？”

sentences.en: "Probably not alone, sir, but they are a beginning," Lin Mei answered.
sentences.zh: “光靠故事可能不行，先生，但这是一个开始，”林梅回答。

sentences.en: They made a careful plan and set a date for the first show.
sentences.zh: 他们仔细制定了计划，并为第一期节目定了日期。

sentences.en: Lin Mei wrote a warm post online to invite the whole town.
sentences.zh: 林梅在网上发了一条暖心的帖子，邀请全镇的人参与。

sentences.en: She also asked people to send in memories, letters, and songs.
sentences.zh: 她还请大家寄来回忆、信件和歌曲。

sentences.en: The process was much harder than she had hoped at first.
sentences.zh: 整个过程比她起初期望的要艰难得多。

sentences.en: Several days passed, and only three letters arrived.
sentences.zh: 几天过去了，只收到了三封信。

sentences.en: The response rate was low, and her spirit began to fall.
sentences.zh: 回应率很低，她的情绪开始低落。

sentences.en: Still she kept working, saying quietly, "One step at a time."
sentences.zh: 但她仍坚持工作，轻声念着：“一步一步来。”

sentences.en: That little habit gave her the power to continue every day.
sentences.zh: 这个小习惯给了她每天坚持下去的力量。

sentences.en: In the second week, everything suddenly changed.
sentences.zh: 到了第二周，一切忽然改变了。

sentences.en: A fisherman called in with a story about a storm at sea.
sentences.zh: 一位渔民打来电话，讲了一个海上遇到风暴的故事。

sentences.en: A teacher read a gentle poem about the old rock hills.
sentences.zh: 一位教师朗读了一首关于古老岩山的温柔诗篇。

sentences.en: A nurse described her long relationship with a patient of ninety.
sentences.zh: 一位护士讲述了她与一位九十岁病人之间多年的情谊。

sentences.en: A shy boy played a short song on his father's guitar.
sentences.zh: 一个害羞的男孩用父亲的吉他弹了一首短短的歌。

sentences.en: Lin Mei presented each guest with warmth and deep respect.
sentences.zh: 林梅以温暖和深深的敬意介绍每一位来宾。

sentences.en: Slowly, the show became a living record of the town's heart.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，这档节目成了小镇心声的鲜活记录。

sentences.en: Soon the local press printed a long report about it.
sentences.zh: 很快，当地报刊登出了一篇关于它的长篇报道。

sentences.en: A city newspaper called it a project worth protecting.
sentences.zh: 一家城市报纸称它是一个值得保护的项目。

sentences.en: More listeners joined every day, far beyond what anyone expected.
sentences.zh: 每天都有更多听众加入，远远超出所有人的预期。

sentences.en: The audience now covered a wide range of ages and jobs.
sentences.zh: 听众如今涵盖了各个年龄段和各行各业。

sentences.en: Anyone, whatever their age or sex, was welcome to speak.
sentences.zh: 无论年龄和性别，任何人都可以来发声。

sentences.en: A science teacher even gave weekly talks about the night stars.
sentences.zh: 一位科学老师甚至每周来讲夜空中的星星。

sentences.en: The tired old station seemed to wake up and breathe again.
sentences.zh: 这家疲惫的老电台仿佛重新苏醒，再次呼吸。

sentences.en: Then a political reporter came to town with a hard interview.
sentences.zh: 接着，一位时政记者来到镇上，做了一次尖锐的采访。

sentences.en: "Your numbers are up, but can you pay the price of staying open?"
sentences.zh: “你们的收听人数上去了，但你们付得起继续运营的代价吗？”

sentences.en: It was a fair point, because love alone does not pay bills.
sentences.zh: 这话有道理，因为光有热爱付不了账单。

sentences.en: A week later, a private company offered to buy the station.
sentences.zh: 一周后，一家私营公司提出要收购电台。

sentences.en: Their offer promised quick money and security for every worker.
sentences.zh: 他们的报价承诺给每位员工带来快钱和保障。

sentences.en: But their plan would cut local news and put pop music in its place.
sentences.zh: 但他们的计划会砍掉本地新闻，换上流行音乐。

sentences.en: The president found himself in a very difficult position.
sentences.zh: 台长发现自己陷入了非常艰难的境地。

sentences.en: Selling felt safe, yet it would end the station's true role.
sentences.zh: 卖掉电台看似安全，却会终结它真正的使命。

sentences.en: "We shall not sell our voice," he finally told the team.
sentences.zh: “我们绝不出卖自己的声音，”他最终对团队说。

sentences.en: Instead, Lin Mei chose to take a much bigger risk.
sentences.zh: 相反，林梅选择去冒一个更大的险。

sentences.en: She started a campaign to raise the money from listeners themselves.
sentences.zh: 她发起了一场活动，直接向听众们筹款。

sentences.en: The station would provide its service, and the town would own it.
sentences.zh: 电台继续提供服务，而小镇将成为它的主人。

sentences.en: In return, every giver would receive a bright red membership card.
sentences.zh: 作为回报，每位捐助者都会收到一张鲜红色的会员卡。

sentences.en: Money began arriving from shops, farms, and even young children.
sentences.zh: 捐款开始从商铺、农场、甚至小孩子们那里涌来。

sentences.en: Social media carried the story far beyond the valley.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体把这个故事传到了山谷之外的远方。

sentences.en: Day by day, the true potential of the idea became clear.
sentences.zh: 日复一日，这个想法真正的潜力显现了出来。

sentences.en: Within one month, they had reached ninety percent of the goal.
sentences.zh: 不到一个月，他们就达成了目标的百分之九十。

sentences.en: The final day felt like a desperate race against the clock.
sentences.zh: 最后一天，就像一场与时间的殊死赛跑。

sentences.en: They still needed a rather large amount before midnight.
sentences.zh: 午夜之前，他们还差相当大的一笔钱。

sentences.en: Lin Mei stood ready at the microphone from early morning.
sentences.zh: 林梅一大早就在话筒前严阵以待。

sentences.en: "This is our last shot," she told the listening town.
sentences.zh: “这是我们最后一搏，”她对收听的全镇说。

sentences.en: "If we fail today, this voice goes quiet forever."
sentences.zh: “如果今天失败，这个声音将永远沉寂。”

sentences.en: Calls soon came in from every side of the river valley.
sentences.zh: 很快，电话从河谷的四面八方打了进来。

sentences.en: An old sailor gave his savings without a single moment of doubt.
sentences.zh: 一位老水手毫不犹豫地捐出了自己的积蓄。

sentences.en: In the final round of calls, the total passed the goal.
sentences.zh: 在最后一轮来电中，总额超过了目标。

sentences.en: The team cried and hugged in the crowded little studio.
sentences.zh: 团队在拥挤的小直播间里又哭又抱。

sentences.en: The result changed far more than one station's future.
sentences.zh: 这个结果改变的，远不止一家电台的未来。

sentences.en: The city later reviewed its policy toward local media.
sentences.zh: 市里后来重新审查了对本地媒体的政策。

sentences.en: Officials finally saw that community voices should be protected.
sentences.zh: 官员们终于明白，社区的声音应该受到保护。

sentences.en: A recent survey showed listener numbers at an all-time high.
sentences.zh: 最近的一项调查显示，听众人数达到了历史最高。

sentences.en: The station also improved the quality of its daily production.
sentences.zh: 电台还提升了日常制作的质量。

sentences.en: New machines made every voice sound pretty clear and warm.
sentences.zh: 新设备让每个声音听起来都相当清晰而温暖。

sentences.en: For the first time, it was possible to dream about the future.
sentences.zh: 他们第一次有可能去畅想未来。

sentences.en: Lin Mei began to practice hosting bigger shows for the region.
sentences.zh: 林梅开始练习主持面向全地区的更大节目。

sentences.en: A year later, the town looked much the same from outside.
sentences.zh: 一年后，小镇从外表看几乎没有变化。

sentences.en: The water still moved slowly past the quiet gray streets.
sentences.zh: 河水依然缓缓流过安静的灰色街道。

sentences.en: But something inside the community had grown strong and right.
sentences.zh: 但社区内部有某种东西变得坚强而正直。

sentences.en: Neighbors greeted each other by name a little more often.
sentences.zh: 邻里之间更常互相叫着名字打招呼了。

sentences.en: Its broadcasts now reached towns of a similar size nearby.
sentences.zh: 它的节目如今传到了附近规模相近的城镇。

sentences.en: The rest of the story, people liked to say, was still being written.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢说，故事的其余部分还在继续书写。

sentences.en: And every morning, a warm familiar voice opened the day again.
sentences.zh: 而每天清晨，那个温暖而熟悉的声音再次开启新的一天。

sentences.en: This story begins in a small town in the south of China, many years ago.
sentences.zh: 这个故事发生在多年前中国南方的一个小镇上。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin owned a little store on a quiet street near the river.
sentences.zh: 林先生在河边一条安静的街道上开着一家小商店。

sentences.en: He sold rice, tea, and other simple things to his neighbors every day.
sentences.zh: 他每天卖米、茶和其他简单的东西给邻居们。

sentences.en: Each morning, he opened the door early and set a wooden table outside.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他早早开门，在外面摆好一张木桌。

sentences.en: His son, Daniel, always came back after school and helped him in the shop.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子丹尼尔放学后总是回来，在店里帮他的忙。

sentences.en: People in town liked them, because the father and boy were honest and kind.
sentences.zh: 镇上的人都喜欢他们，因为这对父子诚实又善良。

sentences.en: Life was simple for the two of them, but it was not always easy.
sentences.zh: 他们两人的生活很简单，但并不总是轻松。

sentences.en: Daniel had a secret that he never shared with his father.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔有一个从未告诉父亲的秘密。

sentences.en: He loved music more than anything else in the world.
sentences.zh: 他爱音乐胜过世界上的任何东西。

sentences.en: Late at night, he would write a new song in his old notebook.
sentences.zh: 深夜里，他会在旧笔记本上写下一首新歌。

sentences.en: Sometimes he sang very quietly, so nobody in the house could hear him.
sentences.zh: 有时他唱得很轻，家里没有人能听见他。

sentences.en: The sound of his young voice was warm and strong.
sentences.zh: 他年轻的嗓音温暖而有力。

sentences.en: He dreamed of singing on a bright stage in front of a big crowd.
sentences.zh: 他梦想着在明亮的舞台上，面对众多观众歌唱。

sentences.en: But his father had made a very different plan for his future.
sentences.zh: 但他的父亲为他的未来做了完全不同的打算。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin wanted his boy to study business at a good university.
sentences.zh: 林先生希望儿子在一所好大学学习商科。

sentences.en: 'A degree is the first step towards a safe life,' he often said.
sentences.zh: 他常说：“学位是走向安稳生活的第一步。”

sentences.en: 'You must think about money first, not about dreams.'
sentences.zh: “你必须先考虑钱，而不是梦想。”

sentences.en: In his thinking, music was only a game for rich families.
sentences.zh: 在他的想法里，音乐只是有钱人家的游戏。

sentences.en: He himself had worked hard through many long and difficult years.
sentences.zh: 他自己辛辛苦苦地熬过了许多漫长而艰难的岁月。

sentences.en: He paid his tax on time and saved every coin he could.
sentences.zh: 他按时纳税，能省的每一分钱都存起来。

sentences.en: A standard office job, he believed, was much safer than any dream.
sentences.zh: 他相信，一份普通的办公室工作比任何梦想都更安稳。

sentences.en: Daniel did not want to argue, so he kept his secret and remained quiet.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔不想争吵，所以他守着秘密，保持沉默。

sentences.en: Then, one hot summer day, something unexpected happened.
sentences.zh: 后来，在一个炎热的夏日，意想不到的事情发生了。

sentences.en: A singing contest came to their small town for the very first time.
sentences.zh: 一场歌唱比赛第一次来到了他们的小镇。

sentences.en: The title of the contest was 'New Star of the South'.
sentences.zh: 比赛的名字叫“南方新星”。

sentences.en: The winner would receive prize money and professional music training.
sentences.zh: 获胜者将得到奖金和专业的音乐培训。

sentences.en: Daniel read the poster and felt his heart speed up at once.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔看到海报，心跳立刻加快了。

sentences.en: This was the chance he had been waiting for all his life.
sentences.zh: 这正是他一直在等待的机会。

sentences.en: He decided to try, though he was afraid of his father's anger.
sentences.zh: 他决定试一试，尽管他害怕父亲发火。

sentences.en: So he wrote down his name and said nothing at home.
sentences.zh: 于是他偷偷报了名，在家里只字未提。

sentences.en: The contest was held in the hall of the old train station.
sentences.zh: 比赛在老火车站的大厅里举行。

sentences.en: Friendly staff guided the nervous singers to their places.
sentences.zh: 友好的工作人员把紧张的歌手们领到各自的位置。

sentences.en: There were performers of every type and style that evening.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，各种类型、各种风格的表演者都有。

sentences.en: Some sang fast, happy pieces, and others chose slow, sad ones.
sentences.zh: 有些人唱欢快的歌，有些人选了缓慢忧伤的歌。

sentences.en: Daniel had to wait a long while until his turn finally came.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔等了很久，终于轮到他上场。

sentences.en: He stood alone in a small space behind the heavy curtain.
sentences.zh: 他独自站在厚重幕布后的一小块空地上。

sentences.en: His hands were cold, but his heart was full of fire.
sentences.zh: 他的手冰凉，心里却燃着火。

sentences.en: When Daniel walked out, the lights felt super bright on his face.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔走出去时，灯光照在脸上，亮得刺眼。

sentences.en: He looked straight at the crowd and took a deep, slow breath.
sentences.zh: 他直视观众，深深地、缓缓地吸了一口气。

sentences.en: Then he began singing, softly at first.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始唱歌，起初声音很轻。

sentences.en: His voice rose upon the quiet air like a bird over a river.
sentences.zh: 他的歌声在寂静的空气中升起，像河上飞起的一只鸟。

sentences.en: Every specific word he sang came from his true heart.
sentences.zh: 他唱出的每一个字都发自真心。

sentences.en: People stopped talking and simply listened.
sentences.zh: 人们停止了交谈，静静地听着。

sentences.en: When the music ended, the total silence broke into loud cheers.
sentences.zh: 音乐结束时，全场的寂静爆发成热烈的欢呼。

sentences.en: Someone in the back shouted his name again and again.
sentences.zh: 后排有人一遍又一遍地喊着他的名字。

sentences.en: The judges gave him top marks in the final test round.
sentences.zh: 评委们在最后的考核环节给了他最高分。

sentences.en: They announced the results at the end of the night.
sentences.zh: 当晚结束时，他们宣布了结果。

sentences.en: Daniel had won first place.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔赢得了第一名。

sentences.en: A local reporter pushed forward, asking to speak with the new winner.
sentences.zh: 一位当地记者挤上前来，想采访这位新科冠军。

sentences.en: But at that moment, Daniel saw a familiar face in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 但就在那一刻，丹尼尔在人群中看到了一张熟悉的脸。

sentences.en: His father was standing there, near the back door, silent and pale.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲就站在那里，靠近后门，沉默而脸色苍白。

sentences.en: A neighbor had sent him a text about the show an hour before.
sentences.zh: 一小时前，一位邻居给他发了条关于演出的短信。

sentences.en: Daniel's smile froze, and a heavy thought filled his mind.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔的笑容僵住了，一个沉重的念头涌上心头。

sentences.en: That night, father and boy walked home together in silence.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，父子俩一路无言地一起走回家。

sentences.en: 'I am sorry I did not tell you,' Daniel finally said.
sentences.zh: “对不起，我没有告诉你。”丹尼尔终于开口说。

sentences.en: 'I was afraid you would make me give it all up.'
sentences.zh: “我怕你会让我放弃这一切。”

sentences.en: His father was quiet for a long while.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲沉默了很久。

sentences.en: 'I want to understand you, but I am afraid too,' he said at last.
sentences.zh: “我想理解你，可我也害怕。”他终于说道。

sentences.en: 'In our society, music is a hard road for a poor boy.'
sentences.zh: “在我们的社会里，音乐对穷人家的孩子来说是一条艰难的路。”

sentences.en: 'The music trade is not kind to families like ours.'
sentences.zh: “音乐这个行当对我们这样的家庭并不友好。”

sentences.en: 'What sort of future can one little tune give you?'
sentences.zh: “一首小曲子能给你什么样的未来？”

sentences.en: Daniel looked into his father's tired eyes and spoke the truth.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔望着父亲疲惫的眼睛，说出了心里话。

sentences.en: 'I know success is never sure,' he said quietly.
sentences.zh: “我知道成功从来没有保证。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: 'But if I never start, I will regret it forever.'
sentences.zh: “但如果我从不开始，我会后悔一辈子。”

sentences.en: 'Please trust me, just this once.'
sentences.zh: “请相信我，就这一次。”

sentences.en: 'The prize includes lessons under a famous teacher in the city.'
sentences.zh: “奖品包括在城里跟随一位名师学习的课程。”

sentences.en: 'The musicians' union will also support young winners like me.'
sentences.zh: “音乐家工会也会资助像我这样的年轻获奖者。”

sentences.en: 'They even have a system to track each student's progress.'
sentences.zh: “他们还有一套系统来跟踪每个学生的进步。”

sentences.en: His father listened to these words very carefully.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲非常仔细地听着这些话。

sentences.en: For a long moment, the old man said nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 好一会儿，老人一句话也没说。

sentences.en: He remembered his own dreams from those faraway years.
sentences.zh: 他想起了自己在那些遥远岁月里的梦想。

sentences.en: He had given up on music himself, and part of him was still sad about it.
sentences.zh: 他自己当年放弃了音乐，心里至今仍有一丝遗憾。

sentences.en: People should not lock themselves inside old regrets, he decided.
sentences.zh: 他想明白了：人不该把自己锁在过去的遗憾里。

sentences.en: 'All right,' he said slowly. 'You may stay on this road.'
sentences.zh: “好吧，”他缓缓说道，“你可以走这条路。”

sentences.en: 'But you must also finish one term of business classes for me.'
sentences.zh: “但你也要为我读完一学期的商科课程。”

sentences.en: 'Deal!' Daniel laughed. 'Thank you, Father.'
sentences.zh: “成交！”丹尼尔笑了，“谢谢你，爸爸。”

sentences.en: 'Such a big night deserves a bowl of hot noodles,' his father smiled.
sentences.zh: “这么重要的夜晚，值得来一碗热面条。”父亲笑着说。

sentences.en: Soon after, Daniel began his special music lessons in the city.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，丹尼尔开始在城里接受特别的音乐课程。

sentences.en: Today, his first album plays in shops all over the country.
sentences.zh: 今天，他的第一张专辑在全国各地的商店里播放。

sentences.en: Even the state radio played his winning piece last week.
sentences.zh: 就连国家电台上周也播放了他的获奖歌曲。

sentences.en: Tomorrow, he will sing at a big concert in the capital.
sentences.zh: 明天，他将在首都的一场大型音乐会上演唱。

sentences.en: And tonight, his father will close the shop early to watch him on TV.
sentences.zh: 而今晚，他的父亲会早早关店，在电视上看他的演出。

sentences.en: Time, in the end, was the best treatment for their old argument.
sentences.zh: 到头来，时间是治愈他们旧日争执的最好良药。

sentences.en: Daniel now knows how to use his voice to bring people hope.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔如今懂得如何用自己的声音给人们带来希望。

sentences.en: In every interview, he shares the same simple lesson: dreams and family can grow side by side.
sentences.zh: 在每次采访中，他都分享同一个简单的道理：梦想和家庭可以并肩成长。

sentences.en: Lin Hua grew up in a quiet little town in the far west of China.
sentences.zh: 林华在中国西部一个安静的小镇长大。

sentences.en: She was a young woman full of big dreams.
sentences.zh: 她是一个满怀远大梦想的年轻女子。

sentences.en: Her father drove a truck, and her mother sold fruit at the market.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲开卡车，母亲在市场上卖水果。

sentences.en: Every evening she practiced English beside the old stone wall behind her house.
sentences.zh: 每天傍晚，她都在屋后的老石墙边练习英语。

sentences.en: Her voice was soft, but her heart was strong and steady.
sentences.zh: 她的声音很轻柔，内心却坚定而沉稳。

sentences.en: Neighbors often asked why she studied so hard every single day.
sentences.zh: 邻居们常常问她为什么每天都学得这么刻苦。

sentences.en: She told them she wanted to see the wide world one day.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他们，自己总有一天要去看看广阔的世界。

sentences.en: Her deepest wish was to make her parents proud.
sentences.zh: 她最深的心愿就是让父母为她骄傲。

sentences.en: In her final year of high school, a rare chance arrived.
sentences.zh: 高中最后一年，一个难得的机会来了。

sentences.en: A famous academy in London offered scholarships for study abroad.
sentences.zh: 伦敦一所著名的学院提供出国留学的奖学金。

sentences.en: Lin Hua applied in secret, without telling anyone at home.
sentences.zh: 林华偷偷提交了申请，没有告诉家里任何人。

sentences.en: Two months later, a thick letter came, and the answer inside was yes.
sentences.zh: 两个月后，一封厚厚的信寄来了，里面的答案是：录取。

sentences.en: She had beaten hundreds of students to win the place.
sentences.zh: 她击败了数百名学生，赢得了这个名额。

sentences.en: Her parents cried, and the whole town celebrated for days.
sentences.zh: 她的父母哭了，整个小镇庆祝了好几天。

sentences.en: That summer she climbed aboard a plane for the first time in her life.
sentences.zh: 那年夏天，她生平第一次登上了飞机。

sentences.en: She watched the clouds below the window for hours.
sentences.zh: 她盯着窗外下方的云层看了好几个小时。

sentences.en: London felt like a completely different world at first.
sentences.zh: 起初，伦敦就像一个完全不同的世界。

sentences.en: Lin Hua felt very small among the tall buildings and busy streets.
sentences.zh: 在高楼和繁忙的街道之间，林华觉得自己非常渺小。

sentences.en: Her accommodation was a tiny room above an old bakery.
sentences.zh: 她的住处是一家老面包店楼上的小房间。

sentences.en: Every morning she walked twenty minutes to class in the rain.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，她冒着雨步行二十分钟去上课。

sentences.en: Some students laughed at her strong accent during discussions.
sentences.zh: 讨论课上，有些学生嘲笑她浓重的口音。

sentences.en: She had to adjust to new food, new weather, and new rules.
sentences.zh: 她必须适应新的食物、新的天气和新的规则。

sentences.en: When winter came, she missed her mother's hot soup terribly.
sentences.zh: 冬天来临时，她无比想念母亲做的热汤。

sentences.en: Some nights she felt the acute pain of being alone.
sentences.zh: 有些夜晚，孤独带来的剧烈痛楚向她袭来。

sentences.en: Luckily, she met a friend whose family also came from a small village.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，她认识了一位朋友，对方的家人也来自小村庄。

sentences.en: While others slept, the two girls studied late into the night.
sentences.zh: 当别人都睡了的时候，两个女孩还在挑灯夜读。

sentences.en: Yet even in the darkest moments, Lin Hua refused to abandon her dream.
sentences.zh: 然而即使在最黑暗的时刻，林华也拒绝放弃她的梦想。

sentences.en: She wrote a promise on white paper and stuck it above her bed.
sentences.zh: 她在白纸上写下一个承诺，贴在床头上方。

sentences.en: 'I will not give up,' the promise said.
sentences.zh: 那句承诺写着：“我绝不放弃。”

sentences.en: Step by step, she slowly found her own way.
sentences.zh: 一步一步地，她慢慢找到了属于自己的路。

sentences.en: In chemistry class, she learned how acid mixes in water.
sentences.zh: 在化学课上，她学习了酸在水中如何混合。

sentences.en: Her teacher praised the accuracy of her careful lab notes.
sentences.zh: 老师称赞她细致的实验笔记十分精确。

sentences.en: In art class, she studied abstract paintings from various countries.
sentences.zh: 在美术课上，她研究来自各个国家的抽象画。

sentences.en: She also took a course on western history and culture.
sentences.zh: 她还选修了一门西方历史与文化的课程。

sentences.en: The lessons covered the deep causes of each great war.
sentences.zh: 课程讲解了每一场大战的深层原因。

sentences.en: Little by little, she began to acquire true confidence.
sentences.zh: 一点一点地，她开始获得真正的自信。

sentences.en: Her ability improved noticeably every single week.
sentences.zh: 她的能力每星期都有明显的提高。

sentences.en: For her, knowledge was the finest acquisition of all.
sentences.zh: 对她来说，知识是最珍贵的收获。

sentences.en: One spring day, the school announced a big debate activity.
sentences.zh: 一个春日，学校宣布举办一场大型辩论活动。

sentences.en: Students could address serious topics such as abortion, health, and education.
sentences.zh: 学生们可以探讨堕胎、健康、教育等严肃议题。

sentences.en: Each class had to vote for one speaker.
sentences.zh: 每个班级要投票选出一名发言人。

sentences.en: Lin Hua raised her hand, and her classmates chose her at once.
sentences.zh: 林华举起了手，同学们立刻选择了她。

sentences.en: She could not wait to begin preparing her speech.
sentences.zh: 她迫不及待地开始准备演讲。

sentences.en: She checked every fact in the library to keep her argument accurate.
sentences.zh: 她在图书馆核对每一个事实，确保论证准确无误。

sentences.en: On stage, she argued about whether education should be free for everyone.
sentences.zh: 在台上，她就教育是否应该对所有人免费展开论述。

sentences.en: The judges praised every word of her speech and called it a real achievement.
sentences.zh: 评委称赞她演讲中的每一个字，称这是一项真正的成就。

sentences.en: After the debate, she made a short video about English learning every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 辩论赛后，她每个星期天制作一段关于英语学习的短视频。

sentences.en: She shared each lesson via a simple website she built herself.
sentences.zh: 她通过自己搭建的一个简单网站分享每一节课。

sentences.en: 'We learn best through joy,' she often said on camera.
sentences.zh: “我们在快乐中学得最好。”她常在镜头前这样说。

sentences.en: Within a month, thousands of people followed her lessons.
sentences.zh: 不到一个月，就有数千人关注了她的课程。

sentences.en: Fans said her teaching style felt warm and accessible.
sentences.zh: 粉丝们说她的教学风格温暖又易懂。

sentences.en: In her view, a lesson should never feel like heavy weight on the mind.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，一堂课绝不该成为压在心头的沉重负担。

sentences.en: One clip even became an ad, which made her quietly proud.
sentences.zh: 有一段视频甚至被用作广告，这让她暗自骄傲。

sentences.en: Then a famous actress asked to appear in one episode.
sentences.zh: 后来，一位著名女演员请求出演其中一集。

sentences.en: Together they filmed a modern adaptation of an old folk tale.
sentences.zh: 她们一起拍摄了一个古老民间故事的现代改编版。

sentences.en: A kind actor from the drama school played the funny old king.
sentences.zh: 戏剧学院一位和善的男演员扮演了那位滑稽的老国王。

sentences.en: The little film brought even more attention to her channel.
sentences.zh: 这部小短片为她的频道带来了更多关注。

sentences.en: For the first time, she felt that London would truly become home.
sentences.zh: 她第一次感觉到，伦敦真的会成为她的家。

sentences.en: Then, in her second year, trouble arrived without warning.
sentences.zh: 然而，在第二年，麻烦毫无预兆地降临了。

sentences.en: Lin Hua worked part-time for a respected research professor.
sentences.zh: 林华在一位受人尊敬的研究教授手下做兼职。

sentences.en: The professor expected absolute loyalty from everyone on his team.
sentences.zh: 这位教授要求团队里的每个人绝对忠诚。

sentences.en: One evening she noticed something wrong in his final report.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，她发现他的最终报告里有些不对劲。

sentences.en: The actual numbers did not match the printed version at all.
sentences.zh: 实际数据和打印出来的版本完全对不上。

sentences.en: That report was used to ask the government for money.
sentences.zh: 那份报告被用来向政府申请经费。

sentences.en: Changing the data like this was a clear abuse of public trust.
sentences.zh: 这样篡改数据显然是对公众信任的滥用。

sentences.en: She sat alone in the lab and asked herself what she should do.
sentences.zh: 她独自坐在实验室里，问自己该怎么办。

sentences.en: In the absence of strong proof, nobody might believe a student.
sentences.zh: 在缺乏有力证据的情况下，也许没有人会相信一个学生。

sentences.en: For days she could not eat or sleep well.
sentences.zh: 好几天她都吃不好、睡不好。

sentences.en: At last she talked to the professor's wife, a kind older teacher.
sentences.zh: 最后，她去找教授的妻子谈了谈，那是一位和蔼的年长教师。

sentences.en: The gentle woman listened carefully and then spoke softly.
sentences.zh: 这位温和的女士认真听完，然后轻声开口。

sentences.en: 'Ask yourself one question tonight,' she said.
sentences.zh: “今晚问你自己一个问题。”她说。

sentences.en: 'Think about who you truly are.'
sentences.zh: “想一想你到底是什么样的人。”

sentences.en: 'Your heart already knows the answer.'
sentences.zh: “你的心其实早已知道答案。”

sentences.en: That night, Lin Hua decided to tell the truth, whatever the cost.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，林华决定说出真相，无论付出什么代价。

sentences.en: The next morning, she went to the administration with her notebook.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，她带着笔记本去了行政部门。

sentences.en: She showed the officers exactly where the numbers had been changed.
sentences.zh: 她向工作人员准确指出了数据被改动的地方。

sentences.en: After a careful investigation, the professor had to admit his fault.
sentences.zh: 经过仔细调查，教授不得不承认自己的过错。

sentences.en: He made a full admission and lost his research funds.
sentences.zh: 他作了全面的供认，并失去了研究经费。

sentences.en: The school chose to acknowledge her courage in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: 学校选择当众表彰她的勇气。

sentences.en: At first, she found all the praise hard to accept.
sentences.zh: 起初，这些赞扬让她难以接受。

sentences.en: 'Truth has real value,' she answered simply.
sentences.zh: “真相自有其价值。”她简单地回答。

sentences.en: Many students began to see honesty as an active choice.
sentences.zh: 许多学生开始把诚实看作一种主动的选择。

sentences.en: Three years later, Lin Hua finished her studies with high honors.
sentences.zh: 三年后，林华以优异的成绩完成了学业。

sentences.en: She turned down offers to advance in big London companies.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝了在伦敦大公司晋升发展的邀请。

sentences.en: Instead, she flew home first to visit her aging parents.
sentences.zh: 相反，她先飞回家探望年迈的父母。

sentences.en: Then she opened a small school in her old town and planned to adopt fresh teaching methods.
sentences.zh: 然后她在家乡小镇开了一所小学校，打算采用全新的教学方法。

sentences.en: Her bright classrooms had adequate light and rows of clean desks.
sentences.zh: 她明亮的教室里有充足的光线和一排排干净的课桌。

sentences.en: She welcomed every child, and every curious adult too.
sentences.zh: 她欢迎每一个孩子，也欢迎每一位好学的成年人。

sentences.en: Her dream was easy to say but hard to accomplish, and she kept working at it.
sentences.zh: 她的梦想说来简单，实现却难，而她一直在为之努力。

sentences.en: She told her students that anyone could achieve great things, and looking back, she knew every hard day had been worth it.
sentences.zh: 她告诉学生们，任何人都能取得伟大的成就；回望过去，她知道每一个艰难的日子都是值得的。

sentences.en: Mei worked as an assistant at a small travel agency in the busy city center.
sentences.zh: 小梅在繁华市中心的一家小型旅行社里当助理。

sentences.en: The company was called Blue Arrow, and its office sat inside an old apartment building.
sentences.zh: 这家公司名叫“蓝箭”，办公室设在一栋老公寓楼里。

sentences.en: The rooms were plain and simple, but the atmosphere there was always warm.
sentences.zh: 房间朴素简单，但那里的氛围总是很温暖。

sentences.en: Her boss, Mr. Long, had worked in the travel business for approximately thirty years.
sentences.zh: 她的老板龙先生在旅游行业工作了大约三十年。

sentences.en: He knew Asia well, and he had led tours in almost every Asian country.
sentences.zh: 他非常了解亚洲，几乎在每个亚洲国家都带过团。

sentences.en: People said he could plan a good trip to anywhere in the world.
sentences.zh: 人们说，他能规划一场通往世界任何地方的美好旅行。

sentences.en: Mei loved her job, though in many ways she was still an amateur.
sentences.zh: 小梅热爱自己的工作，尽管在很多方面她还只是个新手。

sentences.en: Every morning she ate a red apple at her desk and read the travel news.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，她都在办公桌前吃一个红苹果，读旅游新闻。

sentences.en: One Monday morning, Mr. Long called the whole team together to announce some big news.
sentences.zh: 一个周一的早晨，龙先生把整个团队召集起来，宣布一个重大消息。

sentences.en: "This year is our company's twentieth anniversary," he said with a proud smile.
sentences.zh: “今年是我们公司成立二十周年，”他带着自豪的微笑说。

sentences.en: "To celebrate it, our annual project will be something truly special."
sentences.zh: “为了庆祝，我们今年的年度项目会非常特别。”

sentences.en: He wanted to arrange a grand adventure tour for their oldest and best clients.
sentences.zh: 他想为最资深、最重要的客户安排一次盛大的冒险之旅。

sentences.en: The route would begin in the Arctic and then cross the Atlantic Ocean by ship.
sentences.zh: 这条线路将从北极出发，然后乘船横渡大西洋。

sentences.en: The final stop would be a green valley in the east of Africa.
sentences.zh: 最后一站是非洲东部的一片绿色山谷。

sentences.en: For the last part, the guests would travel in a small aircraft.
sentences.zh: 最后一段旅程，客人们将乘坐一架小型飞机。

sentences.en: The plan sounded exciting, but it also made Mei feel a little anxious.
