sentences.zh: 计划听起来令人兴奋，但也让小梅有些紧张。

sentences.en: The next afternoon, the team sat down together to build a full agenda.
sentences.zh: 第二天下午，团队坐在一起制定完整的日程安排。

sentences.en: Mei's aim was to make every single day of the trip smooth and safe.
sentences.zh: 小梅的目标是让旅程中的每一天都顺利而安全。

sentences.en: She called an airline to book seats and studied the airport rules carefully.
sentences.zh: 她打电话给一家航空公司订座位，并仔细研究机场的规定。

sentences.en: She also looked at every hotel from a different angle before choosing it.
sentences.zh: 在选定每家酒店之前，她还会从不同角度加以考量。

sentences.en: One hotel had a beautiful stone arch and fine old architecture.
sentences.zh: 有一家酒店有一座漂亮的石拱门和精美的老式建筑。

sentences.en: Another one offered farm visits, because the region was famous for its agriculture.
sentences.zh: 另一家提供农场参观，因为那个地区以农业闻名。

sentences.en: Local families would show the guests their agricultural work and their farm animals.
sentences.zh: 当地家庭会向客人展示他们的农活和农场里的动物。

sentences.en: Mr. Long read her plan slowly and said, "This trip has real appeal."
sentences.zh: 龙先生慢慢读完她的计划，说：“这趟旅行真有吸引力。”

sentences.en: Their most important client was Daniel, a famous athlete from Canada.
sentences.zh: 他们最重要的客户是丹尼尔，一位来自加拿大的著名运动员。

sentences.en: He was tall and athletic, and he trained hard almost every single day.
sentences.zh: 他身材高大、体格健壮，几乎每天都刻苦训练。

sentences.en: He believed a real rest could give him an advantage in the next season.
sentences.zh: 他相信好好休息能让他在下个赛季占得优势。

sentences.en: Another guest was an artist who hoped to paint the northern lights.
sentences.zh: 另一位客人是一位艺术家，希望能画下北极光。

sentences.en: A retired ambassador and his kind wife also joined the small group.
sentences.zh: 一位退休大使和他和善的妻子也加入了这个小团队。

sentences.en: The old man was a strong advocate of slow and careful travel.
sentences.zh: 这位老人极力主张慢节奏、细致的旅行方式。

sentences.en: His advice was simple: watch more, listen more, and never hurry.
sentences.zh: 他的建议很简单：多看，多听，永远不要匆忙。

sentences.en: Mei wrote down every request and made a careful arrangement for each guest.
sentences.zh: 小梅记下每一个要求，为每位客人做了周到的安排。

sentences.en: Before the trip could start, there was a mountain of office work to finish.
sentences.zh: 旅行开始之前，还有堆积如山的办公室工作要完成。

sentences.en: Mei filled in a visa application for every traveler in the group.
sentences.zh: 小梅为团里的每位旅客填写了签证申请表。

sentences.en: She also had to apply for special permits for the northern ship.
sentences.zh: 她还得为北方的那艘船申请特别许可证。

sentences.en: She booked an appointment at the embassy for early Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 她预约了周二一早去大使馆办事。

sentences.en: After that, a safety officer came to assess the whole travel plan.
sentences.zh: 之后，一位安全官员前来评估整个旅行计划。

sentences.en: His assessment took two full days, and his analysis was very detailed.
sentences.zh: 他的评估花了整整两天，分析得非常细致。

sentences.en: In the end, he gave his approval, and the whole office cheered.
sentences.zh: 最后他给予批准，整个办公室都欢呼起来。

sentences.en: "I approve of every aspect of this route," he told them kindly.
sentences.zh: “这条线路的每个方面我都认可，”他和气地对他们说。

sentences.en: On the day of departure, the group met at the gate very early.
sentences.zh: 出发那天，大家一大早就在登机口集合了。

sentences.en: Their arrival in the far north went smoothly, and the sky was clear.
sentences.zh: 他们顺利抵达遥远的北方，天空晴朗。

sentences.en: The ship was strong, with a heavy anchor and walls of light aluminum.
sentences.zh: 那艘船很结实，有沉重的锚和轻质铝制的船壁。

sentences.en: The travelers stood on the deck, and the cold air made them feel alive.
sentences.zh: 旅客们站在甲板上，寒冷的空气让他们感到充满活力。

sentences.en: Mei walked alongside Daniel and patiently answered his many questions.
sentences.zh: 小梅走在丹尼尔身边，耐心地回答他的许多问题。

sentences.en: Late that night, however, a loud alarm suddenly woke everyone up.
sentences.zh: 然而深夜里，一阵刺耳的警报突然把所有人吵醒。

sentences.en: Nobody could stay asleep after such a frightening sound.
sentences.zh: 听到这么吓人的声音，谁也无法继续睡觉。

sentences.en: Smoke rose from the kitchen, and soft gray ash covered the floor.
sentences.zh: 厨房里冒出浓烟，细细的灰烬落满了地板。

sentences.en: It was apparent that a small fire had started near the old stove.
sentences.zh: 很明显，旧炉子附近起了一场小火。

sentences.en: The fire was soon put out, but the trouble of that night was not over.
sentences.zh: 火很快被扑灭了，但那晚的麻烦还没有结束。

sentences.en: Mr. Long held his chest and could not lift his left arm.
sentences.zh: 龙先生捂着胸口，左臂抬不起来。

sentences.en: Mei was afraid, but she stayed calm and called for help at once.
sentences.zh: 小梅很害怕，但她保持镇定，立刻求救。

sentences.en: When the ship reached the port, an ambulance was already waiting there.
sentences.zh: 船靠岸时，一辆救护车已经在那里等候。

sentences.en: The doctors gave him quick aid and said he must rest for two weeks.
sentences.zh: 医生们迅速对他进行了救助，并说他必须休息两周。

sentences.en: "Does anybody here know the full plan?" one worried guest asked.
sentences.zh: “这里有谁了解完整的计划吗？”一位担心的客人问道。

sentences.en: "I do," Mei said quietly, "and anyway, the trip must go on."
sentences.zh: “我了解，”小梅轻声说，“无论如何，旅行必须继续。”

sentences.en: Afterwards, she took charge of the whole affair by herself.
sentences.zh: 此后，她独自挑起了整件事情的担子。

sentences.en: Not everyone on the ship was happy with this sudden change.
sentences.zh: 船上并不是每个人都对这个突然的变化感到满意。

sentences.en: Daniel's agent, a loud man named Rick, became aggressive at once.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔的经纪人里克嗓门很大，立刻变得咄咄逼人。

sentences.en: "You are just a young office girl!" he shouted in open anger.
sentences.zh: “你不过是个年轻的办公室小姑娘！”他愤怒地大喊。

sentences.en: His angry words started a long argument on the cold deck.
sentences.zh: 他愤怒的话在冰冷的甲板上引发了一场长时间的争吵。

sentences.en: "Do not assume that I cannot lead this group," Mei answered firmly.
sentences.zh: “不要以为我带不了这个团，”小梅坚定地回答。

sentences.en: "Your assumption is wrong, and I will prove it to you."
sentences.zh: “你的假设是错的，我会证明给你看。”

sentences.en: The old diplomat stepped forward to argue on her side.
sentences.zh: 那位老外交官站出来为她辩护。

sentences.en: For a moment, the whole group seemed ready to fall apart.
sentences.zh: 有那么一刻，整个团队似乎快要分崩离析。

sentences.en: In the end, Rick stepped aside, still shaking his head slowly.
sentences.zh: 最后，里克退到一旁，仍在缓缓摇头。

sentences.en: Mei quickly changed the plan and found a smart alternative route.
sentences.zh: 小梅迅速修改计划，找到了一条聪明的替代路线。

sentences.en: A friendly African pilot agreed to fly them south over the water.
sentences.zh: 一位友好的非洲飞行员答应载他们向南飞越海面。

sentences.en: Altogether, the new route saved the group two full days of travel.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，新路线为团队节省了整整两天的行程。

sentences.en: Because of this, they could afford one extra night in the valley.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们负担得起在山谷里多住一晚。

sentences.en: Best of all, the change did not affect the main events at all.
sentences.zh: 最棒的是，这次调整完全没有影响主要活动。

sentences.en: When they finally arrived, warm rain was falling on the green hills.
sentences.zh: 他们终于抵达时，温暖的雨正落在青翠的山丘上。

sentences.en: The guests, young and old alike, laughed and danced like happy children.
sentences.zh: 客人们不论老少，都像快乐的孩子一样又笑又跳。

sentences.en: Nobody wanted alcohol that night; sweet local tea felt much better.
sentences.zh: 那晚没人想喝酒，香甜的当地茶让人感觉好多了。

sentences.en: There was one last surprise waiting for them on the final morning.
sentences.zh: 最后一天早晨，还有一个意外在等着他们。

sentences.en: Local police officers came to arrest a strange man at the hotel.
sentences.zh: 当地警察来到酒店，逮捕了一个可疑的男人。

sentences.en: The man had changed his appearance and sold fake tours to visitors.
sentences.zh: 那人改变了自己的外貌，向游客兜售假冒的旅行团。

sentences.en: He was a former associate of Rick's company, which shocked everyone there.
sentences.zh: 他曾是里克公司的合伙人，这让在场的所有人都很震惊。

sentences.en: Rick looked ashamed, and he had to admit that Mei had protected them all.
sentences.zh: 里克面露羞愧，不得不承认是小梅保护了大家。

sentences.en: He walked over to apologize to her in front of the whole group.
sentences.zh: 他走过去，当着全团的面向她道歉。

sentences.en: "I accept your apology," Mei said. "Now let us enjoy our last day."
sentences.zh: “我接受你的道歉，”小梅说，“现在让我们好好享受最后一天吧。”

sentences.en: From that morning on, Rick began to appear much friendlier to everyone.
sentences.zh: 从那天早上起，里克对每个人都显得友善多了。

sentences.en: On the last evening, the group held a small party under the bright stars.
sentences.zh: 最后一个晚上，大家在璀璨的星空下举办了一场小型聚会。

sentences.en: Daniel stood up to advise everyone to travel with Mei again next year.
sentences.zh: 丹尼尔站起来，建议大家明年再跟小梅一起旅行。

sentences.en: "I truly appreciate her hard work and her brave heart," he said warmly.
sentences.zh: “我由衷感激她的辛勤付出和勇敢的心，”他热情地说。

sentences.en: The guests showed their appreciation with a long and loud cheer.
sentences.zh: 客人们用长久而响亮的欢呼表达了谢意。

sentences.en: Everyone could agree on one thing: this young woman had saved the trip.
sentences.zh: 所有人都一致认同：这位年轻女士拯救了这次旅行。

sentences.en: Back home, Mr. Long was healthy again and full of quiet pride.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，龙先生已恢复健康，心中满是欣慰与骄傲。

sentences.en: He offered Mei a new agreement and a much better job title.
sentences.zh: 他给了小梅一份新合同和一个更高的职位。

sentences.en: "You did not just assist us on this trip; you led us," he said.
sentences.zh: “这次旅行你不只是在协助我们，你是在带领我们，”他说。

sentences.en: "Your assistance was quick, and your calm manner was appropriate at every hard moment."
sentences.zh: “你的帮助来得及时，你的沉着在每个艰难时刻都恰到好处。”

sentences.en: Mei smiled at the window; her little desk now felt like the start of a much bigger journey.
sentences.zh: 小梅望着窗外微笑；她的小办公桌如今仿佛成了一段更宏大旅程的起点。

articles.title: The Bell by the Bay
articles.topic_en: The Harvest Festival by the Bay

sentences.en: Last autumn, Lily traveled alone to a small town on the quiet bay.
sentences.zh: 去年秋天，莉莉独自来到宁静海湾边的一座小镇。

sentences.en: She had come to spend two weeks with her aunt Rosa.
sentences.zh: 她来这里和姑妈罗莎一起住两个星期。

sentences.en: Rosa met her at the station, carrying a heavy bag of red apples.
sentences.zh: 罗莎在车站接她，手里提着一大袋红苹果。

sentences.en: "You arrived just in time to attend our harvest festival," Rosa said happily.
sentences.zh: “你来得正好，可以参加我们的丰收节。”罗莎高兴地说。

sentences.en: Her warm attitude made Lily smile for the first time in weeks.
sentences.zh: 她热情的态度让莉莉几周以来第一次露出了笑容。

sentences.en: The festival was the biggest attraction of the town every year.
sentences.zh: 这个节日是小镇每年最大的亮点。

sentences.en: It could attract hundreds of visitors from far beyond the hills.
sentences.zh: 它能吸引数百名来自远方山那边的游客。

sentences.en: That night, Lily lay awake, feeling excited about the days ahead.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，莉莉兴奋得睡不着，期待着接下来的日子。

sentences.en: The next morning, they walked down the main avenue toward the beach.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，她们沿着主街走向海滩。

sentences.en: Colorful booths stood in a long line beside the shining water.
sentences.zh: 五颜六色的摊位沿着闪亮的水边排成一长排。

sentences.en: An old bell rang softly from the white church on the corner.
sentences.zh: 街角白色教堂里传来古老钟声，轻轻回响。

sentences.en: A famous author with a gray beard was signing books at one table.
sentences.zh: 一位留着灰白胡子的著名作家正在一张桌前签名售书。

sentences.en: He told the small audience funny stories about the town's past.
sentences.zh: 他给一小群听众讲着小镇过去的趣事。

sentences.en: Lily bought an authentic wooden bird carved by a local artist.
sentences.zh: 莉莉买了一只本地艺术家雕刻的正宗木鸟。

sentences.en: Everywhere she looked, people were laughing, and nobody seemed bored.
sentences.zh: 放眼望去，人们都在欢笑，没有人显得无聊。

sentences.en: "Nothing in this town is ever boring," Rosa said proudly.
sentences.zh: “在这个镇上，什么都不会让人觉得乏味。”罗莎骄傲地说。

sentences.en: But at noon, bad news dropped on the town like a bomb.
sentences.zh: 然而中午时分，一个坏消息像炸弹一样落在小镇上。

sentences.en: A health officer said he had found dangerous bacteria in the old water basin.
sentences.zh: 一位卫生官员说，他在旧蓄水池里发现了危险的细菌。

sentences.en: He spoke on behalf of the city authority, holding a thick report.
sentences.zh: 他代表市政当局发言，手里拿着厚厚的一份报告。

sentences.en: "We may have to ban the festival this year," he announced coldly.
sentences.zh: “今年我们可能不得不禁止举办这个节日。”他冷冷地宣布。

sentences.en: The words tasted bitter, like the first shot of a long battle.
sentences.zh: 这些话听起来苦涩，就像一场持久战的第一枪。

sentences.en: Some angry people started to blame the food sellers for everything.
sentences.zh: 一些愤怒的人开始把一切都怪罪到食品摊主头上。

sentences.en: Rosa stood up and refused to accept such unfair behavior.
sentences.zh: 罗莎站起来，拒绝接受这种不公平的做法。

sentences.en: "This festival does not belong to the city; it belongs to us," she said.
sentences.zh: “这个节日不属于市政府，它属于我们。”她说。

sentences.en: That evening, Lily could not bear the heavy silence in the house.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，莉莉无法忍受屋子里沉重的寂静。

sentences.en: Unable to rest in her bedroom, she went down to the basement.
sentences.zh: 她在卧室里待不住，于是下到了地下室。

sentences.en: She hoped the town's background might hold something useful.
sentences.zh: 她希望小镇的历史背景里能藏着有用的东西。

sentences.en: Beneath a dusty blanket, she found a box of yellow papers.
sentences.zh: 在一条落满灰尘的毯子下面，她发现了一箱发黄的文件。

sentences.en: The oldest pages described the birth of the festival a hundred years ago.
sentences.zh: 最古老的几页记录了一百年前这个节日的诞生。

sentences.en: Long ago, a kind bishop had opened the very first harvest fair.
sentences.zh: 很久以前，一位善良的主教主持了第一届丰收集市。

sentences.en: He had asked heaven to bless the town and its clean mountain spring.
sentences.zh: 他祈求上天保佑这座小镇和它清澈的山泉。

sentences.en: That spring, not the dirty pool, was the true basis of the water supply.
sentences.zh: 那眼山泉，而不是那个脏水池，才是供水的真正来源。

sentences.en: At breakfast the next day, Lily spread the papers across the table.
sentences.zh: 第二天早餐时，莉莉把文件摊在桌子上。

sentences.en: Rosa was frying bacon and eggs when she started to read.
sentences.zh: 罗莎正在煎培根和鸡蛋，随手开始读了起来。

sentences.en: She was so surprised that she dropped a banana from the fruit basket.
sentences.zh: 她惊讶得把一根香蕉从果篮里碰掉了。

sentences.en: "This is awesome news, my dear!" she shouted with joy.
sentences.zh: “亲爱的，这真是天大的好消息！”她高兴地喊道。

sentences.en: "We must make that officer aware of the real truth," Lily said.
sentences.zh: “我们必须让那位官员了解真相。”莉莉说。

sentences.en: Rosa quickly called her friend Ben, a biology teacher, to assist them.
sentences.zh: 罗莎立刻打电话请她的朋友、生物老师本来帮忙。

sentences.en: Ben promised that a basic water test could prove everything clearly.
sentences.zh: 本保证，一个基础的水质检测就能把一切证明清楚。

sentences.en: An hour later, Ben arrived on his bike with a testing machine.
sentences.zh: 一小时后，本骑着自行车带着检测仪来了。

sentences.en: The machine was automatic, but its battery was completely dead.
sentences.zh: 这台机器是全自动的，可是电池完全没电了。

sentences.en: Lily offered to run to the store at the far end of town.
sentences.zh: 莉莉主动提出跑去镇子另一头的商店买电池。

sentences.en: On the way, a fallen tree seemed to block the narrow road.
sentences.zh: 半路上，一棵倒下的树把狭窄的路挡住了。

sentences.en: She had to bend low and climb over a wooden barrier.
sentences.zh: 她只好弯下腰，翻过一道木栅栏。

sentences.en: Then she jumped sideways to avoid a deep hole in the path.
sentences.zh: 接着她侧身一跳，避开了路上一个深坑。

sentences.en: An angry bee buzzed around her head, and she almost lost her balance.
sentences.zh: 一只愤怒的蜜蜂在她头边嗡嗡打转，她差点失去平衡。

sentences.en: Her boots were muddy when she crossed the border of the last field, but she made it back in time.
sentences.zh: 当她穿过最后一块田地的边界时，靴子沾满了泥，但她及时赶了回来。

sentences.en: By sunset, the results were clear: the spring water was perfectly safe.
sentences.zh: 到日落时，结果一目了然：泉水完全安全。

sentences.en: Only the old, unused pool showed anything awful at all.
sentences.zh: 只有那个废弃的旧水池才检出了糟糕的东西。

sentences.en: The next afternoon, the town held a meeting at the baseball field.
sentences.zh: 第二天下午，镇上在棒球场举行了大会。

sentences.en: People filled every bench and even sat on the bare grass.
sentences.zh: 人们坐满了每条长凳，甚至坐在光秃秃的草地上。

sentences.en: A young boy leaned on his bat and listened with wide eyes.
sentences.zh: 一个小男孩倚着球棒，睁大眼睛听着。

sentences.en: Lily stood up, feeling awkward in front of so many faces.
sentences.zh: 莉莉站起来，面对这么多面孔，感到很不自在。

sentences.en: For one terrible moment, her mind went completely blank.
sentences.zh: 有那么可怕的一瞬间，她的脑子一片空白。

sentences.en: Then she took a deep breath and let her story begin.
sentences.zh: 然后她深吸一口气，开始讲述她的故事。

sentences.en: She showed the old papers and read out the fresh test results.
sentences.zh: 她展示了那些旧文件，并宣读了最新的检测结果。

sentences.en: "This festival is beneficial for us all; every shop and family gets a real benefit," she said.
sentences.zh: “这个节日对我们所有人都有好处；每家商铺和每个家庭都能得到实实在在的收益。”她说。

sentences.en: "Besides, it keeps our oldest belief alive," she added softly.
sentences.zh: “而且，它让我们最古老的信念得以延续。”她轻声补充道。

sentences.en: "We were blind to our own history," an old farmer said quietly.
sentences.zh: “我们竟然对自己的历史视而不见。”一位老农轻声说。

sentences.en: The officer rubbed his round belly, looked at the numbers, and slowly nodded.
sentences.zh: 那位官员摸着圆圆的肚子，看着数据，慢慢点了点头。

sentences.en: "I only ask that everyone behave carefully near the spring," he said at last.
sentences.zh: “我只要求大家在泉水附近谨慎行事。”他最后说。

sentences.en: Rosa promised that responsible behaviour would keep the water clean forever.
sentences.zh: 罗莎承诺，大家会用负责任的行为让泉水永远保持干净。

sentences.en: A great cheer seemed to blow down the street like a warm wind.
sentences.zh: 一阵欢呼声像暖风一样吹过街道。

sentences.en: Two days later, the festival opened again in all its beauty.
sentences.zh: 两天后，节日重新开幕，美丽如初。

sentences.en: Visitors ate hot beef sandwiches and drank cold beer under the trees.
sentences.zh: 游客们在树下吃着热牛肉三明治，喝着冰啤酒。

sentences.en: Children played basketball on the corner near the little juice bar.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在小果汁吧旁的街角打篮球。

sentences.en: A small boat carried happy families across the shining water.
sentences.zh: 一条小船载着快乐的家庭驶过闪亮的水面。

sentences.en: Business started to boom for every seller along the street.
sentences.zh: 街上每个摊主的生意都开始红火起来。

sentences.en: The mayor even gave Rosa an award for the most attractive pie stand.
sentences.zh: 镇长还给罗莎颁了一个奖，表彰她的派摊最吸引人。

sentences.en: At the charity table, a kind stranger made a surprising bid for her biggest pie.
sentences.zh: 在义卖桌前，一位好心的陌生人为她最大的派出了一个惊人的价钱。

sentences.en: He even added a bonus to help repair the old church roof.
sentences.zh: 他还额外多付了一笔钱，帮忙修缮教堂的旧屋顶。

sentences.en: That very evening happened to be Rosa's sixtieth birthday.
sentences.zh: 恰好那天晚上是罗莎六十岁的生日。

sentences.en: Lily gave her a soft leather belt and a card full of thanks.
sentences.zh: 莉莉送给她一条柔软的皮革腰带和一张写满感谢的卡片。

sentences.en: Rosa took a big bite of her own pie and laughed until she cried.
sentences.zh: 罗莎大大地咬了一口自己做的派，笑得流出了眼泪。

sentences.en: "I feel young down to my bones tonight," she said.
sentences.zh: “今晚我觉得自己从骨子里都年轻了。”她说。

sentences.en: Later, Lily took a long warm bath and thought about the week.
sentences.zh: 晚些时候，莉莉泡了个长长的热水澡，回想着这一周。

sentences.en: Through the small bathroom window, she could hear music from the shore.
sentences.zh: 透过浴室的小窗，她能听到岸边传来的音乐。

sentences.en: One honest attempt, she thought, can truly change everything.
sentences.zh: 她想，一次真诚的尝试，真的可以改变一切。

sentences.en: Nobody had needed to beg; they had simply shown the truth.
sentences.zh: 没有人需要去哀求，他们只是把真相摆了出来。

sentences.en: On her last morning, Lily climbed the hill and took a few steps backwards to hold the view longer.
sentences.zh: 离开的那个早晨，莉莉爬上山坡，倒退着走了几步，想把这景色多留一会儿。

sentences.en: Below her, the calm water lay like a great sleeping beast.
sentences.zh: 在她脚下，平静的水面像一头沉睡的巨兽。

sentences.en: She felt a deep bond with Rosa and with the little town.
sentences.zh: 她感到自己与罗莎、与这座小镇之间有了深厚的情感纽带。

sentences.en: "Come back next year, my dear!" Rosa called from the gate.
sentences.zh: “亲爱的，明年一定要回来！”罗莎在门口喊道。

sentences.en: Lily waved and promised that she would.
sentences.zh: 莉莉挥了挥手，答应她一定会回来。

sentences.en: Some places, she thought, hold your heart long after you leave them.
sentences.zh: 她想，有些地方，在你离开很久之后，仍然牵着你的心。

sentences.en: Lin worked in a small bakery in the centre of town.
sentences.zh: 林在镇中心的一家小面包店工作。

sentences.en: Every morning he baked fresh bread for people's breakfast.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，他为人们的早餐烤制新鲜面包。

sentences.en: He spread butter on warm rolls and sold them cheap.
sentences.zh: 他在温热的面包卷上抹上黄油，卖得很便宜。

sentences.en: His boss, Mrs. Chen, was always busy but very kind.
sentences.zh: 他的老板陈太太总是很忙，但心地非常善良。

sentences.en: As a boy, Lin first learned cooking at a summer camp.
sentences.zh: 小时候，林是在一次夏令营里第一次学会做饭的。

sentences.en: Since childhood, he had dreamed of becoming a famous chef.
sentences.zh: 从童年起，他就梦想成为一名著名的厨师。

sentences.en: He hoped to build his own brand of cakes one day.
sentences.zh: 他希望有一天能创立自己的蛋糕品牌。

sentences.en: But dreams need money, and he had very little cash.
sentences.zh: 可是梦想需要钱，而他手头的现金少得可怜。

sentences.en: One rainy Monday, a letter carrier brought a special letter to the shop.
sentences.zh: 一个下雨的星期一，一位邮递员给店里送来了一封特别的信。

sentences.en: A television channel planned to broadcast a big baking contest.
sentences.zh: 一家电视频道计划直播一场大型烘焙比赛。

sentences.en: The show would take place in an old castle by the river.
sentences.zh: 节目将在河边一座古老的城堡里举行。

sentences.en: Each candidate had to bake a cake for a real wedding.
sentences.zh: 每位参赛者都要为一场真正的婚礼烤一个蛋糕。

sentences.en: The bride herself would taste every one and help the judges.
sentences.zh: 新娘本人会品尝每一个蛋糕，并协助评委打分。

sentences.en: Lin thought about his mother, who was fighting cancer at home.
sentences.zh: 林想起了正在家中与癌症抗争的母亲。

sentences.en: Her medicine cost more than he could ever earn at the shop.
sentences.zh: 她的药费远远超过他在店里能挣到的钱。

sentences.en: Mrs. Chen said, 'You should choose to enter, Lin.'
sentences.zh: 陈太太说：“林，你应该选择去参赛。”

sentences.en: 'It will be a hard challenge, but you are brilliant.'
sentences.zh: “这会是一场艰难的挑战，但你才华出众。”

sentences.en: Lin felt afraid, yet he wanted to be brave for his mother.
sentences.zh: 林心里害怕，但为了母亲，他想勇敢一次。

sentences.en: They had a long chat about the plan that evening.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他们就这个计划聊了很久。

sentences.en: At last, he signed his name at the bottom of the form.
sentences.zh: 最后，他在表格的底部签下了自己的名字。

sentences.en: The next week, Lin took an early bus into the hills.
sentences.zh: 第二个星期，林坐上早班公交车前往山区。

sentences.en: The road crossed a stone bridge over a quiet river.
sentences.zh: 公路跨过一座石桥，桥下是一条安静的河。

sentences.en: He saw cattle eating grass in the broad green fields.
sentences.zh: 他看见牛群在宽阔的绿色田野上吃草。

sentences.en: A lazy cat slept under a bush near the road.
sentences.zh: 一只慵懒的猫睡在路边的灌木丛下。

sentences.en: The wind moved every branch of the tall trees.
sentences.zh: 风吹动着高大树木的每一根树枝。

sentences.en: The castle stood on a hill above a dark cave.
sentences.zh: 城堡矗立在山丘上，山下有一个幽深的洞穴。

sentences.en: Lin wore his white cap and carried his tools in an old bag.
sentences.zh: 林戴着白色的帽子，用一个旧包背着他的工具。

sentences.en: He was careful with his knives and tried to stay calm.
sentences.zh: 他小心地保管着刀具，努力让自己保持平静。

sentences.en: The castle walls were built of heavy grey brick.
sentences.zh: 城堡的墙壁是用厚重的灰砖砌成的。

sentences.en: Inside, the great hall had a painted ceiling and a red carpet.
sentences.zh: 在城堡里，大厅有彩绘的天花板和红色的地毯。

sentences.en: Bright lights hung above every table and chair.
sentences.zh: 明亮的灯光悬挂在每张桌子和椅子上方。

sentences.en: A small bird sang in a golden cage by the window.
sentences.zh: 窗边金色的笼子里，一只小鸟在歌唱。

sentences.en: Cameras stood in each corner, ready to film everything.
sentences.zh: 每个角落都架着摄像机，准备拍下这里的一切。

sentences.en: The chairman of the contest gave a brief welcome speech.
sentences.zh: 比赛的主席作了简短的欢迎致辞。

sentences.en: He asked all the bakers to bow to the judges.
sentences.zh: 他请所有面点师向评委们鞠躬。

sentences.en: 'There is only one category today: wedding cakes,' he said.
sentences.zh: 他说：“今天只有一个类别——婚礼蛋糕。”

sentences.en: 'The champion will win a certificate and ten thousand dollars.'
sentences.zh: “冠军将获得一张证书和一万美元奖金。”

sentences.en: Lin's main rival was a tall man named Max.
sentences.zh: 林最主要的对手是一个名叫马克斯的高个子男人。

sentences.en: Max had done boxing and bowling before he became a baker.
sentences.zh: 马克斯在成为面点师之前，练过拳击，也打过保龄球。

sentences.en: His chest was wide, and he wore casual clothes.
sentences.zh: 他胸膛宽阔，穿着一身休闲装。

sentences.en: He walked around like the captain of the whole room.
sentences.zh: 他在屋里走来走去，好像自己是全场的队长。

sentences.en: 'This prize is already mine,' Max said loudly.
sentences.zh: “这个奖已经是我的了。”马克斯大声说。

sentences.en: He told rude jokes to bother the other bakers.
sentences.zh: 他讲一些无礼的笑话来打扰其他选手。

sentences.en: Lin only took a deep breath and said nothing.
sentences.zh: 林只是深吸了一口气，什么也没说。

sentences.en: The contest began, and the kitchen filled with noise.
sentences.zh: 比赛开始了，厨房里顿时充满了喧闹声。

sentences.en: Lin mixed eggs and sugar in a large bowl.
sentences.zh: 林在一个大碗里搅拌鸡蛋和糖。

sentences.en: He opened a bottle of milk and added melted chocolate.
sentences.zh: 他打开一瓶牛奶，又加入了融化的巧克力。

sentences.en: 'Baking is a kind of chemistry,' his old teacher once said.
sentences.zh: 他的老师曾经说过：“烘焙就是一种化学。”

sentences.en: Heat changes each chemical in the flour and sugar.
sentences.zh: 高温会改变面粉和糖里的每一种化学物质。

sentences.en: Even the carbon in browned sugar gives a special taste.
sentences.zh: 就连焦糖里的碳也能带来一种特别的风味。

sentences.en: Lin's brain worked fast as he planned every step.
sentences.zh: 林的大脑飞快运转，规划着每一个步骤。

sentences.en: The recipe was challenging, but he worked with quiet joy.
sentences.zh: 配方很有挑战性，但他做得沉静而快乐。

sentences.en: When he needed more cream, he had to borrow some from a friendly baker.
sentences.zh: 当奶油不够时，他只好向一位友善的选手借了一些。

sentences.en: At noon, the helpers served chicken and cheese sandwiches for lunch.
sentences.zh: 中午，工作人员端来了鸡肉奶酪三明治当午餐。

sentences.en: Then, in the afternoon, trouble came.
sentences.zh: 然而到了下午，麻烦来了。

sentences.en: While Lin talked to a judge, Max decided to cheat.
sentences.zh: 趁林和评委说话的时候，马克斯决定作弊。

sentences.en: He secretly pressed a button to turn the heat far too high.
sentences.zh: 他偷偷按下按钮，把烤箱温度调得过高。

sentences.en: He also dropped a broken egg onto Lin's clean table.
sentences.zh: 他还把一个打碎的鸡蛋扔在林干净的操作台上。

sentences.en: Soon black smoke rose, and the kitchen fell into chaos.
sentences.zh: 很快黑烟升起，厨房陷入一片混乱。

sentences.en: Lin ran back, coughing, and could hardly breathe.
sentences.zh: 林咳嗽着跑回来，几乎无法呼吸。

sentences.en: His first layer had started to burn at the edges.
sentences.zh: 他的第一层蛋糕坯边缘已经开始烧焦了。

sentences.en: Luckily, a young helper managed to catch Max's trick on film.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，一位年轻的助手用摄像机拍到了马克斯的把戏。

sentences.en: A chain of small clues also pointed straight at Max.
sentences.zh: 一连串的小线索也直接指向了马克斯。

sentences.en: The judges asked Lin if he wished to cancel his part in the show.
sentences.zh: 评委们问林是否想取消参赛。

sentences.en: 'No,' he said. 'This problem is not a burden; it is a test.'
sentences.zh: “不，”他说，“这个麻烦不是负担，而是一场考验。”

sentences.en: Like a rubber ball, he was ready to bounce back.
sentences.zh: 就像一只皮球，他准备好重新弹起来。

sentences.en: He felt bound to finish what he had started.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己一定要完成已经开始的事情。

sentences.en: Failure, he thought, is only a boundary that you must cross.
sentences.zh: 他想，失败只是一道必须跨越的界线。

sentences.en: He picked up his small brush and painted sugar flowers again.
sentences.zh: 他拿起小刷子，重新描画起糖霜花朵。

sentences.en: One by one, the other bakers began to cheer for him.
sentences.zh: 其他选手一个接一个地开始为他加油喝彩。

sentences.en: The bride, Anna, arrived to watch the final hour.
sentences.zh: 新娘安娜来到现场，观看最后一小时的比赛。

sentences.en: Her family was Christian and loved old traditions.
sentences.zh: 她的家人是基督徒，很看重古老的传统。

sentences.en: The wedding would be a Catholic ceremony next Sunday.
sentences.zh: 婚礼将于下周日举行，是一场天主教仪式。

sentences.en: Anna held a bunch of white roses against her breast.
sentences.zh: 安娜把一束白玫瑰捧在胸前。

sentences.en: For her, Lin cast little candy birds from melted sugar.
sentences.zh: 林用融化的糖为她浇铸出一只只小小的糖果鸟。

sentences.en: He also added funny cartoon animals for the children.
sentences.zh: 他还为孩子们添上了有趣的卡通动物。

sentences.en: He checked each step on a small chart taped to the wall.
sentences.zh: 他对照贴在墙上的小图表，逐一核对每个步骤。

sentences.en: At sunset, the judges tasted every cake in silence.
sentences.zh: 日落时分，评委们默默地品尝了每一个蛋糕。

sentences.en: Max was sent home at once for his dirty trick.
sentences.zh: 马克斯因为他的卑劣手段被立刻请出了赛场。

sentences.en: Then the chairman raised Lin's hand high in the air.
sentences.zh: 接着，主席高高举起了林的手。

sentences.en: 'Our new champion!' he shouted, and the room exploded with joy.
sentences.zh: “我们的新冠军！”他大声宣布，全场顿时欢腾起来。

sentences.en: Anna hugged Lin and thanked him with tears in her eyes.
sentences.zh: 安娜拥抱了林，含着眼泪向他道谢。

sentences.en: Lin received his certificate and the prize money.
sentences.zh: 林领到了证书和奖金。

sentences.en: He promised not to waste a single cent of it.
sentences.zh: 他发誓一分钱也不会乱花。

sentences.en: Outside, he called his mother on his cell phone.
sentences.zh: 在城堡外，他用手机给母亲打了电话。

sentences.en: 'The money will pay for your doctors,' he told her softly.
sentences.zh: “这笔钱可以付你的医药费了。”他轻声对她说。

sentences.en: That night, there was a warm celebration at the little bakery.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，小面包店里举行了一场温馨的庆祝会。

sentences.en: Friends and neighbours came to celebrate Lin's great win.
sentences.zh: 朋友和邻居们都来庆祝林的重大胜利。

sentences.en: Mrs. Chen raised her glass and cried, 'Cheers to our hero!'
sentences.zh: 陈太太举起酒杯，喊道：“为我们的英雄干杯！”

sentences.en: They laughed and told stories until long after midnight.
sentences.zh: 他们又笑又聊，一直闹到深夜以后。

sentences.en: When the last guest left, Lin waved and said, 'Bye!'
sentences.zh: 最后一位客人离开时，林挥着手说：“再见！”

sentences.en: He looked up at the quiet stars and smiled.
sentences.zh: 他抬头望着宁静的星空，露出了微笑。

sentences.en: A new chapter of his life had just begun.
sentences.zh: 他人生的新篇章才刚刚开始。

sentences.en: The small town of Seabrook sat quietly on a windy coast.
sentences.zh: 海溪镇是一座安静的小镇，坐落在多风的海岸边。

sentences.en: At the corner of Main Street stood an old cinema called the Starlight.
sentences.zh: 在主街的拐角处，有一家名叫“星光”的老电影院。

sentences.en: The great clock above its door had stopped many years ago.
sentences.zh: 门口上方那座大钟，早在多年前就停了。

sentences.en: Inside, an old coal stove still warmed the hall in winter.
sentences.zh: 在里面，一只烧煤的旧炉子在冬天仍为大厅供暖。

sentences.en: Every weekend the little theater showed classic films from the past.
sentences.zh: 每个周末，这家小影院都会放映过去的经典电影。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin, a retired teacher, loved the place more than anyone else.
sentences.zh: 退休教师林先生比任何人都更爱这个地方。

sentences.en: As a boy, he had watched his first comedy there and laughed until he cried.
sentences.zh: 小时候，他在那里看了人生第一部喜剧，笑得眼泪都出来了。

sentences.en: In the cold climate of December, the warm hall felt like the heart of the town.
sentences.zh: 在十二月寒冷的气候里，温暖的大厅就像小镇的心脏。

sentences.en: One morning, bad news arrived over the town like a dark cloud.
sentences.zh: 一天早晨，坏消息像一团乌云笼罩了小镇。

sentences.en: A large corporation from the city wanted to buy the old building.
sentences.zh: 一家来自城里的大公司想买下这座老建筑。

sentences.en: Their plan was to begin construction of a shiny commercial center.
sentences.zh: 他们的计划是动工修建一座光鲜的商业中心。

sentences.en: The wooden walls would be replaced by cold grey concrete.
sentences.zh: 木头墙壁将被冰冷的灰色混凝土取代。

sentences.en: The plan was controversial, and every citizen had a strong opinion about it.
sentences.zh: 这个计划很有争议，每个市民都对它有强烈的看法。

sentences.en: A consultant hired by the city reported that the building was in poor condition.
sentences.zh: 市里聘请的一位顾问报告说，这座建筑状况很差。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin read the report twice with deep concern.
sentences.zh: 林先生怀着深深的忧虑把报告读了两遍。

sentences.en: Then he drank his morning coffee slowly and made a quiet decision.
sentences.zh: 然后他慢慢喝完早晨的咖啡，默默做了一个决定。

sentences.en: That evening, he began to collect the opinions of his neighbors.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他开始收集邻居们的意见。

sentences.en: He wanted to communicate with every family in Seabrook.
sentences.zh: 他想和海溪镇的每一户人家沟通。

sentences.en: His first conversation was with Maya, a young clerk from the bank.
sentences.zh: 他的第一次交谈对象是玛雅，银行里一位年轻的职员。

sentences.en: Maya was clever, and she understood how to reach people quickly.
sentences.zh: 玛雅很聪明，懂得如何快速联系到大家。

sentences.en: Next, he visited Dr. Ross at the small clinic by the harbor.
sentences.zh: 接着，他去港口边的小诊所拜访了罗斯医生。

sentences.en: The kind doctor soon became his closest companion in the campaign.
sentences.zh: 这位善良的医生很快成了他在这场行动中最亲密的伙伴。

sentences.en: They all agreed that the protest must stay civil and peaceful.
sentences.zh: 他们一致同意，抗议必须保持文明与和平。

sentences.en: Within a week, a small circle of friends was meeting every night.
sentences.zh: 不到一周，一个小小的朋友圈子每晚都聚在一起。

sentences.en: The group gathered in an empty classroom at the school.
sentences.zh: 这群人聚集在学校一间空教室里。

sentences.en: Maya opened her computer and built a page for the campaign.
sentences.zh: 玛雅打开电脑，为这次行动建了一个网页。

sentences.en: With a single click, people anywhere could add their names in support.
sentences.zh: 只需轻轻一点，任何地方的人都可以签名支持。

sentences.en: She also printed a copy of the plan for every member.
sentences.zh: 她还为每位成员打印了一份计划书。

sentences.en: Clear communication, she said, was the key to winning hearts.
sentences.zh: 她说，清晰的沟通是赢得人心的关键。

sentences.en: The page helped them connect with people in other towns along the coast.
sentences.zh: 这个网页帮助他们和沿海其他城镇的人们建立了联系。

sentences.en: Day by day, Mr. Lin felt a warm connection growing among the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 一天天过去，林先生感到邻里之间温暖的纽带在生长。

sentences.en: The corporation's letter had sounded like a command, but the town refused to be afraid.
sentences.zh: 那家公司的信听起来像一道命令，但小镇拒绝害怕。

sentences.en: At the meetings, people shared their memories of the Starlight.
sentences.zh: 在聚会上，人们分享着关于“星光”的回忆。

sentences.en: Old Captain Reed, a soldier who was now a civilian, spoke first.
sentences.zh: 老船长里德——一位如今已是平民的退伍军人——第一个发言。

sentences.en: He remembered watching news films there about the communist countries of Europe.
sentences.zh: 他记得曾在那里看过关于欧洲共产主义国家的新闻影片。

sentences.en: Others loved the old documentaries about ancient civilization.
sentences.zh: 还有人喜欢那些讲述古代文明的老纪录片。

sentences.en: The theater had also shown contemporary films from almost every continent.
sentences.zh: 这家影院还放映过来自几乎每一块大陆的当代电影。

sentences.en: Mrs. Park brought her precious collection of old tickets.
sentences.zh: 朴太太带来了她珍藏的旧电影票收藏。

sentences.en: Each ticket had a different colour, like a small rainbow of memories.
sentences.zh: 每张票的颜色都不同，就像一道由回忆组成的小彩虹。

sentences.en: The color of the oldest one had faded to soft brown.
sentences.zh: 最旧的那张票，颜色已褪成柔和的棕色。

sentences.en: These stories gave the whole group fresh courage.
sentences.zh: 这些故事给了大家新的勇气。

sentences.en: Then Maya explained her concept for saving the building.
sentences.zh: 接着，玛雅讲了她拯救这座建筑的构想。

sentences.en: They would combine a winter concert with a street market.
sentences.zh: 他们要把一场冬季音乐会和街头集市结合起来。

sentences.en: There would also be a friendly baking competition in the square.
sentences.zh: 广场上还会举行一场友好的烘焙比赛。

sentences.en: Anyone in town could compete, young or old.
sentences.zh: 镇上的任何人都可以参赛，不分老幼。

sentences.en: Every family promised to contribute something to the event.
sentences.zh: 每户人家都答应为活动出一份力。

sentences.en: Even the smallest contribution, Maya said, would make a difference.
sentences.zh: 玛雅说，哪怕最小的贡献也会带来改变。

sentences.en: The hotel chef offered to cook hot soup for the crowd.
sentences.zh: 旅馆的厨师主动提出为大家煮热汤。

sentences.en: The children planned to sell chocolate cookies at a cheap price.
sentences.zh: 孩子们打算以便宜的价格出售巧克力饼干。

sentences.en: During the next week, the whole town prepared the old hall.
sentences.zh: 接下来的一周，全镇的人都在为老礼堂做准备。

sentences.en: Volunteers arrived early each morning to clean the dusty seats.
sentences.zh: 志愿者们每天一早就来打扫满是灰尘的座椅。

sentences.en: Maya wiped every window with a soft white cloth.
sentences.zh: 玛雅用一块柔软的白布擦净了每一扇窗户。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin had to climb a tall ladder to reach the broken lights.
sentences.zh: 林先生不得不爬上高高的梯子去修坏掉的灯。

sentences.en: An electrician repaired the old circuit behind the stage.
sentences.zh: 一位电工修好了舞台后面老旧的电路。

sentences.en: He tested each lamp twice to confirm that everything worked.
sentences.zh: 他把每盏灯都测了两遍，以确认一切正常。

sentences.en: Fresh paint arrived in a heavy metal container.
sentences.zh: 新油漆装在一个沉重的金属容器里运来了。

sentences.en: One box even contained little clay stars made by the schoolchildren.
sentences.zh: 有一个箱子里甚至装着小学生们做的黏土小星星。

sentences.en: Outside, a food stand prepared roasted corn and cold coke for the visitors.
sentences.zh: 门外，一个小吃摊为来客准备了烤玉米和冰镇可乐。

sentences.en: The big day arrived just before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节前夕，这个重要的日子终于到了。

sentences.en: Snow fell softly, and people came in their warmest clothes.
sentences.zh: 雪轻轻地下着，人们穿着最暖和的衣服前来。

sentences.en: A local shop even donated winter clothing for the volunteers.
sentences.zh: 本地一家商店还为志愿者捐赠了冬季服装。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin put on his old grey coat with pride.
sentences.zh: 林先生自豪地穿上了他那件灰色的旧大衣。

sentences.en: He turned up the collar against the sea wind.
sentences.zh: 他竖起衣领，抵挡海上吹来的风。

sentences.en: At the door, children dropped coin after coin into a big glass jar.
sentences.zh: 门口，孩子们把一枚又一枚硬币投进大玻璃罐里。

sentences.en: Inside, the repaired seats felt warm and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 在里面，修好的座椅温暖而舒适。

sentences.en: The music brought comfort to every tired heart in the room.
sentences.zh: 音乐给屋里每一颗疲惫的心带来了慰藉。

sentences.en: The crowd began to cheer when the school band played its first song.
sentences.zh: 当学校乐队奏响第一首歌时，人群开始欢呼。

sentences.en: In the middle of the evening, the mayor arrived with a manager from the company.
sentences.zh: 晚会进行到一半时，镇长带着公司的一位经理来了。

sentences.en: The manager made a cold comment about the noise and the crowd.
sentences.zh: 经理对噪音和人群冷冷地评论了一句。

sentences.en: For a moment, an open conflict seemed possible.
sentences.zh: 有那么一瞬间，公开的冲突似乎一触即发。

sentences.en: But Mr. Lin stayed calm and confident.
sentences.zh: 但林先生保持着冷静和自信。

sentences.en: He invited the manager to conduct a fair review of the town's plan.
sentences.zh: 他邀请经理对小镇的方案进行一次公正的审查。

sentences.en: "Please consider what this place means to us," he said gently.
sentences.zh: “请考虑一下这个地方对我们意味着什么。”他温和地说。

sentences.en: "We are asking for consideration, not for charity."
sentences.zh: “我们请求的是体谅，不是施舍。”

sentences.en: His voice was quiet but constant, like the sound of the sea.
sentences.zh: 他的声音轻柔却坚定不变，像大海的声音。

sentences.en: The town's message had stayed consistent from the very first day.
sentences.zh: 小镇的诉求从第一天起就始终如一。

sentences.en: Maya then read aloud a line from the city's constitution about protecting historic places.
sentences.zh: 接着，玛雅大声读出市宪章中关于保护历史场所的一条规定。

sentences.en: She also presented a careful plan for the conservation of the building.
sentences.zh: 她还提出了一份周密的建筑保护计划。

sentences.en: The problem was complex, she admitted, and money was short.
sentences.zh: 她承认，问题很复杂，而且资金短缺。

sentences.en: But the cinema was a key component of the town's future, not only its past.
sentences.zh: 但电影院不仅属于小镇的过去，更是小镇未来的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Her report was a thoughtful composition of facts and feelings.
sentences.zh: 她的报告是一篇由事实与情感精心写成的文章。

sentences.en: "Compare the price of losing this place with the price of keeping it," she said.
sentences.zh: “请比较一下失去这个地方的代价和保住它的代价。”她说。

sentences.en: Losing it would bring a consequence that no money could repair.
sentences.zh: 失去它将带来金钱无法弥补的后果。

sentences.en: The manager grew silent and began to concentrate on her words.
sentences.zh: 经理沉默下来，开始专心听她说话。

sentences.en: Outside, the manager lit a cigarette and stood alone in the falling snow.
sentences.zh: 在外面，经理点燃一支香烟，独自站在飘落的雪中。

sentences.en: After a long minute, he threw it away and walked back inside.
sentences.zh: 过了好一会儿，他把烟扔掉，走回了屋里。

sentences.en: "I am a conservative man," he said, "but even I can change my mind."
sentences.zh: “我是个保守的人，”他说，“但就连我也可以改变主意。”

sentences.en: Slowly, and to everyone's surprise, the two sides reached a consensus.
sentences.zh: 出乎所有人的意料，双方慢慢达成了共识。

sentences.en: The compromise they wrote down was simple and fair.
sentences.zh: 他们写下的妥协方案简单而公平。

sentences.en: The corporation would build its center at a more convenient place near the main road.
sentences.zh: 公司将把商业中心建在主路旁一个更便利的位置。

sentences.en: For the convenience of visitors, a new bus line would stop close by.
sentences.zh: 为了方便游客，一条新的公交线路将在附近设站。

sentences.en: In return, the town would commit to repairing the theater within two years.
sentences.zh: 作为交换，小镇承诺在两年内修缮好这家影院。

sentences.en: It was a true commitment, signed on paper that very night.
sentences.zh: 这是一份真正的承诺，当晚就签在了纸上。

sentences.en: In the end, it was the people, not the papers, that helped to convince him.
sentences.zh: 最终，说服他的不是文件，而是这里的人们。

sentences.en: Contrary to everyone's fears, the Starlight was saved.
sentences.zh: 与所有人担心的相反，“星光”被保住了。

sentences.en: It was not a conventional victory, but it was a real one.
sentences.zh: 这不是一场常规意义上的胜利，却是一场真正的胜利。

sentences.en: The following spring, a coach full of tourists stopped at the famous corner.
sentences.zh: 第二年春天，一辆满载游客的长途大巴停在了那个著名的街角。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin stood at the door and smiled like a champion.
sentences.zh: 林先生站在门口，笑得像一位冠军。

sentences.en: The great clock above the entrance was repaired and began to tick again.
sentences.zh: 入口上方的大钟修好了，重新开始滴答走动。

sentences.en: The town had written a warm conclusion to a difficult story.
sentences.zh: 小镇为一个艰难的故事写下了温暖的结局。

sentences.en: And every Christmas since then, the lights of the Starlight have shone brightly over the snow.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，每年圣诞节，“星光”的灯火都在雪夜里明亮地闪耀。

articles.title: The Broken Dam of Green Valley

sentences.en: Daisy lived with her dad in a small cottage at the edge of Green Valley.
sentences.zh: 黛西和爸爸住在绿谷边缘的一座小村舍里。

sentences.en: Every morning she milked the cow and checked the cotton field behind the house.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，她给奶牛挤奶，并查看屋后的棉花地。

sentences.en: The crop had grown well that year, and the family felt hopeful.
sentences.zh: 那一年庄稼长势很好，全家人都充满希望。

sentences.en: One day at dawn, her cousin Leo arrived from the city.
sentences.zh: 一天黎明时分，她的表哥利奥从城里来了。

sentences.en: 'My dear Daisy,' he said, 'I want to become a detective.'
sentences.zh: 他说：“亲爱的黛西，我想成为一名侦探。”

sentences.en: He carried a small diary in which he wrote down everything he saw.
sentences.zh: 他随身带着一本小日记，把看到的一切都记下来。

sentences.en: Daisy laughed at him, but she was also curious about his plan.
sentences.zh: 黛西笑话他，但也对他的计划感到好奇。

sentences.en: 'Daddy says nothing ever happens in our village,' she told him.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他：“爸爸说我们村里从来不会发生什么事。”

sentences.en: She was completely wrong.
sentences.zh: 她完全错了。

sentences.en: That night, a loud crash woke the whole village.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，一声巨响惊醒了整个村庄。

sentences.en: Water was pouring through a hole in the old dam above the valley.
sentences.zh: 河水正从山谷上方那座旧水坝的缺口涌出来。

sentences.en: The flood caused terrible damage to the fields near the river.
sentences.zh: 洪水给河边的田地造成了严重的破坏。

sentences.en: By morning, a worried crowd had gathered on the main road.
sentences.zh: 到了早晨，一群忧心忡忡的人聚集在大路上。

sentences.en: Some children began to cry when they saw the ruined farms.
sentences.zh: 一些孩子看到被毁的农田后哭了起来。

sentences.en: 'This is a disaster for all of us,' said the mayor, shaking his head.
sentences.zh: “这对我们所有人来说都是一场灾难，”镇长摇着头说。

sentences.en: Leo studied the broken stones and whispered, 'This was not an accident; it was a crime.'
sentences.zh: 利奥仔细察看碎裂的石块，低声说：“这不是意外，而是一桩罪案。”

sentences.en: Leo believed that someone had done this deliberately.
sentences.zh: 利奥确信有人是故意这么干的。

sentences.en: 'A criminal always leaves a mark,' he said with confidence.
sentences.zh: “罪犯总会留下痕迹，”他自信地说。

sentences.en: In the dirt near the wall, they found boot prints leading in the direction of the forest.
sentences.zh: 在墙边的泥土里，他们发现了通向森林方向的靴印。

sentences.en: Back home, Leo sat at the old desk and made careful notes.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，利奥坐在旧书桌前认真做记录。

sentences.en: He wrote a full description of the boot prints.
sentences.zh: 他把靴印的特征完整地描述了下来。

sentences.en: Daisy tried to describe a stranger she had seen near the river last week.
sentences.zh: 黛西试着描述上周她在河边见过的一个陌生人。

sentences.en: The man was tall, and his long coat was dirty and torn.
sentences.zh: 那个男人个子很高，长外套又脏又破。

sentences.en: Leo searched a police database on his laptop and found a matching face.
sentences.zh: 利奥在笔记本电脑上搜索警方数据库，找到了一张相符的面孔。

sentences.en: The man was Mr. Drake, a former official who many people believed was corrupt.
sentences.zh: 那人是德雷克先生，一位许多人认为很腐败的前官员。

sentences.en: For a decade he had controlled the local water company.
sentences.zh: 十年来，他一直控制着当地的水务公司。

sentences.en: Now he owed a huge debt to a foreign bank.
sentences.zh: 如今他欠了一家外国银行一大笔债。

sentences.en: He had even changed his money into foreign currency to hide it.
sentences.zh: 他甚至把钱换成外币来藏匿。

sentences.en: Officers at customs had once stopped him at the border crossing.
sentences.zh: 海关人员曾在边境口岸拦下过他。

sentences.en: Recently the value of his company had begun to decline.
sentences.zh: 最近，他公司的价值开始下滑。

sentences.en: If the valley flooded, land prices would decrease, and he could buy everything cheaply.
sentences.zh: 如果山谷被淹，地价就会下跌，他就能廉价买下一切。

sentences.en: 'What a cruel plan,' Daisy said angrily.
sentences.zh: “多么残忍的计划啊，”黛西气愤地说。

sentences.en: They knew the forest was dangerous, but they went anyway.
sentences.zh: 他们知道森林很危险，但还是去了。

sentences.en: 'Do you dare to follow me?' Leo asked with a smile.
sentences.zh: “你敢跟我来吗？”利奥笑着问。

sentences.en: Daisy needed all her courage to walk into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 黛西鼓起全部勇气才走进那片黑暗。

sentences.en: A deer suddenly jumped across the path, but Leo said it was only a gentle creature.
sentences.zh: 一只鹿突然从小路上跳过，但利奥说那只是一只温顺的动物。

sentences.en: They reached a stream and tested its depth with a long stick.
sentences.zh: 他们来到一条小溪边，用长树枝试探水的深度。

sentences.en: Daisy had to dip her boots into the cold water.
sentences.zh: 黛西不得不把靴子浸进冰冷的水里。

sentences.en: Then they saw a light and made a quick dash behind a tree.
sentences.zh: 接着他们看见一点亮光，飞快地冲到一棵树后躲起来。

sentences.en: Now they understood the danger: Mr. Drake was standing near a small hut.
sentences.zh: 现在他们明白了危险所在：德雷克先生正站在一间小木屋旁。

sentences.en: Drake was giving orders to a small work crew with shovels.
sentences.zh: 德雷克正对一小队拿着铁锹的工人下命令。

sentences.en: 'Dig here,' he said, 'and bury the tools deep in the ground.'
sentences.zh: “在这里挖，”他说，“把工具深埋进土里。”

sentences.en: Leo quietly recorded the whole dialogue on his phone.
sentences.zh: 利奥悄悄用手机录下了整段对话。

sentences.en: He also took a photo of a shining diamond in Drake's hand.
sentences.zh: 他还拍下了德雷克手中一颗闪亮的钻石。

sentences.en: 'That must be the deposit he promised the workers,' Daisy whispered.
sentences.zh: “那一定是他答应给工人的定金，”黛西低声说。

sentences.en: Everything would now depend on this evidence.
sentences.zh: 现在一切都要取决于这些证据了。

sentences.en: They copied the files onto a small disc that same night.
sentences.zh: 当天夜里，他们就把文件拷贝到了一张小光盘上。

sentences.en: 'He cannot delete the truth,' Leo said firmly.
sentences.zh: “他删不掉真相，”利奥坚定地说。

sentences.en: The next evening, the villagers held a big meeting after dinner.
sentences.zh: 第二天晚饭后，村民们举行了一场大会。

sentences.en: It was an old local custom to discuss serious problems together.
sentences.zh: 共同商讨重大问题是当地的一项老传统。

sentences.en: The debate quickly grew loud and hot.
sentences.zh: 辩论很快变得激烈起来。

sentences.en: Some farmers chose to disagree with Leo's story.
sentences.zh: 一些农民不同意利奥的说法。

sentences.en: 'A young boy cannot defeat a rich man,' one of them said.
sentences.zh: “一个小伙子斗不过有钱人，”其中一人说。

sentences.en: Drake stood up to defend himself with smooth words.
sentences.zh: 德雷克站起来，用花言巧语为自己辩护。

sentences.en: 'My lawyer will lead my defence,' he declared proudly.
sentences.zh: “我的律师会负责为我辩护，”他傲慢地宣称。

sentences.en: But when Leo played the recording, the room fell silent, and then everyone began to demand justice.
sentences.zh: 但当利奥播放录音时，全场安静下来，随后所有人都开始要求伸张正义。

sentences.en: Drake became desperate and ran toward the door.
sentences.zh: 德雷克陷入绝望，朝门口跑去。

sentences.en: His desire to escape made him careless.
sentences.zh: 逃跑的欲望让他失去了冷静。

sentences.en: He tried to destroy the evidence, but Leo had already made copies.
sentences.zh: 他试图销毁证据，但利奥早已做了备份。

sentences.en: His destination was the airport, where a taxi was waiting.
sentences.zh: 他的目的地是机场，一辆出租车正在那里等着。

sentences.en: Luckily, a fallen tree caused a long delay on the road.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，一棵倒下的树造成了路上长时间的耽搁。

sentences.en: The police stopped his departure just in time.
sentences.zh: 警察及时阻止了他的离开。

sentences.en: 'You deserve a fair trial,' the officer said, 'but not your freedom tonight.'
sentences.zh: “你应当得到公正的审判，”警官说，“但今晚你别想获得自由。”

sentences.en: In court, his lawyer's defense was weak, and the judge sent him to prison.
sentences.zh: 在法庭上，他律师的辩护苍白无力，法官判他入狱。

sentences.en: After the trial, the village decided to rebuild the broken wall together.
sentences.zh: 审判结束后，村民们决定一起重建被毁的坝墙。

sentences.en: Engineers came from the city to develop a stronger design.
sentences.zh: 工程师们从城里赶来，设计出更坚固的方案。

sentences.en: Old Mr. Hu, who was disabled, drew the first plan from his wheelchair.
sentences.zh: 腿脚不便的胡老先生坐在轮椅上画出了第一张图纸。

sentences.en: His disability had never stopped his clever mind.
sentences.zh: 残疾从未束缚住他聪明的头脑。

sentences.en: He worked with quiet dignity, and everyone respected him.
sentences.zh: 他带着从容的尊严工作，人人都敬重他。

sentences.en: When the new wall was finished, nobody was disappointed.
sentences.zh: 新坝墙建成后，没有人感到失望。

sentences.en: In fact, the whole valley was delighted with the result.
sentences.zh: 事实上，整个山谷的人都对结果感到欣喜。

sentences.en: The fear that had hung over the village finally seemed to disappear.
sentences.zh: 笼罩在村庄上空的恐惧终于仿佛消散了。

sentences.en: That autumn, there was a big dance in the village square.
sentences.zh: 那年秋天，村广场上举行了一场盛大的舞会。

sentences.en: Daisy's father loved to cook, and he baked cakes with sweet cream for everyone.
sentences.zh: 黛西的爸爸喜欢下厨，他为大家烤了抹着甜奶油的蛋糕。

sentences.en: Every customer at his little shop received a free piece.
sentences.zh: 他小店里的每位顾客都得到了免费的一块。

sentences.en: 'This is delicious!' the children shouted at the counter.
sentences.zh: “太好吃了！”孩子们在柜台前喊道。

sentences.en: A truck arrived to deliver new books for the school.
sentences.zh: 一辆卡车开来，为学校送来了新书。

sentences.en: The teachers added a safety lesson to the school curriculum.
sentences.zh: 老师们在学校课程中增加了一节安全课。

sentences.en: Before leaving, Leo gave Daisy a small dictionary as a gift.
sentences.zh: 临走前，利奥送给黛西一本小词典作为礼物。

sentences.en: 'A good investigator must always find the correct word,' he joked.
sentences.zh: “优秀的调查者必须永远找到正确的词，”他开玩笑说。

sentences.en: Years later, Daisy often thought about that strange autumn.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，黛西常常想起那个不寻常的秋天。

sentences.en: Life in the valley still moved in a quiet cycle of planting and harvest.
sentences.zh: 山谷里的生活依旧在耕种与收获的宁静循环中流转。

sentences.en: She learned to count her blessings every single day.
sentences.zh: 她学会了每天细数自己拥有的幸福。

sentences.en: Leo earned a degree in law at the city university.
sentences.zh: 利奥在城里的大学获得了法律学位。

sentences.en: His cases would differ, but his method stayed the same.
sentences.zh: 他办的案子各不相同，但方法始终如一。

sentences.en: 'Evidence and honesty are my only criteria,' he liked to say.
sentences.zh: “证据和诚实是我唯一的标准，”他喜欢这样说。

sentences.en: No difficulty could change his direct and honest way of working.
sentences.zh: 任何困难都无法改变他直接而诚实的工作方式。

sentences.en: He was determined to protect ordinary people from harm.
sentences.zh: 他下定决心保护普通人免受伤害。

sentences.en: Once, he even solved a famous case in a faraway desert town.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他甚至在遥远的沙漠小镇破了一桩大案。

sentences.en: Daisy stayed in the valley and helped a doctor search for a cure for her father's illness.
sentences.zh: 黛西留在山谷里，帮一位医生寻找治疗父亲疾病的方法。

sentences.en: That adventure had added a new dimension to their quiet lives.
sentences.zh: 那次冒险为他们平静的生活增添了新的一面。

sentences.en: In the end, both of them found happiness in their own way.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们都以自己的方式找到了幸福。

sentences.en: Mei worked as a young editor at a small newspaper in an eastern city.
sentences.zh: 梅在东部一座城市的小报社做年轻编辑。

sentences.en: Her everyday life at the office was quiet but busy.
sentences.zh: 她在办公室的日常生活安静而忙碌。

sentences.en: Deep in her heart, she had a dream of writing a story everyone would remember.
sentences.zh: 她心底有一个梦想：写出一篇人人都会记住的报道。

sentences.en: In college, she had won a prize for an essay about local history.
sentences.zh: 大学时，她曾凭一篇关于本地历史的文章获奖。

sentences.en: One evening, she was reading her e-mail at her desk.
sentences.zh: 一天傍晚，她正在桌前查看电子邮件。

sentences.en: Suddenly, the whole building began to shake.
sentences.zh: 突然，整栋楼开始摇晃。

sentences.en: It was an earthquake, and it hit the downtown area very hard.
sentences.zh: 那是一场地震，市中心受灾严重。

sentences.en: The city declared an emergency at once.
sentences.zh: 城市立刻宣布进入紧急状态。

sentences.en: The electricity was cut off, and the streets went dark.
sentences.zh: 电力中断，街道陷入黑暗。

sentences.en: Dust filled the air, and broken glass lay everywhere.
sentences.zh: 空气中满是灰尘，碎玻璃到处都是。

sentences.en: The next morning, many shops stood empty and silent.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，许多商店空空荡荡，一片寂静。

sentences.en: Mei went to help at a shelter near her office.
sentences.zh: 梅去办公室附近的避难所帮忙。

sentences.en: There she met Dr. Lin, a kind doctor who believed helping people was her duty.
sentences.zh: 在那里她认识了林医生，一位认为帮助别人是自己职责的好心医生。

sentences.en: She also met Chen, a young engineer who checked the damaged buildings.
sentences.zh: 她还认识了陈，一位检查受损建筑的年轻工程师。

sentences.en: The three of them soon became close friends.
sentences.zh: 三个人很快成了好朋友。

sentences.en: At the shelter, Mei cooked a simple dish of rice and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 在避难所，梅做了一道简单的米饭蔬菜。

sentences.en: She handed out warm drinks and boiled eggs to the tired families.
sentences.zh: 她给疲惫的家庭分发热饮和煮鸡蛋。

sentences.en: Dr. Lin found dry blankets for the elders.
sentences.zh: 林医生为老人们找来干燥的毯子。

sentences.en: One little girl had dropped her doll somewhere in the ruins.
sentences.zh: 一个小女孩把她的娃娃丢在了废墟里。

sentences.en: Chen went back that afternoon and found it for her.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，陈回去帮她找了回来。

sentences.en: Small acts like this encouraged everybody at the shelter.
sentences.zh: 这样的小事鼓舞了避难所里的每一个人。

sentences.en: Still, the city needed a lot of money to rebuild.
sentences.zh: 不过，城市重建还需要很多钱。

sentences.en: A week later, Chen asked Mei to come to the old city museum.
sentences.zh: 一周后，陈请梅去老城博物馆。

sentences.en: The earthquake had cracked the wall near the entrance.
sentences.zh: 地震震裂了入口附近的墙壁。

sentences.en: They entered the dark basement with two flashlights.
sentences.zh: 他们拿着两支手电筒走进黑暗的地下室。

sentences.en: Behind the broken wall, Chen had discovered a wooden box.
sentences.zh: 在破裂的墙后，陈发现了一个木箱。

sentences.en: Inside lay an old document, wrapped in soft grey paper.
sentences.zh: 里面放着一份旧文件，用柔软的灰纸包着。

sentences.en: It seemed to describe an emperor from a distant age.
sentences.zh: 它似乎记载着一位遥远时代的皇帝。

sentences.en: Mei's heart beat like a drum.
sentences.zh: 梅的心跳得像鼓一样。

sentences.en: She knew at once that this could be a great discovery.
sentences.zh: 她立刻意识到这可能是一个重大发现。

sentences.en: The next day, they examined the paper very carefully.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他们非常仔细地检查了那张纸。

sentences.en: Every dot and line had been drawn by hand.
sentences.zh: 每一个点、每一条线都是手工画的。

sentences.en: They could not understand the exact meaning of some old words.
sentences.zh: 有些古老的词语，他们弄不清确切的意思。

sentences.en: Mei took clear photos and saved them on a disk.
sentences.zh: 梅拍下清晰的照片，存在一张磁盘上。

sentences.en: She downloaded old maps to compare the place names.
sentences.zh: 她下载了旧地图来比对地名。

sentences.en: That night, she wrote a dozen pages of notes.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她写了十几页笔记。

sentences.en: Then she prepared the first draft of her article.
sentences.zh: 然后她写出了文章的初稿。

sentences.en: But not everyone was happy about the news.
sentences.zh: 但并不是所有人都为这个消息高兴。

sentences.en: Wang, the head of a rival paper, treated Mei like an enemy.
sentences.zh: 竞争对手报社的主编王，把梅当作敌人。

sentences.en: He printed a special edition just to attack her story.
sentences.zh: 他专门印了一期特刊来攻击她的报道。

sentences.en: "The document is a fake," he wrote, "and full of errors."
sentences.zh: “这份文件是假的，”他写道，“错误百出。”

sentences.en: His words were disturbing, and some readers began to doubt Mei.
sentences.zh: 他的话令人不安，一些读者开始怀疑梅。

sentences.en: One night, Wang came to her office, loud and half drunk.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，王来到她的办公室，大声嚷嚷，半醉着。

sentences.en: He made an excuse about a lost report and asked to see her notes.
sentences.zh: 他借口丢了一份报告，要求看她的笔记。

sentences.en: When she refused, he dragged a chair to her desk and would not leave.
sentences.zh: 她拒绝后，他把椅子拖到她桌前，赖着不走。

sentences.en: Chen arrived just in time and calmly asked him to go.
sentences.zh: 陈及时赶到，平静地请他离开。

sentences.en: Mei decided she had to prove the document was real.
sentences.zh: 梅决定必须证明文件是真的。

sentences.en: She contacted a history expert who worked with a foreign embassy.
sentences.zh: 她联系了一位在外国大使馆工作的历史专家。

sentences.en: The expert agreed to run a full examination of the paper.
sentences.zh: 专家同意对纸张做一次全面检验。

sentences.en: His team used modern electronic equipment in the lab.
sentences.zh: 他的团队在实验室里使用了现代电子设备。

sentences.en: They even used a tiny drill to take a sample from the box.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至用一个小钻头从木箱上取了样。

sentences.en: For two weeks, they evaluated every small detail.
sentences.zh: 两周里，他们评估了每一个小细节。

sentences.en: At last, the report came back: the document was real and in excellent condition.
sentences.zh: 报告终于出来了：文件是真的，而且保存状况极佳。

sentences.en: The old document told a moving story.
sentences.zh: 这份旧文件讲述了一个动人的故事。

sentences.en: Long ago, a terrible disease spread through the ruler's city.
sentences.zh: 很久以前，一场可怕的疾病在这位统治者的城市里蔓延。

sentences.en: There was no drug to cure it at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时没有药物可以治疗。

sentences.en: Rich families escaped to the mountains, but the poor could not.
sentences.zh: 富人家逃进了山里，穷人却走不了。

sentences.en: The wise ruler refused to divide his people into rich and poor.
sentences.zh: 睿智的统治者拒绝把人民分成贫富两类。

sentences.en: He opened his palace, whose gates showed an eagle and an elephant.
sentences.zh: 他敞开了宫殿，宫门上刻着一只鹰和一头大象。

sentences.en: He said the division between classes must end during the crisis.
sentences.zh: 他说，危机期间，阶层之间的隔阂必须结束。

sentences.en: "Help must be equal for all," he wrote, "or the suffering will be endless."
sentences.zh: “援助必须人人平等，”他写道，“否则苦难将无休无止。”

sentences.en: Mei published the full story in her newspaper.
sentences.zh: 梅在报纸上刊登了完整的故事。

sentences.en: Readers loved the old ruler's idea of equality.
sentences.zh: 读者们喜爱这位古代统治者的平等理念。

sentences.en: His story warned against discrimination of any kind.
sentences.zh: 他的故事警示人们反对任何形式的歧视。

sentences.en: It taught that kindness makes no distinction between strong and weak.
sentences.zh: 它告诉人们，善良不分强弱。

sentences.en: Teachers discussed the text in schools across the city.
sentences.zh: 全城的老师都在课堂上讨论这篇文章。

sentences.en: One class discussion focused on the evolution of the city itself.
sentences.zh: 有一场课堂讨论聚焦于这座城市自身的演变。

sentences.en: People felt proud that such history could still exist under their streets.
sentences.zh: 人们为脚下的街道里还留存着这样的历史而自豪。

sentences.en: To raise money for rebuilding, Mei planned a charity exhibition at the museum.
sentences.zh: 为了给重建筹钱，梅计划在博物馆办一场慈善展览。

sentences.en: The city elected a small committee to organize the event.
sentences.zh: 市里选出了一个小委员会来组织这次活动。

sentences.en: An electrical company repaired the museum's old wiring for free.
sentences.zh: 一家电气公司免费修好了博物馆的老旧线路。

sentences.en: New electric lights made the halls bright and warm.
sentences.zh: 新的电灯让展厅明亮而温暖。

sentences.en: Chen carefully checked the environment inside the building for safety.
sentences.zh: 陈仔细检查了建筑内部环境的安全。

sentences.en: A diverse group of volunteers joined the effort.
sentences.zh: 各种各样的志愿者加入了这项工作。

sentences.en: They put colorful posters at the edge of every street.
sentences.zh: 他们在每条街的路边贴上了彩色海报。

sentences.en: Entry was free, but visitors could donate money at the door.
sentences.zh: 入场免费，但参观者可以在门口捐款。

sentences.en: The exhibition opened on a sunny weekend near Easter.
sentences.zh: 展览在复活节前后一个阳光明媚的周末开幕。

sentences.en: Mei wore a simple blue dress for the big day.
sentences.zh: 梅在这个大日子里穿了一条简单的蓝裙子。

sentences.en: People traveled a long distance to see the ancient document.
sentences.zh: 人们从很远的地方赶来看这份古老的文件。

sentences.en: Children were eager to try the fun activities outside.
sentences.zh: 孩子们迫不及待地想尝试外面的趣味活动。

sentences.en: There was music, food, and free entertainment in the square.
sentences.zh: 广场上有音乐、美食和免费的娱乐节目。

sentences.en: A dynamic street band played happy songs all afternoon.
sentences.zh: 一支充满活力的街头乐队整个下午都在演奏欢快的歌曲。

sentences.en: The joyful sound filled everyone's ears.
sentences.zh: 欢乐的声音充满了每个人的耳朵。

sentences.en: In the park pond, a duck dived for bread that children threw.
sentences.zh: 公园的池塘里，一只鸭子潜下水去捡孩子们扔的面包。

sentences.en: One boy said the wet bread looked disgusting, and everyone laughed.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩说湿面包看起来真恶心，大家都笑了。

sentences.en: By the end of the day, they had raised thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 到这一天结束时，他们筹到了几千美元。

sentences.en: Local shops offered a discount to every visitor with a ticket.
sentences.zh: 本地商店给每位持票的参观者打折。

sentences.en: A rich woman, living alone after her divorce, gave the largest gift.
sentences.zh: 一位离婚后独居的富有女士捐出了最大的一笔钱。

sentences.en: She said helping others was better exercise for the heart than running.
sentences.zh: 她说，帮助别人比跑步更能锻炼心灵。

sentences.en: Even Mei and Wang exchanged a few polite words.
sentences.zh: 连梅和王也客气地交谈了几句。

sentences.en: He admitted his attack had been an ugly mistake, and she forgave him.
sentences.zh: 他承认自己的攻击是个丑陋的错误，她原谅了他。

sentences.en: The museum earned enough money to repair the whole building.
sentences.zh: 博物馆挣到了足够修缮整栋建筑的钱。

sentences.en: For Mei, Dr. Lin, and Chen, it was a truly happy ending.
sentences.zh: 对梅、林医生和陈来说，这是一个真正圆满的结局。

sentences.en: After her grandfather's funeral, Lin took the ferry back to the old village.
sentences.zh: 祖父的葬礼结束后，林乘渡船回到了老村庄。

sentences.en: She had spent five years working in finance in the big city.
sentences.zh: 她已经在大城市从事金融工作五年了。

sentences.en: Her flight had been cancelled, so the slow boat was her only choice.
sentences.zh: 她的航班被取消了，所以慢船成了唯一的选择。

sentences.en: The family farm looked smaller and sadder than she remembered.
sentences.zh: 家里的农场看上去比记忆中更小、更冷清。

sentences.en: The wooden fence leaned to one side, and weeds grew everywhere.
sentences.zh: 木栅栏歪向一边，杂草到处都是。

sentences.en: Still, every stone path felt familiar to her.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，每条石板小路对她来说都那么熟悉。

sentences.en: Her grandfather had been a farmer and a baker all his life.
sentences.zh: 她的祖父一辈子既是农民又是面包师。

sentences.en: His little mill by the river had turned wheat into flour for fifty years.
sentences.zh: 他河边的小磨坊已经把小麦磨成面粉整整五十年了。

sentences.en: Once, its bread had been famous across the whole area.
sentences.zh: 曾经，这里的面包在整个地区都很有名。

sentences.en: Now the business was close to complete failure.
sentences.zh: 如今，这门生意已濒临彻底失败。

sentences.en: The lawyer handed Lin a thick file of unpaid bills.
sentences.zh: 律师递给林一叠厚厚的未付账单文件。

sentences.en: Every expense had grown, and repairs would be expensive.
sentences.zh: 每项开支都在增加，而修缮又会很昂贵。

sentences.en: Selling the place seemed like the easiest exit.
sentences.zh: 把这里卖掉似乎是最轻松的出路。

sentences.en: But Lin could not accept that its long existence might simply end.
sentences.zh: 但林无法接受它漫长的存在就这样结束。

sentences.en: She decided she would not let the mill fail.
sentences.zh: 她决定绝不让磨坊倒下。

sentences.en: That evening, her childhood friend Wei knocked on the door.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚，她儿时的朋友阿伟敲响了门。

sentences.en: He was a friendly fellow with rough hands and a warm smile.
sentences.zh: 他是个友善的家伙，双手粗糙，笑容温暖。

sentences.en: Their friendship had begun years ago, catching fish in this same river.
sentences.zh: 他们的友谊始于多年前，在这条河里一起捉鱼的日子。

sentences.en: "You look worried," he said, reading her facial expression.
sentences.zh: “你看起来很担心。”他看着她脸上的表情说。

sentences.en: Lin tried to explain her plan to save the mill.
sentences.zh: 林试着解释她拯救磨坊的计划。

sentences.en: Her explanation was messy, but Wei nodded anyway.
sentences.zh: 她的解释乱七八糟，但阿伟还是点了点头。

sentences.en: "I have faith in you," he said simply.
sentences.zh: “我相信你。”他简单地说。

sentences.en: "Then do me a favor and help me rebuild it," she answered.
sentences.zh: “那就帮我个忙，和我一起重建它吧。”她回答。

sentences.en: The next morning they began to explore the old building.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他们开始探查这座老房子。

sentences.en: Dust covered the floor and the broken furniture.
sentences.zh: 灰尘覆盖着地板和破旧的家具。

sentences.en: The fridge in the corner had stopped working long ago.
sentences.zh: 角落里的冰箱早就坏了。

sentences.en: A fox had slept under the stairs and left fur on the boxes.
sentences.zh: 一只狐狸曾睡在楼梯下，箱子上留下了它的毛。

sentences.en: They cleaned for two days and threw out a mountain of rubbish.
sentences.zh: 他们打扫了两天，扔掉了堆积如山的垃圾。

sentences.en: In a drawer, Lin found her grandfather's favorite recipe book.
sentences.zh: 在抽屉里，林找到了祖父最喜爱的食谱。

sentences.en: She folded back the fragile cover and turned the pages with one finger.
sentences.zh: 她翻开脆弱的封面，用一根手指小心地翻动书页。

sentences.en: Then Wei began to fix the old stone oven.
sentences.zh: 接着，阿伟开始修理那座老石炉。

sentences.en: He was an expert with machines of every kind.
sentences.zh: 他是各种机器方面的行家。

sentences.en: By the weekend, the oven was warm again.
sentences.zh: 到了周末，炉子又重新暖了起来。

sentences.en: They decided to experiment with new kinds of bread.
sentences.zh: 他们决定尝试制作新品种的面包。

sentences.en: Lin wanted loaves with more fiber and less fat.
sentences.zh: 林想做纤维更多、脂肪更少的面包。

sentences.en: She added fresh fruit from the trees behind the house.
sentences.zh: 她加入了屋后树上摘来的新鲜水果。

sentences.en: The first batches burned, and she felt like a fool.
sentences.zh: 最初几炉都烤糊了，她觉得自己像个傻瓜。

sentences.en: "It's not your fault," Wei said. "The oven runs too hot."
sentences.zh: “这不是你的错，”阿伟说，“是炉子温度太高了。”

sentences.en: He lowered the flame until the heat was steady.
sentences.zh: 他调低了火焰，直到温度稳定下来。

sentences.en: At last, one fantastic loaf came out golden and soft.
sentences.zh: 终于，一条极好的面包出炉了，金黄而松软。

sentences.en: The sweet flesh of the baked apples seemed to fill the whole kitchen with its smell.
sentences.zh: 烤苹果甜美的果肉香气仿佛充满了整个厨房。

sentences.en: Lin was so happy she felt she could fly.
sentences.zh: 林高兴得觉得自己都能飞起来。

sentences.en: They ate the whole loaf standing up, laughing like children.
sentences.zh: 他们站着吃完了整条面包，笑得像孩子一样。

sentences.en: But making bread and making money are two different things.
sentences.zh: 但做面包和赚钱是两码事。

sentences.en: The bank asked for a heavy fee before it would lend more.
sentences.zh: 银行要求先付一笔高额费用才肯继续放贷。

sentences.en: So Lin built a simple framework for their small budget.
sentences.zh: 于是林为他们微薄的预算搭建了一个简单的框架。

sentences.en: There was no extra cash for fancy equipment.
sentences.zh: 没有多余的现金去买花哨的设备。

sentences.en: Their plan had to stay flexible, week by week.
sentences.zh: 他们的计划必须每周保持灵活调整。

sentences.en: Wei suggested selling bread at the autumn festival in town.
sentences.zh: 阿伟建议在镇上的秋季节日集会上卖面包。

sentences.en: It was a fair way to test the market.
sentences.zh: 这是检验市场的一个公平办法。

sentences.en: They painted a small flag to hang above their stand.
sentences.zh: 他们画了一面小旗子，准备挂在摊位上方。

sentences.en: A month ago, all of this had sounded like fiction to Lin.
sentences.zh: 一个月前，这一切对林来说还像小说里的情节。

sentences.en: Now the dream was no longer a fantasy.
sentences.zh: 如今，这个梦想不再是幻想了。

sentences.en: Then, three days before the event, the weather forecast brought bad news.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在活动前三天，天气预报带来了坏消息。

sentences.en: Heavy rain was coming, and the river might flood.
sentences.zh: 暴雨即将来临，河水可能会泛滥。

sentences.en: That night, water began to flow over the low bank.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，河水开始漫过低矮的河岸。

sentences.en: Freezing rain beat against the windows for hours.
sentences.zh: 冰冷刺骨的雨敲打了窗户好几个小时。

sentences.en: Lin stood at the door with cold fear in her chest.
sentences.zh: 林站在门口，心中充满了冰冷的恐惧。

sentences.en: Wei arrived before midnight with bags of sand.
sentences.zh: 午夜前，阿伟带着一袋袋沙子赶到了。

sentences.en: They worked in the dark until their arms could barely function.
sentences.zh: 他们在黑暗中干活，直到手臂几乎无法动弹。

sentences.en: By morning, the garden was under water, but the mill was safe.
sentences.zh: 到早晨，菜园被水淹了，但磨坊保住了。

sentences.en: Only one flower bed by the gate was destroyed.
sentences.zh: 只有大门旁的一个花坛被毁掉了。

sentences.en: Lin was wet from head to foot and shaking.
sentences.zh: 林从头到脚都湿透了，浑身发抖。

sentences.en: The next day she woke with a fever.
sentences.zh: 第二天，她醒来时发起了烧。

sentences.en: Wei made her rest and went out to feed the chickens himself.
sentences.zh: 阿伟让她休息，自己出去喂鸡。

sentences.en: A week later, the festival finally opened under a clear sky.
sentences.zh: 一周后，节日集会终于在晴朗的天空下开幕了。

sentences.en: Folk music played in the square, and people came from every village.
sentences.zh: 广场上奏着民间音乐，各个村子的人都来了。

sentences.en: Luck seemed to favour Lin and Wei at last.
sentences.zh: 幸运终于眷顾了林和阿伟。

sentences.en: An old man tasted their apple cake with a small fork and smiled.
sentences.zh: 一位老人用小叉子尝了他们的苹果蛋糕，露出了笑容。

sentences.en: In a flash, the first basket was empty.
sentences.zh: 转眼间，第一篮面包就卖空了。

sentences.en: The apple cake quickly became the town's new favourite.
sentences.zh: 苹果蛋糕很快成了全镇新的最爱。

sentences.en: By noon they had sold everything and gained their first real profit.
sentences.zh: 到中午，他们卖完了所有东西，赚到了第一笔真正的利润。

sentences.en: A shop owner from the city asked about frequent deliveries.
sentences.zh: 一位城里的店主询问能否频繁送货。

sentences.en: He even spoke of plans to export the bread to towns along the coast.
sentences.zh: 他甚至谈到把面包外销到沿海城镇的计划。

sentences.en: Lin shook his hand with a firm grip.
sentences.zh: 林坚定有力地和他握了手。

sentences.en: "This is extraordinary," she whispered to Wei.
sentences.zh: “这太不可思议了。”她小声对阿伟说。

sentences.en: That night they counted the money three times, just to be sure.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他们把钱数了三遍，只为确认这是真的。

sentences.en: Over the winter, the little business began to expand.
sentences.zh: 整个冬天，这门小生意开始扩张。

sentences.en: Lin gave up her flat in the city and moved back for good.
sentences.zh: 林退掉了城里的公寓，永远搬了回来。

sentences.en: A factory in town made paper bags with their name printed on them.
sentences.zh: 镇上的一家工厂为他们制作了印有店名的纸袋。

sentences.en: Wei built a wooden extension at the back of the mill.
sentences.zh: 阿伟在磨坊后面加盖了一间木制扩建房。

sentences.en: Lin designed a clean format for all the labels.
sentences.zh: 林为所有标签设计了简洁的版式。

sentences.en: A cold room let them freeze dough for busy days.
sentences.zh: 一间冷藏室让他们可以把面团冷冻起来，以备忙碌的日子。

sentences.en: Fuel for the delivery van cost money, but orders kept coming.
sentences.zh: 送货车的燃料要花钱，但订单源源不断。

sentences.en: Honest work, Lin learned, was the fundamental rule of the trade.
sentences.zh: 林明白了，诚实劳动是这行最根本的规则。

sentences.en: The bread would never bring them a great fortune.
sentences.zh: 面包永远不会给他们带来巨大的财富。

sentences.en: But it gave them a good and steady life.
sentences.zh: 但它给了他们一种美好而安稳的生活。

sentences.en: One evening in spring, Lin walked up the hill to her grandfather's grave.
sentences.zh: 春天的一个傍晚，林走上山坡，来到祖父的墓前。

sentences.en: Behind the mill, the forest was turning green again.
sentences.zh: 磨坊后面的森林又开始泛绿了。

sentences.en: "Forgive me for staying away so long," she said quietly.
sentences.zh: “原谅我离开了这么久。”她轻声说。

sentences.en: She promised to foster the traditions he had loved.
sentences.zh: 她许诺要培育和延续他所热爱的传统。

sentences.en: She knew now that coming home had not been a false step.
sentences.zh: 她现在明白，回家并不是一步错棋。

sentences.en: The extreme days of worry were finally behind them.
sentences.zh: 那些极度忧虑的日子终于过去了。

sentences.en: When she finished speaking, the sun was setting over the river.
sentences.zh: 她说完话时，太阳正落在河面上。

sentences.en: Wei waited by the gate, hardly able to express his news.
sentences.zh: 阿伟在门口等着，兴奋得几乎说不出他的消息。

sentences.en: A young customer had started an online fan page for their little mill.
sentences.zh: 一位年轻顾客为他们的小磨坊建了一个网上粉丝主页。

sentences.en: Lin laughed until tears came to her eyes.
sentences.zh: 林笑得眼泪都流了出来。

sentences.en: This quiet life fit her perfectly, and freedom, she thought, meant choosing your own work.
sentences.zh: 这种宁静的生活完全适合她；她想，自由就是选择自己想做的工作。

sentences.en: "I'm home forever now," she told the evening wind.
sentences.zh: “现在，我永远回家了。”她对着晚风说。

sentences.en: Grace finished her exams in May and finally became a college graduate.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝在五月考完了试，终于成为一名大学毕业生。

sentences.en: The graduation ceremony in the city felt grand and unforgettable.
sentences.zh: 在城里举行的毕业典礼隆重而难忘。

sentences.en: But her grandmother was too old to travel there for the day.
sentences.zh: 但她的祖母年纪太大，无法赶去参加。

sentences.en: So Grace planned a long holiday at the family farm, free from homework at last.
sentences.zh: 于是格蕾丝计划去家里的农场度一个长假，终于不用再做作业了。

sentences.en: She packed a straw hat, her old guitar, and a bag of clothes.
sentences.zh: 她收拾了一顶草帽、一把旧吉他和一袋衣服。

sentences.en: The country bus climbed a green hill and stopped beside a wooden gate.
sentences.zh: 乡村巴士爬上一座青山，停在一扇木门旁。

sentences.en: Her grandfather was waiting there, and he welcomed her with a long hug.
sentences.zh: 祖父正在那里等她，用一个长长的拥抱迎接她。

sentences.en: "Hello, my dear girl!" he shouted, waving both arms.
sentences.zh: “你好啊，我亲爱的孩子！”他挥着双臂喊道。

sentences.en: His hair had turned gray, but his eyes were still young and bright.
sentences.zh: 他的头发已经花白，但眼睛依然年轻明亮。

sentences.en: Grandma stood in the garden, cutting fresh flowers for the table.
sentences.zh: 奶奶站在花园里，剪着新鲜的花准备摆在桌上。

sentences.en: Grace gave her a small gift she had chosen in the city.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝送给她一份在城里挑选的小礼物。

sentences.en: A white goat watched them from the tall grass near the fence.
sentences.zh: 一只白山羊从栅栏边的高草丛中望着她们。

sentences.en: An old brown horse rested in the shade beside the garage.
sentences.zh: 一匹棕色的老马在车库旁的阴凉处休息。

sentences.en: In the kitchen, bread, honey, and thick slices of ham waited on the table.
sentences.zh: 厨房里，面包、蜂蜜和厚厚的火腿片已摆在桌上。

sentences.en: Grandma took cold lemonade from the fridge and filled three cups.
sentences.zh: 奶奶从冰箱里拿出冰柠檬水，倒满了三个杯子。

sentences.en: Grace felt a quiet happiness she had almost forgotten in the city.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝感到一种在城市里几乎被遗忘的宁静的幸福。

sentences.en: Farm life soon became a gentle habit for Grace.
sentences.zh: 农场生活很快成了格蕾丝一种温和的习惯。

sentences.en: Every morning she fed the hungry chickens before her own breakfast.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，她都在自己吃早饭前先喂饥饿的鸡群。

sentences.en: Grandfather collected the garbage, then repaired old tools with his hammer.
sentences.zh: 祖父收拾好垃圾，然后用锤子修理旧工具。

sentences.en: He was an honest man, trusted by every generation in the village.
sentences.zh: 他是个诚实的人，村里每一代人都信任他。

sentences.en: Neighbors called him a real gentleman, because he was generous even in hard years.
sentences.zh: 邻居们称他为真正的绅士，因为即使在艰难的年月他也很慷慨。

sentences.en: In the evenings he told long stories, and his humor made everyone laugh.
sentences.zh: 晚上他讲很长的故事，他的幽默让每个人都开怀大笑。

sentences.en: Grace would hang a lamp by the door and listen until midnight.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝会在门边挂一盏灯，一直听到深夜。

sentences.en: Sometimes the old radio played a gay, lively tune from his young days.
sentences.zh: 有时旧收音机会播放他年轻时那种欢快活泼的曲子。

sentences.en: One morning they walked to the village to buy some goods.
sentences.zh: 一天早晨，他们步行去村里买些货物。

sentences.en: The grocery store stood next to a tiny art gallery.
sentences.zh: 杂货店旁边是一间小小的美术馆。

sentences.en: Behind them, a new gym had opened on the old golf field.
sentences.zh: 在它们后面，旧高尔夫球场上新开了一家健身房。

sentences.en: The shopkeeper welcomed every guest as if they were family.
sentences.zh: 店主招待每一位客人都像招待家人一样。

sentences.en: "How you grow!" she cried, measuring Grace's height with her hand.
sentences.zh: “你长得真快！”她一边喊，一边用手比着格蕾丝的身高。

sentences.en: Grace laughed and said she was glad to be remembered.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝笑了，说自己很高兴还有人记得她。

sentences.en: She offered to teach English grammar to the village children that summer.
sentences.zh: 她主动提出那个夏天教村里的孩子们英语语法。

sentences.en: In return, an old hunter promised to guide her through the woods.
sentences.zh: 作为回报，一位老猎人答应带她去树林里游览。

sentences.en: The hunter told her that his gun had stayed locked away for years.
sentences.zh: 猎人告诉她，他的枪已经锁起来很多年了。

sentences.en: "I used to hunt foxes, but now I only take pictures," he explained.
sentences.zh: “我以前打狐狸，现在只拍照片了。”他解释道。

sentences.en: "A wild animal does no harm if you leave it in peace."
sentences.zh: “只要你不去打扰，野生动物不会伤害任何人。”

sentences.en: He wore a funny yellow helmet and rode a small motorbike along the highway.
sentences.zh: 他戴着一顶滑稽的黄色头盔，骑着一辆小摩托车沿公路行驶。

sentences.en: Grace could hardly stop laughing when she saw him coming.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝看到他骑车过来时，几乎笑得停不下来。

sentences.en: One day they rode together to the harbor to watch the fishing boats.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他们一起骑车去港口看渔船。

sentences.en: The boats rocked in perfect harmony with the slow waves.
sentences.zh: 渔船随着缓缓的波浪和谐地摇晃着。

sentences.en: Those warm days seemed as if they would never end.
sentences.zh: 那些温暖的日子仿佛永远不会结束。

sentences.en: Then one afternoon the heat suddenly broke, and the wind changed direction.
sentences.zh: 然而一天下午，暑热突然消退，风向也变了。

sentences.en: Grandfather turned on the radio and heard a horrible warning.
sentences.zh: 祖父打开收音机，听到了一个可怕的警报。

sentences.en: A hurricane was moving toward the coast, said every headline.
sentences.zh: 每条头条新闻都在说：一场飓风正朝海岸移动。

sentences.en: Outside, the golden grain stood tall and almost ready.
sentences.zh: 屋外，金黄的谷物挺立着，几乎就要成熟了。

sentences.en: If the storm came first, the whole harvest of the year would be lost.
sentences.zh: 如果暴风雨先来，这一年的收成就会全部毁掉。

sentences.en: Grandfather understood the gravity of the situation at once.
sentences.zh: 祖父立刻明白了局势的严重性。

sentences.en: "We cannot hide from the sky," he said quietly, "but we can hurry."
sentences.zh: “我们躲不开老天，”他平静地说，“但我们可以抓紧时间。”

sentences.en: There was no money to hire extra workers from the town.
sentences.zh: 家里没有钱从镇上雇额外的工人。

sentences.en: So Grace decided to gather the neighbors herself.
sentences.zh: 于是格蕾丝决定亲自去召集邻居们。

sentences.en: She ran from house to house and knocked on every single door.
sentences.zh: 她挨家挨户地跑，敲响了每一扇门。

sentences.en: "We need a hundred hands in the fields by sunrise," she told them.
sentences.zh: “日出前我们需要一百双手到田里去。”她对大家说。

sentences.en: One young man refused at first, then felt guilty and came running after her.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻人起初拒绝了，后来心里愧疚，又追了上来。

sentences.en: "I cannot guarantee good weather," Grace said, "but I promise nobody will stand alone."
sentences.zh: “我不能保证天气会好，”格蕾丝说，“但我保证没有人会孤军奋战。”

sentences.en: Everyone within hearing agreed to come and help.
sentences.zh: 所有听到这番话的人都答应来帮忙。

sentences.en: Even the smallest children begged for some helpful job to do.
sentences.zh: 连最小的孩子们也央求分一份能帮上忙的活儿。

sentences.en: The work began before the first light touched the fields.
sentences.zh: 天还没亮，劳作就开始了。

sentences.en: Grace drew a simple graph to show which field should be cut first.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝画了一张简单的图表，标明该先收割哪块田。

sentences.en: She also learned to handle the old cutting machine after a few tries.
sentences.zh: 她试了几次后，也学会了操作那台旧收割机。

sentences.en: Grandfather stood by the barn to guard the growing pile of sacks.
sentences.zh: 祖父站在谷仓旁，看守着越堆越高的粮袋。

sentences.en: Under his calm guidance, nobody wasted a single minute.
sentences.zh: 在他沉着的指导下，没有人浪费一分钟。

sentences.en: The heavy bags were carried into the dry hall of the church.
sentences.zh: 沉重的粮袋被搬进了教堂干燥的大厅里。

sentences.en: The priest opened the holy building without asking a single question.
sentences.zh: 牧师二话不说就打开了这座神圣的建筑。

sentences.en: At noon a news helicopter flew over and filmed the busy fields.
sentences.zh: 中午，一架新闻直升机飞过，拍下了繁忙的田野。

sentences.en: By evening, only a handful of rows were still standing.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，只剩下寥寥几行庄稼还立在田里。

sentences.en: The hurricane arrived that night, and the rain fell like stones.
sentences.zh: 飓风当晚就来了，雨点像石头一样砸下来。

sentences.en: The family sat close together, watching the storm through the window glass.
sentences.zh: 一家人紧紧地坐在一起，透过窗玻璃看着暴风雨。

sentences.en: Grandma poured hot tea and said heaven had given them just enough time.
sentences.zh: 奶奶倒上热茶，说是上天刚好给了他们足够的时间。

sentences.en: The wind tore a hole in the garage roof, but nothing worse happened.
sentences.zh: 大风在车库屋顶上撕开了一个洞，但没有造成更大的损失。

sentences.en: Grace held the old woman's hand and felt no hunger for city life at all.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝握着老人的手，心里对城市生活再没有一丝渴望。

sentences.en: By morning the sky was a soft, tired grey.
sentences.zh: 到了早晨，天空是一片柔和而疲惫的灰色。

sentences.en: The fields were wet and empty, but the grain was safe inside.
sentences.zh: 田野湿漉漉、空荡荡的，但谷物安全地存放在屋里。

sentences.en: A week later, the village decided to host a great thanksgiving dinner.
sentences.zh: 一周后，村里决定举办一场盛大的感恩晚宴。

sentences.en: There was no hotel nearby, so visitors slept in friendly farmhouse rooms.
sentences.zh: 附近没有旅馆，来客们就睡在热情人家的农舍里。

sentences.en: Long tables were set out on the healthy green field by the church.
sentences.zh: 长桌摆在教堂旁生机勃勃的绿地上。

sentences.en: The old hunter hung his coat on a hook and played music all night.
sentences.zh: 老猎人把外套挂在挂钩上，整晚都在演奏音乐。

sentences.en: A handsome young teacher stood up to give a short speech.
sentences.zh: 一位英俊的年轻教师站起来做了简短的致辞。

sentences.en: "Tonight we honor Grace," he said, "who showed us what one brave heart can do."
sentences.zh: “今晚我们向格蕾丝致敬，”他说，“她让我们看到一颗勇敢的心能做到什么。”

sentences.en: "It is an honour I must share," Grace answered, "with every hand in this room."
sentences.zh: “这份荣誉，”格蕾丝回答，“我必须与在座的每一双手分享。”

sentences.en: People called her a hero, but she only pointed at her smiling grandfather.
sentences.zh: 人们称她为英雄，她却只是指了指笑呵呵的祖父。

sentences.en: Later that month, a photo of the rescue traveled across the globe online.
sentences.zh: 那个月的晚些时候，一张抢收的照片在网上传遍了全球。

sentences.en: Grace stayed in the village and taught at the little school in autumn.
sentences.zh: 格蕾丝留在了村里，秋天开始在小学校教书。

sentences.en: She gave every child who had worked in the fields a proud top grade.
