sentences.zh: 他是严先生的弟弟，生活对他并不甜蜜。

sentences.en: He had lost his job at the bus terminal and had nowhere left to sleep.
sentences.zh: 他丢掉了在公交总站的工作，无处安身。

sentences.en: He had taken the blade in a weak moment, telling himself it was only temporary.
sentences.zh: 他在一时软弱中拿走了那把剑，还告诉自己这只是暂时的。

sentences.en: The town's anger melted away when people heard how much he had suffered.
sentences.zh: 当人们听说他吃了多少苦之后，镇上的怒气渐渐消散了。

sentences.en: In front of everyone, Mr. Yan said he was deeply sorry to Bing.
sentences.zh: 在众人面前，严先生向阿冰表达了深深的歉意。

sentences.en: A week later, the group decided to perform one last show as a gift to the town.
sentences.zh: 一个星期后，剧团决定再演最后一场，作为送给小镇的礼物。

sentences.en: To everyone's surprise, Bing was invited to play a small part on the stage.
sentences.zh: 令所有人惊讶的是，阿冰被邀请在台上扮演一个小角色。

sentences.en: Mr. Yan wore his finest suit and gave the best performance of his life.
sentences.zh: 严先生穿上他最好的西装，献上了他一生中最精彩的表演。

sentences.en: The show was so successful that people came from all the surrounding villages.
sentences.zh: 演出大获成功，周围村庄的人们都赶来观看。

sentences.en: In one scene, the hunter made the silver blade swing like a flash of light.
sentences.zh: 在其中一幕里，猎人挥舞银剑，剑光像闪电一样划过。

sentences.en: The paper tiger even had a long moving tail that made the children laugh.
sentences.zh: 那只纸老虎还有一条会动的长尾巴，逗得孩子们哈哈大笑。

sentences.en: After the show, Mr. Yan gave the money from every ticket to the little clinic.
sentences.zh: 演出结束后，严先生把每一张票的收入都捐给了小诊所。

sentences.en: 'Now we can buy a fresh supply of bandages and medicine,' Doctor Wu said with a smile.
sentences.zh: 吴医生笑着说：“现在我们可以买一批新的绷带和药品了。”

sentences.en: The rest of the summer flowed by like a warm and gentle stream.
sentences.zh: 那个夏天余下的日子像一条温暖平缓的小溪一样流淌而过。

sentences.en: Tao learned to swim in the river with Bing on the hot afternoons.
sentences.zh: 在炎热的午后，陶和阿冰一起在河里学会了游泳。

sentences.en: They also played tennis against the clinic wall with an old wooden racket.
sentences.zh: 他们还用一只旧木球拍对着诊所的墙壁打网球。

sentences.en: Once, a flat tire on Tao's bicycle made them walk home for a whole hour.
sentences.zh: 有一次，陶的自行车轮胎瘪了，害得他们走了整整一个小时才到家。

sentences.en: Bing kept candies in an old tin box, and they would suck them slowly while talking about the future.
sentences.zh: 阿冰把糖果存放在一个旧铁盒里，他们常常慢慢含着糖，聊着未来。

sentences.en: Doctors, Tao learned that summer, tend to remember their first patient forever.
sentences.zh: 那年夏天陶明白了，医生往往会永远记住自己的第一个病人。

sentences.en: At the end of August, Ms. Song gave him one final tip: work hard, and never call your own dream stupid.
sentences.zh: 八月底，宋老师给了他最后一条建议：努力学习，永远不要说自己的梦想愚蠢。

sentences.en: Years later, Tao did succeed and became a fine surgeon in the city.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，陶真的成功了，成为城里一名出色的外科医生。

sentences.en: For him, the supreme lesson of that summer was simple: courage and kindness open every door.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，那个夏天最重要的一课很简单：勇气与善良能打开每一扇门。

sentences.en: Lin and Mei were twins who lived in a busy urban area.
sentences.zh: 林和梅是一对双胞胎，住在繁忙的城市里。

sentences.en: Every summer they spent their vacation with their Uncle Wei in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天，他们都去山里和魏叔叔一起度假。

sentences.en: This year the trip began on a warm morning in July.
sentences.zh: 今年的旅行开始于七月一个温暖的早晨。

sentences.en: They caught an early train out of the crowded city.
sentences.zh: 他们赶上了一班早班火车，离开了拥挤的城市。

sentences.en: The heavy traffic near the station almost made them late.
sentences.zh: 车站附近拥堵的交通差点让他们迟到。

sentences.en: Mei checked her wallet twice to make sure the tickets were safe.
sentences.zh: 梅检查了两次钱包，确认车票还在。

sentences.en: Luckily, no visa was needed for travel inside their own country.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，在国内旅行不需要签证。

sentences.en: Soon the train rolled toward the green hills in the south.
sentences.zh: 很快，火车朝着南方的青山驶去。

sentences.en: Outside the window, every tree shone bright in the morning sun.
sentences.zh: 窗外，每一棵树都在晨光中闪闪发亮。

sentences.en: The two children felt truly free for the first time in months.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，两个孩子第一次感到真正的自由。

sentences.en: Uncle Wei met them at a tiny station deep in the valley.
sentences.zh: 魏叔叔在山谷深处的一个小车站接他们。

sentences.en: He drove an old truck that made a loud, funny noise.
sentences.zh: 他开着一辆旧卡车，发出又响又滑稽的声音。

sentences.en: It was the only vehicle he had ever owned.
sentences.zh: 那是他拥有过的唯一一辆车。

sentences.en: His village was quiet and green, unlike the noisy city.
sentences.zh: 他的村庄安静而翠绿，和喧闹的城市完全不同。

sentences.en: Many young people had left home because of unemployment.
sentences.zh: 许多年轻人因为失业而离开了家乡。

sentences.en: Uncle Wei believed that tourism could bring the place back to life.
sentences.zh: 魏叔叔相信旅游业能让这个地方重新焕发生机。

sentences.en: But so far, hardly any tourist ever came to see it.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，几乎没有游客来过这里。

sentences.en: That evening he cooked turkey and rice for a welcome dinner.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他做了火鸡和米饭作为接风晚餐。

sentences.en: He told them he had given up tobacco many years ago.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，自己许多年前就戒烟了。

sentences.en: After they washed the dishes together, everyone went to bed early.
sentences.zh: 一起洗完碗后，大家都早早睡了。

sentences.en: The twins woke up when the birds began to sing.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿开始唱歌时，双胞胎就醒了。

sentences.en: After breakfast, Uncle Wei showed them his old warehouse.
sentences.zh: 早饭后，魏叔叔带他们参观了他的旧仓库。

sentences.en: Inside, a thick layer of dust covered everything.
sentences.zh: 仓库里，厚厚的一层灰尘覆盖着一切。

sentences.en: There were boxes full of rusty tools and broken toys.
sentences.zh: 那里有一箱箱生锈的工具和破旧的玩具。

sentences.en: In a corner stood a wooden trunk with an ugly iron lock.
sentences.zh: 角落里立着一只木箱，上面挂着一把难看的铁锁。

sentences.en: Lin pulled hard but was unable to open it.
sentences.zh: 林用力拉，却打不开它。

sentences.en: Then Mei found a tiny key hidden inside a metal tube.
sentences.zh: 后来梅在一根金属管里发现了一把小钥匙。

sentences.en: The lock clicked, and the heavy lid slowly lifted.
sentences.zh: 锁咔哒一声开了，沉重的盖子慢慢升起。

sentences.en: Inside lay an old map covered with strange writing.
sentences.zh: 里面放着一张写满奇怪文字的旧地图。

sentences.en: It spoke of a treasure hidden somewhere underground.
sentences.zh: 上面写着有一批宝藏藏在地下某处。

sentences.en: A small drawing showed the old stone tower on the hill.
sentences.zh: 一幅小图画出了山上那座古老的石塔。

sentences.en: The writing was in a very old form of the language.
sentences.zh: 那些文字是一种非常古老的语言形式。

sentences.en: Uncle Wei's friend, a retired teacher, made a careful translation.
sentences.zh: 魏叔叔的朋友——一位退休教师——做了仔细的翻译。

sentences.en: The topic of the text was a secret room below the tower.
sentences.zh: 这段文字的主题是塔下的一间密室。

sentences.en: It said a vertical shaft went straight down into the rock.
sentences.zh: 上面说有一条垂直的竖井直通岩石深处。

sentences.en: The story sounded unbelievable, but the map seemed valid.
sentences.zh: 这个故事听起来难以置信，但地图看起来是真实有效的。

sentences.en: Mei's tongue felt dry with pure excitement.
sentences.zh: 梅激动得舌头发干。

sentences.en: This was no longer a typical summer holiday.
sentences.zh: 这已经不再是一个普通的暑假了。

sentences.en: Uncle Wei warned them that old places could be dangerous.
sentences.zh: 魏叔叔警告他们，古老的地方可能很危险。

sentences.en: He agreed to help, unless the path proved too risky.
sentences.zh: 他同意帮忙，除非路途实在太危险。

sentences.en: They packed water, strong ropes, and a useful lamp.
sentences.zh: 他们带上了水、结实的绳子和一盏很有用的灯。

sentences.en: News travels fast in a small place like this.
sentences.zh: 在这样的小地方，消息传得很快。

sentences.en: Mr. Gao, the vice head of the village, heard about the map.
sentences.zh: 村里的副村长高先生听说了地图的事。

sentences.en: He was a tough man with one shiny gold tooth.
sentences.zh: 他是个强硬的人，长着一颗闪亮的金牙。

sentences.en: People said he cared about nothing but his own wage.
sentences.zh: 人们说他除了自己的工资什么都不关心。

sentences.en: He urged the twins to hand the map over at once.
sentences.zh: 他催促双胞胎立刻交出地图。

sentences.en: 'That is unfair,' Lin said in an upset voice.
sentences.zh: “这不公平，”林生气地说。

sentences.en: Mr. Gao tried a trick, claiming the tower was closed by law.
sentences.zh: 高先生耍了个花招，声称塔已被依法封闭。

sentences.en: But Uncle Wei knew the claim was completely useless.
sentences.zh: 但魏叔叔知道这种说法完全没用。

sentences.en: There was no rule against a simple tour of the hill.
sentences.zh: 没有任何规定禁止人们上山游览。

sentences.en: Still, they decided to move fast before more trouble arrived.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们还是决定在更多麻烦到来之前赶快行动。

sentences.en: At dawn they walked up the path in a thin mist.
sentences.zh: 黎明时分，他们在薄雾中沿小路上山。

sentences.en: The tower stood at the turning of the old stone road.
sentences.zh: 石塔立在古老石路的转弯处。

sentences.en: Its upper windows were dark, empty, and silent.
sentences.zh: 塔的上层窗户漆黑、空荡、寂静。

sentences.en: Inside, the narrow stairs made an uncomfortable climb.
sentences.zh: 塔内狭窄的楼梯爬起来很不舒服。

sentences.en: Behind a loose stone, Lin found a hole like a trap door.
sentences.zh: 在一块松动的石头后面，林发现了一个像活板门一样的洞口。

sentences.en: A rope ladder hung down into the darkness.
sentences.zh: 一条绳梯垂进黑暗之中。

sentences.en: The air below was cool and smelled of wet earth.
sentences.zh: 下面的空气凉凉的，带着湿土的气味。

sentences.en: Their lamp lit up a vast room cut into the rock.
sentences.zh: 灯光照亮了一间在岩石中开凿出来的巨大房间。

sentences.en: Water dripped somewhere, playing a soft, slow tune.
sentences.zh: 不知何处滴着水，奏出一支轻柔缓慢的曲子。

sentences.en: On one wall, someone had painted a picture of the universe.
sentences.zh: 一面墙上，有人画了一幅宇宙的图画。

sentences.en: Rows of small stone units, like open boxes, lined the far wall.
sentences.zh: 一排排像开口盒子一样的小石格排列在远处的墙边。

sentences.en: Inside them they found old coins and painted pots.
sentences.zh: 他们在石格里发现了古钱币和彩绘陶罐。

sentences.en: One box held a transparent stone that shone like ice.
sentences.zh: 一个盒子里放着一块像冰一样闪亮的透明宝石。

sentences.en: Everything in the room was clearly valuable.
sentences.zh: 房间里的每样东西显然都很贵重。

sentences.en: 'These things belong to everyone,' Uncle Wei said quietly.
sentences.zh: “这些东西属于所有人，”魏叔叔轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Art like this is universal; it speaks to all people.'
sentences.zh: “这样的艺术是全人类共通的，它能打动所有人。”

sentences.en: Mei reached out but was careful not to touch anything.
sentences.zh: 梅伸出手，却小心地不去碰任何东西。

sentences.en: Each object was unique and far too easy to break.
sentences.zh: 每件物品都是独一无二的，而且极易破碎。

sentences.en: Lin guessed the whole find weighed almost a ton.
sentences.zh: 林估计这批发现的东西差不多有一吨重。

sentences.en: They took photos as a visual record for the museum.
sentences.zh: 他们拍了照片，作为给博物馆的影像记录。

sentences.en: Then they climbed back up to share the amazing news.
sentences.zh: 然后他们爬回地面，去分享这个惊人的消息。

sentences.en: But at the top, a strange twist waited for them.
sentences.zh: 但在上面，一个意想不到的转折正等着他们。

sentences.en: Mr. Gao had secretly followed them up the hill.
sentences.zh: 高先生偷偷跟着他们上了山。

sentences.en: He was not a violent man, but he was greedy.
sentences.zh: 他不是个暴力的人，但他很贪心。

sentences.en: Without a word, he hurried down the rope ladder alone.
sentences.zh: 他一句话也没说，独自匆匆爬下绳梯。

sentences.en: Halfway down, the old rope broke under his weight.
sentences.zh: 爬到一半时，旧绳子承受不住他的重量断了。

sentences.en: He fell and became the only victim of his own greed.
sentences.zh: 他摔了下去，成了自己贪心的唯一受害者。

sentences.en: There was no violence, only an unfortunate accident.
sentences.zh: 这不是暴力事件，只是一场不幸的意外。

sentences.en: The twins called for help, because the matter was urgent.
sentences.zh: 情况紧急，双胞胎赶紧打电话求助。

sentences.en: An ambulance carried him to the small town hospital.
sentences.zh: 一辆救护车把他送到了镇上的小医院。

sentences.en: The family sat in the waiting-room for two long hours.
sentences.zh: 一家人在候诊室里坐了漫长的两个小时。

sentences.en: At last, a nurse in a white uniform led them to his ward.
sentences.zh: 终于，一位穿白色制服的护士把他们领到了他的病房。

sentences.en: Mr. Gao lay in bed, weak but very much alive.
sentences.zh: 高先生躺在床上，虽然虚弱，但活得好好的。

sentences.en: A doctor checked his throat and tested him for a common virus.
sentences.zh: 医生检查了他的喉咙，还给他做了常见病毒的检测。

sentences.en: In the end, it was just a broken leg, nothing more.
sentences.zh: 最后发现只是腿骨折了，没有别的问题。

sentences.en: Mr. Gao felt ashamed and said sorry to the twins.
sentences.zh: 高先生感到羞愧，向双胞胎道了歉。

sentences.en: 'I was blind to what is vital for our village,' he said.
sentences.zh: “我一直看不清什么才是对村子至关重要的东西，”他说。

sentences.en: From that day on, he offered his voluntary help to everyone.
sentences.zh: 从那天起，他开始主动义务帮助大家。

sentences.en: Slowly, the whole village began to transform.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，整个村庄开始发生转变。

sentences.en: A team of volunteers cleaned the tower and repaired the path.
sentences.zh: 一支志愿者队伍清理了石塔，修好了山路。

sentences.en: They even built a clean toilet for future visitors.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至为将来的游客修建了干净的厕所。

sentences.en: A bus company added new transport from the town.
sentences.zh: 一家公交公司增开了从镇上过来的新交通线路。

sentences.en: An update about the discovery soon appeared on the national news.
sentences.zh: 关于这次发现的最新消息很快出现在全国新闻上。

sentences.en: Soon every social media user seemed to know the story.
sentences.zh: 很快，每个社交媒体用户似乎都知道了这个故事。

sentences.en: In autumn, the village held its first traditional festival in years.
sentences.zh: 秋天，村里举办了多年来的第一次传统节日。

sentences.en: There was a rich variety of food, music, and dance.
sentences.zh: 节日上有丰富多样的美食、音乐和舞蹈。

sentences.en: A chess tournament was even held in the school yard.
sentences.zh: 学校操场上还举办了一场象棋锦标赛。

sentences.en: Lin played well and enjoyed a small victory in the final.
sentences.zh: 林发挥出色，在决赛中赢得了一场小小的胜利。

sentences.en: The museum opened the underground room for a trial period.
sentences.zh: 博物馆将地下密室试开放了一段时间。

sentences.en: Hundreds of guests came, which was unusual for the quiet valley.
sentences.zh: 数百名客人到来，这对宁静的山谷来说很不寻常。

sentences.en: Visiting the old tower soon became a popular trend online.
sentences.zh: 参观古塔很快成了网上的一股热门潮流。

sentences.en: Uncle Wei treated the twins to ice cream by the gate.
sentences.zh: 魏叔叔在大门口请双胞胎吃了冰激凌。

sentences.en: 'Not our usual summer,' Mei laughed, 'but the best one ever.'
sentences.zh: “这可不是我们平常的夏天，”梅笑着说，“但却是最棒的一个。”

sentences.en: The village had found its treasure, and something greater: hope.
sentences.zh: 村庄找到了它的宝藏，还找到了更宝贵的东西——希望。

articles.title: The Wheat Farm That Would Not Sell

sentences.en: Mei worked as an accountant in a busy city office.
sentences.zh: 梅在繁忙的城市写字楼里做会计。

sentences.en: Every weekend she added numbers until her wrist began to hurt.
sentences.zh: 每个周末她都要算账，直到手腕开始发疼。

sentences.en: Yesterday a letter arrived from her grandmother's village.
sentences.zh: 昨天，一封信从奶奶的村庄寄来。

sentences.en: Grandma Lin was a widow who lived alone on a wheat farm.
sentences.zh: 林奶奶是个寡妇，独自住在一座麦田农场上。

sentences.en: The old woman wrote that she felt weak and needed help.
sentences.zh: 老人在信中说她感到身体虚弱，需要帮助。

sentences.en: Mei was worried, so she packed a bag at once.
sentences.zh: 梅很担心，立刻收拾了行李。

sentences.en: She took an airplane the next morning, watching clouds through the small window.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上她坐上飞机，透过小窗看着云朵。

sentences.en: The plane climbed to a high altitude and crossed the national airspace.
sentences.zh: 飞机爬升到很高的高度，穿越了国家领空。

sentences.en: From above, the winter fields looked wide and empty.
sentences.zh: 从空中望去，冬天的田野显得宽阔而空旷。

sentences.en: When she landed, a cold wind touched her face.
sentences.zh: 落地时，一阵冷风拂过她的脸。

sentences.en: Grandma stood at the gate to welcome her with a warm hug.
sentences.zh: 奶奶站在门口，用一个温暖的拥抱欢迎她。

sentences.en: Her coat was old and worn, and her hands were rough.
sentences.zh: 奶奶的外套又旧又破，双手也很粗糙。

sentences.en: Still, her eyes were full of affection.
sentences.zh: 但她的眼里仍然充满慈爱。

sentences.en: Mei felt an ache in her heart when she saw how the farm had changed.
sentences.zh: 看到农场的变化，梅心里一阵酸痛。

sentences.en: Weeds grew in every corner of the yard.
sentences.zh: 院子的每个角落都长满了杂草。

sentences.en: A spider had built a web across the kitchen door.
sentences.zh: 一只蜘蛛在厨房门上结了一张网。

sentences.en: The wheel of the old cart lay broken in the wet mud.
sentences.zh: 旧推车的轮子断在湿泥里。

sentences.en: Grandma explained her trouble while they drank tea.
sentences.zh: 喝茶的时候，奶奶说起了自己的麻烦。

sentences.en: A wealthy businessman named Mr. Zhao wanted to buy her land.
sentences.zh: 一个叫赵先生的有钱商人想买下她的土地。

sentences.en: He planned to build a private zoo on the two hundred acres.
sentences.zh: 他打算在这两百英亩土地上建一座私人动物园。

sentences.en: His workers had already measured the fields without asking.
sentences.zh: 他的工人们没打招呼就已经来丈量了田地。

sentences.en: Grandma refused, but the pressure made her worry day and night.
sentences.zh: 奶奶拒绝了，但压力让她日夜担忧。

sentences.en: Mr. Zhao had accumulated great wealth over twenty years.
sentences.zh: 二十年来，赵先生积累了巨额财富。

sentences.en: He owned a famous factory that made red wine.
sentences.zh: 他拥有一家有名的红酒厂。

sentences.en: He put an advertisement in the weekly newspaper about his zoo project.
sentences.zh: 他在周报上登了一则关于动物园项目的广告。

sentences.en: He promised jobs wherever the village needed them.
sentences.zh: 他承诺村里哪里需要工作岗位，他就在哪里提供。

sentences.en: To Mei, the plan sounded absurd.
sentences.zh: 在梅看来，这个计划十分荒谬。

sentences.en: A private park would destroy the wild land where animals lived free.
sentences.zh: 私人园区会毁掉动物自由生活的野地。

sentences.en: Local wildlife, like deer and birds, would lose their home.
sentences.zh: 当地的野生动物，比如鹿和鸟，将失去家园。

sentences.en: Some people said a wolf still lived in the far woods.
sentences.zh: 有人说远处的树林里还住着一只狼。

sentences.en: Mei decided to study the sale contract carefully.
sentences.zh: 梅决定仔细研究那份买卖合同。

sentences.en: Numbers, after all, were never her weakness.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，数字从来不是她的弱项。

sentences.en: She discovered how he planned to allocate the money.
sentences.zh: 她发现了他打算如何分配这笔钱。

sentences.en: Almost zero was set aside for animal welfare.
sentences.zh: 用于动物福利的钱几乎为零。

sentences.en: The contract also let him withdraw his promises at any time.
sentences.zh: 合同还允许他随时撤回承诺。

sentences.en: Reading it aloud to Grandma, Mei shook her head.
sentences.zh: 梅把合同大声读给奶奶听，一边摇着头。

sentences.en: It was a wise old lawyer, an acquaintance of Grandma's, who confirmed her fears.
sentences.zh: 一位睿智的老律师——奶奶的一位熟人——证实了她的担心。

sentences.en: He said the deal was a waste of good farmland.
sentences.zh: 他说这笔交易是对良田的浪费。

sentences.en: That evening the village held a meeting in the hall.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，村里在礼堂开了会。

sentences.en: Mr. Zhao arrived in a shiny yellow car.
sentences.zh: 赵先生开着一辆闪亮的黄色轿车来了。

sentences.en: He began to advertise his plan with big colorful pictures.
sentences.zh: 他开始用巨大的彩色图片宣传他的计划。

sentences.en: He said doubt about the project was abnormal and foolish.
sentences.zh: 他说对这个项目的怀疑既反常又愚蠢。

sentences.en: Then, in an abrupt turn, he accused Grandma of blocking progress.
sentences.zh: 接着他话锋突然一转，指责奶奶阻碍发展。

sentences.en: Mei stood up, though her voice shook a little.
sentences.zh: 梅站了起来，尽管声音有点发抖。

sentences.en: She showed the numbers to everyone in the room.
sentences.zh: 她把那些数字展示给在场的每一个人看。

sentences.en: The farmers were amazed by what the contract really said.
sentences.zh: 农民们对合同的真实内容感到震惊。

sentences.en: Many were willing to stand with Grandma after that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上之后，许多人愿意站在奶奶这一边。

sentences.en: The next morning brought rainy weather and gray clouds.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上是阴雨天气，乌云密布。

sentences.en: Mei walked along a narrow alley behind the barn.
sentences.zh: 梅沿着谷仓后面的一条窄巷走着。

sentences.en: There she witnessed something surprising.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她目睹了令人吃惊的一幕。

sentences.en: A young eagle lay on the ground with a broken wing.
sentences.zh: 一只翅膀受伤的小鹰躺在地上。

sentences.en: There was a deep wound on its leg, caught by a wire.
sentences.zh: 它的腿被铁丝缠住，留下了一道很深的伤口。

sentences.en: Mei wrapped the bird gently and carried it home.
sentences.zh: 梅轻轻裹住这只鸟，把它带回了家。

sentences.en: The vet in town took an x-ray and cleaned the small cut.
sentences.zh: 镇上的兽医给它拍了X光片，清理了伤口。

sentences.en: He said the bird was strong and would fly again.
sentences.zh: 他说这只鸟很强壮，还能再次飞翔。

sentences.en: Mei posted the eagle's story online that night.
sentences.zh: 当晚，梅把小鹰的故事发到了网上。

sentences.en: The story became widespread within days.
sentences.zh: 几天之内，这个故事就广泛传开了。

sentences.en: People worldwide sent messages of support for the small farm.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的人们发来消息，支持这个小农场。

sentences.en: An animal group offered to protect the zone around the trees.
sentences.zh: 一个动物保护组织提出要保护树林周围的区域。

sentences.en: Reporters came whenever something new happened.
sentences.zh: 每当有新的进展，记者们就会赶来。

sentences.en: One reporter, whom Mei had met in college, wrote a long article.
sentences.zh: 一位梅在大学时认识的记者写了一篇长文。

sentences.en: It described Grandma's admirable courage and quiet wisdom.
sentences.zh: 文章描写了奶奶令人敬佩的勇气和沉静的智慧。

sentences.en: Everyone began to admire the old woman who refused to sell.
sentences.zh: 大家开始敬佩这位拒绝卖地的老人。

sentences.en: Mr. Zhao saw that public opinion had turned against him.
sentences.zh: 赵先生看到舆论已经转向对他不利。

sentences.en: He could not adapt to the new situation.
sentences.zh: 他无法适应新的局面。

sentences.en: In the end, the county decided to abolish the building plan completely.
sentences.zh: 最终，县里决定彻底废除这项建设计划。

sentences.en: Afterward, Mr. Zhao quietly left the village.
sentences.zh: 之后，赵先生悄悄离开了村庄。

sentences.en: Mei felt like a winner, but she stayed humble.
sentences.zh: 梅觉得自己像个胜利者，但她依然谦逊。

sentences.en: She wiped the dust from the old kitchen table and smiled.
sentences.zh: 她擦去旧厨桌上的灰尘，笑了。

sentences.en: Victory, she thought, belonged to the whole village.
sentences.zh: 她想，胜利属于整个村庄。

sentences.en: Spring came, and Mei made a big adjustment in her life.
sentences.zh: 春天来了，梅对自己的生活做了一个重大调整。

sentences.en: She left her city job and grew accustomed to farm mornings.
sentences.zh: 她辞掉了城里的工作，渐渐习惯了农场的清晨。

sentences.en: She started teaching children at the small village school.
sentences.zh: 她开始在村里的小学校教孩子们。

sentences.en: The little ones learned the alphabet, and the older ones studied algebra.
sentences.zh: 小孩子们学字母表，大孩子们学代数。

sentences.en: One adolescent boy, Tao, was addicted to phone games.
sentences.zh: 一个叫涛的青少年男孩沉迷于手机游戏。

sentences.en: His father was an alcoholic who was often absent from home.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲是个酒鬼，经常不在家。

sentences.en: Mei gave Tao a small allowance for helping on the farm.
sentences.zh: 梅给涛一点零用钱，让他在农场帮忙。

sentences.en: Slowly the boy began to absorb knowledge like dry soil takes in rain.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，这个男孩开始像干涸的土壤吸收雨水一样吸收知识。

sentences.en: Adolescence is a hard road, but Tao changed that summer.
sentences.zh: 青春期是条艰难的路，但那个夏天涛变了。

sentences.en: His progress seemed to accelerate week by week.
sentences.zh: 他的进步似乎一周比一周快。

sentences.en: He would accompany Mei to the fields after class.
sentences.zh: 放学后，他常常陪梅一起去田里。

sentences.en: The harvest that year was abundant, filling every basket.
sentences.zh: 那一年收成丰盛，装满了每一个篮子。

sentences.en: Only one problem appeared: Tao was allergic to the flower dust.
sentences.zh: 只出现了一个问题：涛对花粉过敏。

sentences.en: So Mei let him wear a simple mask while working.
sentences.zh: 于是梅让他干活时戴上一个简单的口罩。

sentences.en: Grandma grew stronger and began to adore the busy new life.
sentences.zh: 奶奶的身体越来越好，开始热爱这忙碌的新生活。

sentences.en: In her youth, she said, the farm had been just as alive.
sentences.zh: 她说，在她年轻的时候，农场也是这般生机勃勃。

sentences.en: A year later, wonderful news arrived at the farm.
sentences.zh: 一年后，农场迎来了美妙的消息。

sentences.en: Mei was going to marry the young vet who had saved the eagle.
sentences.zh: 梅要和那位救过小鹰的年轻兽医结婚了。

sentences.en: The wedding was held under the tall trees by the field.
sentences.zh: 婚礼在田边的大树下举行。

sentences.en: Guests came from far away, waving as they walked up the road.
sentences.zh: 客人们从远方赶来，一边沿路走来一边挥手。

sentences.en: Grandma held Mei's hand and said, 'This land is now yours.'
sentences.zh: 奶奶握着梅的手说："这片土地现在是你的了。"

sentences.en: 'You have proved yourself worthy of it.'
sentences.zh: "你已经证明自己配得上它。"

sentences.en: Mei looked at the golden fields and felt a quiet wonder.
sentences.zh: 梅望着金色的田野，心中涌起一种静静的惊叹。

sentences.en: The eagle, healthy again, flew high above the happy crowd.
sentences.zh: 那只康复的鹰在欢乐的人群上空高高飞翔。

sentences.en: Sometimes, she thought, the best riches are the home you fight to keep.
sentences.zh: 她想，有时候最好的财富，就是你努力守护的家园。

articles.title: The Star Festival at Grandpa's Bungalow

sentences.en: Last June, sixteen-year-old Lin took a train to his grandfather's small town.
sentences.zh: 去年六月，十六岁的林坐火车去了爷爷所在的小镇。

sentences.en: The town was his mother's birthplace, quiet and full of green hills.
sentences.zh: 那座小镇是他妈妈的出生地，安静宁和，青山环绕。

sentences.en: At the station he found a cab and gave the driver the address.
sentences.zh: 在车站，他找了一辆出租车，把地址递给了司机。

sentences.en: His baggage was heavy because he had packed too many books.
sentences.zh: 他的行李很重，因为装了太多书。

sentences.en: Grandpa Wei lived in a white bungalow at the end of a narrow lane.
sentences.zh: 魏爷爷住在一条窄巷尽头的白色平房里。

sentences.en: An old bicycle leaned against the gate, and a small dog began to bark.
sentences.zh: 一辆旧自行车靠在门边，一只小狗叫了起来。

sentences.en: Grandpa hurried out, a little bent with age, but his eyes were bright.
sentences.zh: 爷爷急忙走出来，年纪大了背有些驼，但眼睛依然明亮。

sentences.en: "Welcome home," he said, and Lin suddenly felt warm inside.
sentences.zh: “欢迎回家。”他说，林的心里忽然暖暖的。

sentences.en: Grandpa Wei had been a famous astronomer before he retired.
sentences.zh: 魏爷爷退休前是一位著名的天文学家。

sentences.en: Even now, he loved astronomy more than anything else in the world.
sentences.zh: 即使现在，他仍然爱天文学胜过世上的一切。

sentences.en: In the living room, a soft armchair stood beside an antique telescope.
sentences.zh: 客厅里，一把柔软的扶手椅立在一架古董望远镜旁。

sentences.en: On the balcony, boxes of old cassette tapes held his early lectures.
sentences.zh: 阳台上，一箱箱旧磁带录着他早年的讲课。

sentences.en: He was writing a biography of his teacher, who had once worked in the Antarctic.
sentences.zh: 他正在为自己的老师写传记，老师曾在南极工作过。

sentences.en: The appendix of the book listed every star his teacher had studied.
sentences.zh: 书的附录列出了老师研究过的每一颗星。

sentences.en: That evening, Grandpa shared an anecdote about meeting an astronaut in 1985.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，爷爷讲了一件轶事：他在1985年见过一位宇航员。

sentences.en: "He told me space smells like a burned biscuit," Grandpa laughed.
sentences.zh: “他告诉我，太空闻起来像烤糊的饼干。”爷爷笑着说。

sentences.en: Lin listened with such amusement that he forgot to check his phone.
sentences.zh: 林听得津津有味，连手机都忘了看。

sentences.en: That summer, the town was planning a big star festival.
sentences.zh: 那年夏天，小镇正在筹备一场盛大的观星节。

sentences.en: The mayor decided to appoint Grandpa as the chief organizer.
sentences.zh: 镇长决定任命爷爷为总负责人。

sentences.en: The process was slow and bureaucratic, and new forms arrived every day.
sentences.zh: 整个流程缓慢又官僚，每天都有新的表格寄来。

sentences.en: The endless paperwork began to annoy Lin, but Grandpa stayed patient.
sentences.zh: 没完没了的文书工作让林开始烦躁，爷爷却始终耐心。

sentences.en: Every volunteer applicant had to attach a photo to a short letter.
sentences.zh: 每位志愿者申请人都要在短信里附上一张照片。

sentences.en: Some of the rules seemed arbitrary, yet nobody dared to change them.
sentences.zh: 有些规定看起来很随意，但没人敢去更改。

sentences.en: Grandpa drew his plan on a blackboard in the school canteen.
sentences.zh: 爷爷在学校食堂的黑板上画出了他的计划。

sentences.en: Lin designed a colourful brochure and wrote a caption under every picture.
sentences.zh: 林设计了一本彩色宣传册，并在每张图片下写了说明文字。

sentences.en: Whenever a new problem would arise, Grandpa simply smiled at it.
sentences.zh: 每当出现新问题，爷爷只是笑笑面对。

sentences.en: "We have ample time," he said, "as long as we work together."
sentences.zh: “只要我们齐心协力，”他说，“时间就绰绰有余。”

sentences.en: The next morning, they visited the little shops on Main Street.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他们走访了主街上的小店铺。

sentences.en: The bakery agreed to make sweet bread shaped like stars.
sentences.zh: 面包店答应做星星形状的甜面包。

sentences.en: The butcher promised fresh meat for a big barbecue.
sentences.zh: 肉店老板答应为大型烧烤会提供新鲜的肉。

sentences.en: The barber put a festival poster in his shining window.
sentences.zh: 理发师在他明亮的橱窗里贴上了节日海报。

sentences.en: The small brewery offered free fruit drinks for the children.
sentences.zh: 小酿酒厂愿意为孩子们免费提供果汁饮料。

sentences.en: A kind carpenter said he would build the wooden stage himself.
sentences.zh: 一位善良的木匠说他要亲自搭建木舞台。

sentences.en: At the market, Lin helped Grandpa bargain for boxes of cabbage.
sentences.zh: 在市场上，林帮爷爷讨价还价，买了几箱卷心菜。

sentences.en: They also bought carrots, beans, and rice for the soup.
sentences.zh: 他们还买了胡萝卜、豆子和大米，用来煮汤。

sentences.en: Finally, a rich businessman named Mr. Qian promised money for the fireworks.
sentences.zh: 最后，一位名叫钱先生的富商答应出钱买烟花。

sentences.en: The days before the festival were busy but happy.
sentences.zh: 节日前的日子忙碌而快乐。

sentences.en: Each morning, Lin did arithmetic exercises before breakfast.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，林在早饭前做算术练习。

sentences.en: Afterward, he and Grandpa played badminton in the yard.
sentences.zh: 之后，他和爷爷在院子里打羽毛球。

sentences.en: On Sundays they enjoyed a slow brunch under the bamboo trees.
sentences.zh: 每逢周日，他们在竹林下悠闲地吃早午餐。

sentences.en: Grandpa wore a blue apron and liked to boil sweet soup.
sentences.zh: 爷爷系着蓝色围裙，喜欢煮甜汤。

sentences.en: Lin swept the floor with a broom and watched a line of ants march past.
sentences.zh: 林用扫帚扫地，看着一队蚂蚁从旁边爬过。

sentences.en: In the evening he liked to bathe in the deep white bathtub.
sentences.zh: 晚上，他喜欢在深深的白色浴缸里泡澡。

sentences.en: Uncle Chen, a cheerful bachelor from next door, often came for dinner.
sentences.zh: 隔壁开朗的单身汉陈叔叔常来一起吃晚饭。

sentences.en: One night, a butterfly landed on Grandpa's open book about botany.
sentences.zh: 一天夜里，一只蝴蝶落在爷爷摊开的植物学书上。

sentences.en: "Plants and stars," Grandpa said, "are both worth our attention."
sentences.zh: “植物和星星，”爷爷说，“都值得我们用心去看。”

sentences.en: Then, three days before the festival, trouble arrived.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在节日前三天，麻烦来了。

sentences.en: A burglar broke into the house while they were out shopping.
sentences.zh: 他们外出买东西时，一个窃贼闯进了家里。

sentences.en: He stole the telescope and Grandpa's old star catalogue.
sentences.zh: 他偷走了望远镜和爷爷那本旧的星表目录。

sentences.en: For the festival, this was close to a catastrophe.
sentences.zh: 对观星节来说，这几乎是一场大灾难。

sentences.en: Grandpa sat down slowly, and his hands would not stop shaking.
sentences.zh: 爷爷缓缓坐下，双手止不住地颤抖。

sentences.en: "Someone careless left the back door open," the police officer said.
sentences.zh: “有人粗心大意，把后门开着。”警察说。

sentences.en: Lin's face turned red, for it was he who had forgotten to lock it.
sentences.zh: 林的脸红了，因为忘记锁门的正是他。

sentences.en: He felt he had betrayed his grandfather's trust completely.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己彻底辜负了爷爷的信任。

sentences.en: "Anyhow, blaming yourself will not bring it back," Grandpa said gently.
sentences.zh: “不管怎样，自责也换不回望远镜。”爷爷温和地说。

sentences.en: That night, neither of them had any appetite for dinner.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，他们俩谁都没有胃口吃晚饭。

sentences.en: The next day, Lin decided to analyse every clue by himself.
sentences.zh: 第二天，林决定亲自分析每一条线索。

sentences.en: The footprints near the gate were ambiguous in the soft mud.
sentences.zh: 门口软泥里的脚印模糊不清，难以辨认。

sentences.en: Still, he tried to calculate the size of the thief's shoes.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他还是试着计算小偷鞋子的尺码。

sentences.en: An old lady in a flowered blouse said she had seen a stranger that morning.
sentences.zh: 一位穿花衬衫的老太太说，那天早上她见过一个陌生人。

sentences.en: The man had glanced backward twice before running toward the botanical garden.
sentences.zh: 那人向后张望了两次，然后朝植物园跑去。

sentences.en: Lin followed the trail with great caution.
sentences.zh: 林小心翼翼地沿着踪迹追去。

sentences.en: Near the garden pond, he found fresh earth, as if someone had tried to bury a box.
sentences.zh: 在园中的池塘边，他发现了新翻的泥土，好像有人埋过一个箱子。

sentences.en: He dug carefully and pulled out the old star list, wrapped in plastic.
sentences.zh: 他小心地挖开，取出了那本用塑料包着的旧星表。

sentences.en: "Bingo!" he shouted, though his heart was beating like a drum.
sentences.zh: “找到了！”他喊道，尽管心跳得像打鼓一样。

sentences.en: He grew cautious again, because the thief might still be near.
sentences.zh: 他又警觉起来，因为小偷可能还在附近。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a man jumped out from behind a tall tree.
sentences.zh: 突然，一个男人从大树后面跳了出来。

sentences.en: It was Mr. Qian's driver, holding the telescope like a baby.
sentences.zh: 正是钱先生的司机，他像抱婴儿一样抱着望远镜。

sentences.en: Lin chased him along the river path until he was breathless.
sentences.zh: 林沿着河边小路追他，追得上气不接下气。

sentences.en: The man's bike had a broken brake, and he crashed into a fence.
sentences.zh: 那人的车闸坏了，一头撞上了栅栏。

sentences.en: He twisted his ankle, and his arm started to bleed.
sentences.zh: 他扭伤了脚踝，胳膊也流血了。

sentences.en: Though afraid, Lin showed real bravery and stayed to help him.
sentences.zh: 尽管害怕，林还是表现出真正的勇敢，留下来帮助他。

sentences.en: Later, a doctor wrapped the man's arm with a clean bandage.
sentences.zh: 后来，医生用干净的绷带包扎了那人的胳膊。

sentences.en: At the hospital cafeteria, the driver quietly told them the truth.
sentences.zh: 在医院的自助餐厅里，司机低声说出了实情。

sentences.en: Mr. Qian, who collected old instruments, had paid him to steal the telescope.
sentences.zh: 收藏旧仪器的钱先生花钱雇他去偷望远镜。

sentences.en: Angry neighbours wanted to boycott every shop the rich man owned.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的邻居们想抵制这位富商名下的所有商店。

sentences.en: But Grandpa only said, "Return what you took, apologize, and learn."
sentences.zh: 但爷爷只说：“把东西还回来，道个歉，吸取教训。”

sentences.en: On festival night, the whole town gathered in the square.
sentences.zh: 观星节当晚，全镇的人都聚集到了广场上。

sentences.en: Hundreds of balloons floated up, and a candle glowed in every window.
sentences.zh: 数百个气球升上天空，每扇窗户里都点着一支蜡烛。

sentences.en: A white horse pulled an old carriage slowly through the crowd.
sentences.zh: 一匹白马拉着一辆旧马车缓缓穿过人群。

sentences.en: Girls from the dance school performed a short, lovely ballet.
sentences.zh: 舞蹈学校的女孩们表演了一段短小而优美的芭蕾。

sentences.en: The buffet tables were full, and volunteers worked hard to cater to every guest.
sentences.zh: 自助餐桌上摆得满满的，志愿者们尽力招待每一位客人。

sentences.en: The smell of roasting meat made everyone hungry.
sentences.zh: 烤肉的香味让每个人都饿了。

sentences.en: A local craftsman had carved a wooden camel for the children to ride.
sentences.zh: 当地一位手艺人雕了一只木骆驼，让孩子们骑着玩。

sentences.en: An old monk who studied Buddhism gave a quiet blessing for peace.
sentences.zh: 一位研习佛教的老僧人为大家静静地祈福平安。

sentences.en: When Grandpa pointed the telescope at Mars, the crowd began to applaud.
sentences.zh: 当爷爷把望远镜对准火星时，人群响起了掌声。

sentences.en: Mr. Qian stood before them all, apologized deeply, and returned everything.
sentences.zh: 钱先生站在众人面前深深道歉，归还了所有东西。

sentences.en: Late that night, Lin and Grandpa sat alone under the stars.
sentences.zh: 深夜，林和爷爷单独坐在星空下。

sentences.en: "My ambition was never fame," Grandpa said softly.
sentences.zh: “我的志向从来不是名声。”爷爷轻声说。

sentences.en: "I only wanted people to look up and feel amazed."
sentences.zh: “我只想让人们抬起头，感到惊叹。”

sentences.en: He talked about the atom, and about new discoveries in biochemistry.
sentences.zh: 他谈起了原子，也谈起了生物化学的新发现。

sentences.en: "Science is waiting for another breakthrough, and it will come from your generation."
sentences.zh: “科学在等待下一次突破，而它将来自你们这一代。”

sentences.en: "Someday, an autonomous ship may carry a capsule of seeds to another world."
sentences.zh: “总有一天，一艘自主飞行的飞船会带着一个装满种子的太空舱去往另一个世界。”

sentences.en: "Our ancestors watched these same stars long ago," Lin answered.
sentences.zh: “很久以前，我们的祖先也看过这些星星。”林回答。

sentences.en: "Then we must not fail them," Grandpa smiled.
sentences.zh: “那我们就不能辜负他们。”爷爷微笑着说。

sentences.en: Years later, Lin worked hard and finally attained his own dream of becoming a scientist.
sentences.zh: 多年以后，林努力奋斗，终于实现了成为科学家的梦想。

sentences.en: Whenever life felt heavy, the memory of that bright summer would amuse and comfort him.
sentences.zh: 每当生活沉重时，那个明亮夏天的回忆总会逗乐他、安慰他。

articles.title: The Winter Choir of Riverside School
articles.topic: 乡村学校的冬季音乐节

sentences.en: Lin Hai studied at a small school deep in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 林海在乡村深处的一所小学校读书。

sentences.en: His dorm stood beside a quiet river full of tall grass.
sentences.zh: 他的宿舍坐落在一条长满高草的静静河边。

sentences.en: Every morning he ran downstairs before the first bell rang.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，第一遍铃声响起前，他就跑下楼去。

sentences.en: That autumn the sky was often cloudy and grey.
sentences.zh: 那年秋天，天空常常阴沉灰暗。

sentences.en: The classroom walls felt damp after weeks of soft rain.
sentences.zh: 连绵几周的细雨过后，教室的墙壁摸上去很潮湿。

sentences.en: His best classmate, Xiao Yu, always arrived first.
sentences.zh: 他最好的同学小雨总是第一个到校。

sentences.en: She was a cheerful girl who smiled at everyone.
sentences.zh: 她是个开朗的女孩，见谁都笑眯眯的。

sentences.en: Their teacher, Mr. Fang, wrote the day's plan in white chalk.
sentences.zh: 他们的老师方老师用白色粉笔写下当天的计划。

sentences.en: He liked to classify his students by their talents, not their grades.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢按天赋而不是分数来给学生分类。

sentences.en: Kindness, he said, was the most important characteristic of a good school.
sentences.zh: 他说，善良是一所好学校最重要的特征。

sentences.en: That year the school decided to hold a winter music festival.
sentences.zh: 那一年，学校决定举办一场冬季音乐节。

sentences.en: Every class had to send singers to the school choir.
sentences.zh: 每个班都要选出歌手加入校合唱团。

sentences.en: Mr. Fang trained them and acted as the conductor.
sentences.zh: 方老师负责训练他们，并担任指挥。

sentences.en: At first the chorus sounded weak and uneven.
sentences.zh: 起初，合唱听起来又弱又不整齐。

sentences.en: The students would chant the same lines again and again.
sentences.zh: 学生们把同样的歌词一遍又一遍地反复吟唱。

sentences.en: Old Grandpa Chen, who was almost deaf, still came to listen.
sentences.zh: 几乎失聪的陈爷爷仍然每次都来听。

sentences.en: He would clap slowly whenever the song ended.
sentences.zh: 每当歌曲结束，他都会慢慢地鼓掌。

sentences.en: One cold evening, Lin Hai began to cough in the middle of a song.
sentences.zh: 一个寒冷的傍晚，林海唱到一半开始咳嗽。

sentences.en: He drank water too fast and almost began to choke.
sentences.zh: 他喝水太急，差点呛住了。

sentences.en: Even so, singing filled him with a quiet delight.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，唱歌仍让他心里充满一种安静的喜悦。

sentences.en: Everyone could see Mr. Fang's deep devotion to the choir.
sentences.zh: 所有人都能看出方老师对合唱团深深的热爱与奉献。

sentences.en: Lin Hai's other favourite teacher was Mr. Wu.
sentences.zh: 林海另一位最喜欢的老师是吴老师。

sentences.en: Before teaching, Mr. Wu had worked as a chemist in the city.
sentences.zh: 在教书之前，吴老师曾在城里当化学师。

sentences.en: In class he explained how plants take in carbon dioxide.
sentences.zh: 课堂上，他讲解植物如何吸收二氧化碳。

sentences.en: He drew a clear diagram on the board to show the process.
sentences.zh: 他在黑板上画了一张清晰的示意图来展示这个过程。

sentences.en: His lessons improved everyone's comprehension of science.
sentences.zh: 他的课提高了大家对科学的理解力。

sentences.en: If a question was hard, he would clarify it with simple examples.
sentences.zh: 如果问题太难，他就用简单的例子来澄清。

sentences.en: He never let a difficult word confuse his students for long.
sentences.zh: 他从不让一个难词把学生困惑太久。

sentences.en: Effort, not memory, was his criterion for a good learner.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，衡量好学生的标准是努力，而不是记忆力。

sentences.en: When Lin Hai made a mistake, Mr. Wu wrote a gentle correction in red.
sentences.zh: 林海出错时，吴老师会用红笔温和地写下订正。

sentences.en: Science was compulsory, but nobody wanted to miss his class anyway.
sentences.zh: 科学课虽然是必修的，但本来也没人愿意缺他的课。

sentences.en: Slowly, Lin Hai's competence in chemistry grew.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，林海的化学能力提高了。

sentences.en: On weekends, Lin Hai walked home to his grandfather's house.
sentences.zh: 每到周末，林海都步行回爷爷家。

sentences.en: The old kitchen had a small gas cooker in the corner.
sentences.zh: 老厨房的角落里有一个小小的燃气灶。

sentences.en: A wooden cupboard held cups, bowls, and a jar of sugar.
sentences.zh: 一个木碗橱里放着杯子、碗和一罐糖。

sentences.en: Grandfather loved simple country cuisine, like cabbage soup with carrots.
sentences.zh: 爷爷喜欢简单的乡村菜肴，比如加胡萝卜的卷心菜汤。

sentences.en: For dessert, he always made sweet rice balls.
sentences.zh: 甜点他总是做甜汤圆。

sentences.en: Lin Hai would chew them slowly to enjoy the taste.
sentences.zh: 林海会慢慢咀嚼，细细品味。

sentences.en: Grandfather said slow eating helped the body digest food well.
sentences.zh: 爷爷说吃得慢有助于身体消化食物。

sentences.en: On rainy nights they drank hot cocoa by the fire.
sentences.zh: 下雨的夜晚，他们就在炉火旁喝热可可。

sentences.en: The little room felt warm and cosy.
sentences.zh: 小屋里温暖而舒适。

sentences.en: Lin Hai liked to sit on a soft cushion near the window.
sentences.zh: 林海喜欢坐在窗边一个柔软的坐垫上。

sentences.en: A blue curtain kept out the cold wind.
sentences.zh: 一幅蓝色的窗帘挡住了寒风。

sentences.en: Grandfather had worked for forty years as the town dentist.
sentences.zh: 爷爷在镇上当了四十年的牙医。

sentences.en: After dinner he sometimes held an old cigar, though he never lit it anymore.
sentences.zh: 晚饭后，他有时会拿着一支旧雪茄，不过再也不点燃了。

sentences.en: He and Lin Hai often played chess until late.
sentences.zh: 他和林海经常下国际象棋下到很晚。

sentences.en: When Lin Hai won, the old man would pat his cheek and laugh.
sentences.zh: 林海赢了的时候，老人会拍拍他的脸颊哈哈大笑。

sentences.en: Every morning he ran a wooden comb through his white hair.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他都用一把木梳梳理满头白发。

sentences.en: People in town remembered many a kind deed he had done.
sentences.zh: 镇上的人们记得他做过的许多善举。

sentences.en: He was considerate to poor patients and often treated them for free.
sentences.zh: 他对贫困的病人体贴周到，常常免费为他们看病。

sentences.en: One evening, Lin Hai saw him dial a long number on the old phone.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，林海看见他用旧电话拨了一长串号码。

sentences.en: He had found it in a thin school directory.
sentences.zh: 那号码是他从一本薄薄的学校通讯录里找到的。

sentences.en: The cozy room grew quiet as Grandfather spoke softly about money.
sentences.zh: 温馨的房间安静下来，爷爷低声谈起了钱的事。

sentences.en: The next week, strange news spread through the school.
sentences.zh: 第二周，一个奇怪的消息在学校里传开了。

sentences.en: Someone had sent the festival a large cheque with no name on it.
sentences.zh: 有人给音乐节寄来一张没有署名的大额支票。

sentences.en: The head teacher kept the letter confidential.
sentences.zh: 校长对那封信保密。

sentences.en: But one of Mr. Fang's colleagues saw the envelope on the desk.
sentences.zh: 但方老师的一位同事在桌上看到了那个信封。

sentences.en: Soon a rumor began to circulate among the students.
sentences.zh: 很快，一个谣言开始在学生中流传。

sentences.en: Some said Mr. Fang had taken school money and now wanted to compensate for it.
sentences.zh: 有人说方老师拿过学校的钱，现在想要补偿回来。

sentences.en: The circumstance looked bad, though no one had any proof.
sentences.zh: 情况看上去很糟，尽管没有人有任何证据。

sentences.en: Lin Hai faced a painful dilemma.
sentences.zh: 林海陷入了痛苦的两难境地。

sentences.en: He knew the truth, for he had watched Grandfather post the letter.
sentences.zh: 他知道真相，因为他亲眼看见爷爷寄出了那封信。

sentences.en: His conscience told him to speak, but Grandfather wanted to stay unknown.
sentences.zh: 良心让他开口，可爷爷希望不留名。

sentences.en: It felt wrong to condemn a good teacher with silence.
sentences.zh: 用沉默去指责一位好老师，这让他觉得不对。

sentences.en: Worse, the students began to contradict each other about the story.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，学生们对这件事的说法开始互相矛盾。

sentences.en: On Friday, something happened that changed everything.
sentences.zh: 周五，发生了一件改变一切的事。

sentences.en: A young cyclist raced down the wet hill near the school.
sentences.zh: 一个年轻的骑车人沿着学校附近湿滑的山坡飞驰而下。

sentences.en: At the crossroads, he could not stop in time.
sentences.zh: 到了十字路口，他没能及时刹住。

sentences.en: There was a loud collision with the school gate.
sentences.zh: 他重重地撞上了学校大门。

sentences.en: The boy was clumsy from fear and fell into the mud.
sentences.zh: 男孩吓得手脚笨拙，跌进了泥里。

sentences.en: He stood up slowly, feeling dizzy and pale.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢站起来，头晕目眩，脸色苍白。

sentences.en: A cat by the gate raised one claw and ran away in fright.
sentences.zh: 门边的一只猫举起爪子，吓得跑开了。

sentences.en: The school cleaner heard the noise and hurried over.
sentences.zh: 学校的清洁工听到声音，急忙赶了过来。

sentences.en: It was the head teacher's son, carrying a small compass and a bag of letters.
sentences.zh: 原来是校长的儿子，他带着一个小指南针和一袋信件。

sentences.en: Lin Hai helped him inside, careful not to disturb his hurt arm.
sentences.zh: 林海扶他进屋，小心不去碰他受伤的手臂。

sentences.en: Among the letters was a note that could dismiss all the rumors.
sentences.zh: 信件中有一张便条，足以打消所有谣言。

sentences.en: It was from Grandfather, thanking the school for its music.
sentences.zh: 那是爷爷写的，感谢学校带来的音乐。

sentences.en: The truth came out gently, and the school turned back to the festival.
sentences.zh: 真相温和地揭开了，学校重新投入到音乐节的准备中。

sentences.en: Everyone worked together to decorate the great hall.
sentences.zh: 大家齐心协力装饰大礼堂。

sentences.en: Xiao Yu drew bright stars with a red crayon.
sentences.zh: 小雨用红色蜡笔画出明亮的星星。

sentences.en: The art class helped construct a small wooden stage.
sentences.zh: 美术班帮忙搭建了一个小木舞台。

sentences.en: A local carpenter cut each cube of wood for the steps.
sentences.zh: 本地的一位木匠为台阶切好每一块方木。

sentences.en: Mr. Wu even calculated the cubic space of the hall for the lights.
sentences.zh: 吴老师甚至为布置灯光计算了礼堂的立体空间。

sentences.en: In the courtyard, students hung paper lamps from the trees.
sentences.zh: 院子里，学生们把纸灯笼挂到树上。

sentences.en: Teachers began to distribute tickets to every family in town.
sentences.zh: 老师们开始把票分发给镇上的每一户人家。

sentences.en: Mr. Fang continued to dedicate every free hour to practice.
sentences.zh: 方老师继续把每一个空闲的小时都投入到排练中。

sentences.en: The singers promised to devote themselves fully to the final song.
sentences.zh: 歌手们保证全身心投入最后一首歌。

sentences.en: Each decoration carried a small written wish for winter.
sentences.zh: 每一件装饰品上都写着一个小小的冬日心愿。

sentences.en: Still, one problem remained inside the choir.
sentences.zh: 不过，合唱团内部还剩下一个问题。

sentences.en: A sharp disagreement grew about which song to sing last.
sentences.zh: 关于最后唱哪首歌，产生了激烈的分歧。

sentences.en: The two ideas seemed completely contradictory.
sentences.zh: 两种想法看起来完全对立。

sentences.en: Choosing one would surely disappoint half the group.
sentences.zh: 选其中一首，肯定会让一半人失望。

sentences.en: Mr. Fang refused to let the argument discourage anyone.
sentences.zh: 方老师不许这场争论让任何人泄气。

sentences.en: He said it was natural to dislike a song at first and love it later.
sentences.zh: 他说，一首歌起初不喜欢、后来爱上，是很自然的事。

sentences.en: Every choice has some disadvantage, he explained calmly.
sentences.zh: 他平静地解释道，每个选择都有缺点。

sentences.en: Words alone could not convey what music could.
sentences.zh: 光靠语言无法传达音乐所能表达的东西。

sentences.en: So he asked the choir to consult Grandpa Chen, their oldest listener.
sentences.zh: 于是他让合唱团去请教他们最年长的听众——陈爷爷。

sentences.en: Grandpa Chen had seen wars and floods, and had even studied communism in his youth.
sentences.zh: 陈爷爷经历过战争和洪水，年轻时甚至研究过共产主义。

sentences.en: After listening twice, he helped them conclude that both songs could be joined into one.
sentences.zh: 听了两遍后，他帮大家得出结论：两首歌可以合而为一。

sentences.en: The night of the festival finally arrived.
sentences.zh: 音乐节之夜终于到来了。

sentences.en: The show would consist of songs, short plays, and a science talk.
sentences.zh: 演出由歌曲、短剧和一场科学讲座组成。

sentences.en: One little play was about a friendly dinosaur learning to sing.
sentences.zh: 有一出小短剧讲的是一只友好的恐龙学唱歌。

sentences.en: In his talk, Mr. Wu joked that you cannot clone a good voice in a lab.
sentences.zh: 吴老师在讲座里开玩笑说，实验室里可克隆不出好嗓子。

sentences.en: Families laughed so much they forgot to consume their tea and cakes.
sentences.zh: 各家各户笑得太开心，连茶和点心都忘了吃。

sentences.en: At the end, Lin Hai and Xiao Yu performed a short dialog about friendship.
sentences.zh: 最后，林海和小雨表演了一段关于友谊的简短对话。

sentences.en: Their words seemed to correspond perfectly with the music behind them.
sentences.zh: 他们的话语仿佛与身后的音乐完美呼应。

sentences.en: From the stage, Lin Hai could distinguish Grandfather's white hair in the crowd.
sentences.zh: 在台上，林海能在人群中分辨出爷爷的白发。

sentences.en: By a happy coincidence, it was also the old man's seventieth birthday.
sentences.zh: 碰巧的是，那天也是老人的七十岁生日。

sentences.en: The head teacher came forward to congratulate the whole school.
sentences.zh: 校长走上前来，向全校师生表示祝贺。

sentences.en: He gave Mr. Fang a special diploma for his years of service.
sentences.zh: 他为方老师多年的付出颁发了一张特别的证书。

sentences.en: Outside, snow began to fall, soft and white, over the little school.
sentences.zh: 屋外，雪花轻柔洁白地飘落在这所小小的学校上。

sentences.en: Every summer, Grandpa Wu stood at the small bus stop and waited for his grandchildren.
sentences.zh: 每年夏天，吴爷爷都会站在小小的公交车站等他的孙子孙女们。

sentences.en: He had been an educator for forty years, and the whole town respected him.
sentences.zh: 他当了四十年的教育工作者，全镇的人都尊敬他。

sentences.en: This year, his grandson Ming and his granddaughter Lily were coming to visit.
sentences.zh: 今年，他的孙子小明和孙女莉莉要来看他。

sentences.en: They planned to spend a whole fortnight in the quiet mountain town.
sentences.zh: 他们打算在这个安静的山间小镇住上整整两个星期。

sentences.en: The bus fare was cheap, so their parents sent them along the new freeway by themselves.
sentences.zh: 车费很便宜，所以父母让他们自己沿着新建的高速公路坐车过来。

sentences.en: When the bus finally arrived, the two energetic children jumped out and hugged him tightly.
sentences.zh: 公交车终于到站时，两个精力充沛的孩子跳下车，紧紧抱住了他。

sentences.en: Grandpa greeted them warmly, although thick fog still covered the hills that morning.
sentences.zh: 尽管那天早晨浓雾仍笼罩着群山，爷爷还是热情地迎接了他们。

sentences.en: At home, Granny was resting in bed because she had caught the flu.
sentences.zh: 在家里，奶奶因为得了流感正躺在床上休息。

sentences.en: For the children, staying with their grandparents always felt like a real holiday.
sentences.zh: 对孩子们来说，和祖父母住在一起总像是真正的假期。

sentences.en: On the first afternoon, the weather was too foggy for a walk outside.
sentences.zh: 第一天下午，雾太大，没法出去散步。

sentences.en: Ming disliked the quiet at first and said the town seemed a little dull.
sentences.zh: 小明起初不喜欢这份安静，说小镇似乎有点无聊。

sentences.en: Grandpa only smiled and led them up to the attic with a flashlight.
sentences.zh: 爷爷只是笑了笑，拿着手电筒带他们上了阁楼。

sentences.en: The attic was dark and dusty, but it was full of old treasures.
sentences.zh: 阁楼又黑又满是灰尘，却装满了旧日的宝贝。

sentences.en: In the corner stood a wooden desk with a locked drawer.
sentences.zh: 角落里立着一张木桌，桌上有一个上了锁的抽屉。

sentences.en: Grandpa opened it carefully and took out a yellow envelope.
sentences.zh: 爷爷小心地打开抽屉，取出一个发黄的信封。

sentences.en: Inside lay a fragile sheet of paper covered with tiny writing.
sentences.zh: 里面是一张脆弱的纸，上面写满了小字。

sentences.en: He said the recipe had been kept in the family since the last dynasty.
sentences.zh: 他说这份食谱从上一个朝代起就一直保存在家族里。

sentences.en: Lily gave it a quick glance, and her eyes grew wide with wonder.
sentences.zh: 莉莉快速瞥了一眼，眼睛惊讶地睁得大大的。

sentences.en: Grandpa explained that his own father had once cooked for a rich foreigner.
sentences.zh: 爷爷解释说，他的父亲曾经为一位富有的外国人做过饭。

sentences.en: The guest came from France and paid for the meal with a shining silver franc.
sentences.zh: 那位客人来自法国，用一枚闪亮的银法郎付了饭钱。

sentences.en: Great-grandfather was fluent in French, which surprised the whole town.
sentences.zh: 曾祖父法语说得很流利，这让全镇人都很吃惊。

sentences.en: His fluency came from years of trading near the western frontier.
sentences.zh: 他的流利口语来自多年在西部边境做生意的经历。

sentences.en: He loved geography and drew careful maps of every road he traveled.
sentences.zh: 他热爱地理，把走过的每条路都仔细画成地图。

sentences.en: The old recipe described a famous feast with nine special dishes.
sentences.zh: 这份旧食谱描述了一场有九道特色菜的著名盛宴。

sentences.en: 'I want to cook it for the town festival this year,' Grandpa said softly.
sentences.zh: “今年我想在镇上的节日做这桌菜。”爷爷轻声说。

sentences.en: The bold idea seemed to excite the children at once.
sentences.zh: 这个大胆的想法似乎立刻让孩子们兴奋起来。

sentences.en: However, there was one serious drawback to Grandpa's wonderful plan.
sentences.zh: 然而，爷爷这个美妙的计划有一个严重的缺点。

sentences.en: His eyesight had grown weak over the past few years.
sentences.zh: 这几年他的视力变得很差。

sentences.en: The change was gradual, but now he could hardly read small print.
sentences.zh: 这种变化是逐渐发生的，但现在他几乎读不了小字了。

sentences.en: To make things worse, the old ink had begun to fade.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，旧墨水已经开始褪色。

sentences.en: Ming used his phone camera to enlarge every word on the screen.
sentences.zh: 小明用手机相机把每个字都放大到屏幕上。

sentences.en: Sentence by sentence, they copied the whole recipe out in clear letters.
sentences.zh: 他们一句一句地把整份食谱用清晰的字体抄了下来。

sentences.en: From her bed, Granny watched them and offered warm encouragement.
sentences.zh: 奶奶躺在床上看着他们，给了他们温暖的鼓励。

sentences.en: It was evident that the old plan needed young eyes and young hands.
sentences.zh: 显然，这个古老的计划需要年轻的眼睛和年轻的双手。

sentences.en: The next morning at the market, the first grocer they met was a greedy man who asked very high prices.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上在市场里，他们遇到的第一个杂货商是个贪心的人，要价很高。

sentences.en: Grandpa made a polite enquiry about the real cost of the vegetables.
sentences.zh: 爷爷礼貌地询问了蔬菜的实际价格。

sentences.en: In the end, Lily chose a shiny purple eggplant and a large bunch of grapes.
sentences.zh: 最后，莉莉挑了一个发亮的紫茄子和一大串葡萄。

sentences.en: Ming weighed out five hundred grams of fresh garlic.
sentences.zh: 小明称了五百克新鲜大蒜。

sentences.en: They also bought a fat goose from a friendly farmer nearby.
sentences.zh: 他们还从附近一位友善的农民那里买了一只肥鹅。

sentences.en: A soft white feather floated down and landed on Lily's shoe.
sentences.zh: 一根柔软的白羽毛飘落下来，落在莉莉的鞋上。

sentences.en: They carried home almost a gallon of fresh milk as well.
sentences.zh: 他们还带回家差不多一加仑鲜牛奶。

sentences.en: Granny had lent Lily her old handbag to keep the money safe.
sentences.zh: 奶奶把她的旧手提包借给莉莉，好把钱放稳妥。

sentences.en: On the way back, Ming begged for a hamburger, but Grandpa promised him something better.
sentences.zh: 回来的路上，小明吵着要吃汉堡，但爷爷答应给他更好的东西。

sentences.en: That evening, Grandpa put on a thick glove and lit the fire under the grill.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，爷爷戴上厚手套，点燃了烤架下的火。

sentences.en: He showed Ming how to fry the garlic until it turned golden.
sentences.zh: 他教小明怎样把大蒜炒到金黄。

sentences.en: Soon a fragrant smell filled every room of the house.
sentences.zh: 很快，一股香味充满了屋子的每个房间。

sentences.en: While they worked, he explained that vegetables are rich in fibre.
sentences.zh: 干活的时候，他解释说蔬菜富含纤维。

sentences.en: His instructions were explicit, so even a beginner could follow them easily.
sentences.zh: 他的指导非常明确，连初学者也能轻松照做。

sentences.en: 'Never expose hot oil to water,' he warned, 'or it will jump at you.'
sentences.zh: “千万别让热油碰到水，”他警告说，“不然油会溅到你身上。”

sentences.en: Lily wiped the sweat from her forehead and nodded seriously.
sentences.zh: 莉莉擦掉额头上的汗，认真地点了点头。

sentences.en: To their surprise, cooking with Grandpa was more enjoyable than any computer game.
sentences.zh: 让他们惊讶的是，和爷爷一起做饭比任何电脑游戏都有趣。

sentences.en: Then, two days before the festival, trouble arrived without warning.
sentences.zh: 然而，就在节日前两天，麻烦毫无预兆地来了。

sentences.en: At dusk, a fierce storm rolled down from the dark mountains.
sentences.zh: 黄昏时分，一场猛烈的暴风雨从黑压压的山上席卷而下。

sentences.en: The thunder seemed to explode right above the roof of the house.
sentences.zh: 雷声好像就在屋顶正上方炸开。

sentences.en: The sudden noise disturbed everyone and was loud enough to frighten poor Lily.
sentences.zh: 突如其来的巨响打扰了所有人，把可怜的莉莉吓坏了。

sentences.en: Even a little frog hopped into the kitchen to flee from the rain.
sentences.zh: 连一只小青蛙都跳进厨房躲雨。

sentences.en: Ming shook his fist at the sky, which made everyone laugh a little.
sentences.zh: 小明朝天空挥了挥拳头，逗得大家都笑了。

sentences.en: The mountain night grew so cold that a thin frost covered the grass by morning.
sentences.zh: 山里的夜晚变得很冷，到早上草地上结了一层薄霜。

sentences.en: Worse still, rainwater had damaged the old stone fountain in the town square.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，雨水损坏了镇广场上古老的石头喷泉。

sentences.en: The mayor, who had governed the town for ten years, feared the festival must be cancelled.
sentences.zh: 治理这个镇子已有十年的镇长担心节日必须取消。

sentences.en: Nobody could foresee whether the sky would clear in time.
sentences.zh: 没有人能预见天空是否会及时放晴。

sentences.en: 'A storm cannot forbid us from celebrating,' Grandpa told the worried mayor.
sentences.zh: “一场暴风雨不能禁止我们庆祝。”爷爷对忧心忡忡的镇长说。

sentences.en: He suggested moving the whole dinner into the school gymnasium.
sentences.zh: 他建议把整场宴席搬进学校的体育馆。

sentences.en: The hall was already equipped with long tables and bright lights.
sentences.zh: 大厅里已经配备了长桌和明亮的灯。

sentences.en: It was also well furnished because the gymnastics team trained there every week.
sentences.zh: 因为体操队每周都在那里训练，所以那里的设施也很齐全。

sentences.en: The mayor agreed, and it was fortunate that the whole town offered to help.
sentences.zh: 镇长同意了，幸运的是，全镇的人都主动来帮忙。

sentences.en: Neighbors began to glue paper lanterns together and hang them from the ceiling.
sentences.zh: 邻居们开始把纸灯笼粘起来，挂在天花板上。

sentences.en: Grandpa even went for a haircut so that he would look smart on the big night.
sentences.zh: 爷爷甚至去理了发，好在这个重要的夜晚显得精神。

sentences.en: Granny, feeling much better, ironed her most elegant garment for the party.
sentences.zh: 奶奶感觉好多了，为晚会熨好了她最优雅的一件衣服。

sentences.en: Lily was gifted at drawing, so she painted a tall giraffe on the welcome poster.
sentences.zh: 莉莉很有绘画天赋，于是她在欢迎海报上画了一只高高的长颈鹿。

sentences.en: Ming, who loved geometry, measured the hall and arranged the tables in perfect rows.
sentences.zh: 喜欢几何的小明量好了大厅的尺寸，把桌子排得整整齐齐。

sentences.en: At first, standing before so many adults made Lily feel embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 一开始，站在这么多大人面前让莉莉觉得难为情。

sentences.en: She was afraid that people might think her picture looked foolish.
sentences.zh: 她担心人们会觉得她的画看起来很傻。

sentences.en: But Grandpa made a kind gesture from across the room, and her fear melted away.
sentences.zh: 但爷爷从房间另一头做了个友善的手势，她的害怕一下子消失了。

sentences.en: Grandpa also used the evening to educate the young helpers about their home.
sentences.zh: 爷爷还利用那个晚上教育年轻的帮手们了解自己的家乡。

sentences.en: He talked about the river's ecology and why the town must protect its clean water.
sentences.zh: 他讲了河流的生态，以及小镇为什么必须保护干净的水源。

sentences.en: The enthusiastic children promised to look after it together.
sentences.zh: 热情的孩子们答应一起保护它。

sentences.en: Some kids watched them with open envy, wishing for such a grandfather.
sentences.zh: 有些孩子带着毫不掩饰的羡慕看着他们，希望自己也有这样一位爷爷。

sentences.en: On festival night, the sky was finally clear.
sentences.zh: 节日之夜，天空终于放晴了。

sentences.en: People arrived with warm greetings and soon filled the whole hall.
sentences.zh: 人们带着热情的问候到来，很快挤满了整个大厅。

sentences.en: The mayor even decided to employ two extra cooks to help Grandpa serve.
sentences.zh: 镇长甚至决定再雇两名厨师帮爷爷上菜。

sentences.en: Ming ran back and forth to fetch hot dishes from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 小明来回奔跑，从厨房端来热腾腾的菜。

sentences.en: Every single dish went far beyond people's expectations.
sentences.zh: 每一道菜都远远超出了人们的期待。

sentences.en: Grandpa was clearly fond of watching his neighbors enjoy the food.
sentences.zh: 爷爷显然很喜欢看邻居们享用这些饭菜。

sentences.en: Even under the glare of the bright lamps, his tired eyes kept shining.
sentences.zh: 即使在明亮灯光的强光下，他疲惫的眼睛仍然闪着光。

sentences.en: Two boys argued over the last dish, causing brief friction, but Granny calmed them with cake.
sentences.zh: 两个男孩为最后一道菜争了起来，引起了短暂的摩擦，但奶奶用蛋糕让他们平静下来。

sentences.en: When the dinner ended, colorful fireworks rose over the wet town square.
sentences.zh: 晚宴结束时，五彩的烟花在湿漉漉的镇广场上空升起。

sentences.en: Watching the lights, Lily finally grasped why Grandpa loved this small town so deeply.
sentences.zh: 望着那些光，莉莉终于明白了爷爷为什么这么深爱这个小镇。

sentences.en: When it was time to leave, the children promised to come back every summer.
sentences.zh: 到了该离开的时候，孩子们保证每年夏天都会回来。

sentences.en: Grandpa waved until the bus disappeared into the morning mist.
sentences.zh: 爷爷不停地挥手，直到公交车消失在清晨的薄雾中。

sentences.en: Mei packed her luggage and said goodbye to the busy city on the mainland.
sentences.zh: 梅收拾好行李，告别了大陆上繁忙的城市。

sentences.en: She was going back to her hometown, a small town beside a quiet harbour.
sentences.zh: 她要回到自己的家乡——一个坐落在宁静海港旁的小镇。

sentences.en: The bus climbed slowly along the mountainous roads.
sentences.zh: 大巴车沿着山区公路缓缓爬行。

sentences.en: Soft white mist covered the green hills.
sentences.zh: 轻柔的白雾笼罩着青翠的山丘。

sentences.en: Mei pressed her face against the window and smiled.
sentences.zh: 梅把脸贴在车窗上，笑了。

sentences.en: For the last ten kilometers, she rode in an old green jeep.
sentences.zh: 最后十公里，她坐上了一辆旧的绿色吉普车。

sentences.en: Her grandpa waited at the gate with a warm greeting.
sentences.zh: 爷爷等在门口，热情地迎接她。

sentences.en: Mei had come home to teach at the town kindergarten.
sentences.zh: 梅回到家乡，是为了在镇上的幼儿园教书。

sentences.en: The next morning, she met Mr. Wu, the old headmaster.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，她见到了老校长吴先生。

sentences.en: He had a grey moustache and kind, bright eyes.
sentences.zh: 他留着灰白的小胡子，眼睛明亮而慈祥。

sentences.en: He was a humorous man who loved telling funny stories.
sentences.zh: 他是个幽默的人，喜欢讲有趣的故事。

sentences.en: The children laughed at almost everything he said.
sentences.zh: 他说的话几乎每句都能逗笑孩子们。

sentences.en: His gentle humour made the small school feel warm.
sentences.zh: 他温和的幽默感让这所小学校充满温暖。

sentences.en: On the wall, his motto was written in beautiful handwriting: 'Be kind, be brave.'
sentences.zh: 墙上用漂亮的字迹写着他的座右铭：“心怀善意，勇敢前行。”

sentences.en: The clean and bright classrooms impressed Mei deeply.
sentences.zh: 干净明亮的教室给梅留下了深刻的印象。

sentences.en: Mr. Wu instructed her to begin with maths and story time.
sentences.zh: 吴校长指导她先从数学课和故事时间开始。

sentences.en: Mei was a hardworking teacher, and the children loved her at once.
sentences.zh: 梅是位勤奋的老师，孩子们立刻就喜欢上了她。

sentences.en: Her classes were lively and full of songs.
sentences.zh: 她的课堂生动活泼，歌声不断。

sentences.en: Making paper kites soon became the children's favourite hobby.
sentences.zh: 做纸风筝很快成了孩子们最喜欢的爱好。

sentences.en: In science time, they watched a tiny insect under an old microscope.
sentences.zh: 上科学课时，他们用一台旧显微镜观察一只小昆虫。

sentences.en: She taught them to multiply small numbers with beans.
sentences.zh: 她用豆子教他们做简单的乘法。

sentences.en: One boy asked if a balloon full of hydrogen could fly to the moon.
sentences.zh: 一个男孩问，装满氢气的气球能不能飞到月亮上去。

sentences.en: Mei laughed and promised to explain it another day.
sentences.zh: 梅笑了，答应改天给他讲清楚。

sentences.en: Every evening she felt tired but hopeful.
sentences.zh: 每天傍晚，她虽然疲惫，心里却充满希望。

sentences.en: The little town was full of kind and friendly people.
sentences.zh: 这个小镇上到处都是善良友好的人。

sentences.en: Mrs. Lin, the librarian, lent Mei a pile of old picture books.
sentences.zh: 图书管理员林太太借给梅一摞旧图画书。

sentences.en: Madame Rose ran the little tea house near the shore.
sentences.zh: 罗斯夫人经营着海边的小茶馆。

sentences.en: As the hostess, she gave the children free lemonade every Friday.
sentences.zh: 作为女主人，她每周五都请孩子们免费喝柠檬水。

sentences.en: Aunt Hua, a cheerful housewife, always finished her housework early to help at school.
sentences.zh: 华婶是位开朗的家庭主妇，总是早早做完家务去学校帮忙。

sentences.en: People said a millionaire from the city once wanted to buy the whole beach.
sentences.zh: 听说曾有个城里的百万富翁想买下整片海滩。

sentences.en: His wife wore heavy jewellery and called everyone 'madam' in a cold voice.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子戴着沉甸甸的首饰，用冷冰冰的声音称呼每个人“夫人”。

sentences.en: Her quiet maid carried five heavy bags behind her.
sentences.zh: 她那位沉默的女佣跟在身后，提着五个沉重的袋子。

sentences.en: But the town refused to sell, and the family drove away.
sentences.zh: 但小镇拒绝出售，那家人只好开车走了。

sentences.en: On Sundays, Grandpa took Mei up the hill above the town.
sentences.zh: 每逢周日，爷爷都带梅登上镇子上方的小山。

sentences.en: A tall marble monument stood at the top.
sentences.zh: 山顶矗立着一座高大的大理石纪念碑。

sentences.en: Red maple leaves fell around it in the autumn wind.
sentences.zh: 秋风中，红色的枫叶在碑旁飘落。

sentences.en: It was built to honour the heroes of the liberation.
sentences.zh: 它是为纪念解放时期的英雄们而建的。

sentences.en: Every year, the whole town came here to mourn them.
sentences.zh: 每年，全镇的人都来这里悼念他们。

sentences.en: 'They faced great hardship for our homeland,' Grandpa said quietly.
sentences.zh: “他们为了我们的家园经历了巨大的苦难，”爷爷轻声说。

sentences.en: 'Peace is the dream of all mankind,' he added.
sentences.zh: “和平是全人类的梦想，”他又说。

sentences.en: On that quiet hill, Mei felt deep love for her motherland.
sentences.zh: 站在安静的山顶上，梅对祖国生出深深的热爱。

sentences.en: Then, one night in June, a terrible storm came.
sentences.zh: 然而六月的一个夜晚，一场可怕的暴风雨袭来。

sentences.en: The wind began to howl like a wild animal.
sentences.zh: 狂风像野兽一样呼啸起来。

sentences.en: Rain fell for ten hours without an interval.
sentences.zh: 大雨不间断地下了十个小时。

sentences.en: In the morning, the school yard was muddy and every room was messy.
sentences.zh: 早上，校园里满是泥泞，每间屋子都乱七八糟。

sentences.en: Water had broken the windows and soaked the reading mats.
sentences.zh: 大水冲破了窗户，泡湿了阅读用的垫子。

sentences.en: Worse still, Mr. Wu slipped and injured his heel.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，吴校长滑倒了，伤了脚后跟。

sentences.en: He walked with a lame step and could not stand for long.
sentences.zh: 他走路一瘸一拐，站不了太久。

sentences.en: Mei had a bad headache as she looked at the damage.
sentences.zh: 看着满目狼藉，梅头疼得厉害。

sentences.en: For a moment, everything seemed hopeless.
sentences.zh: 一时间，一切似乎都毫无希望。

sentences.en: But the town did not give up.
sentences.zh: 但小镇的人们没有放弃。

sentences.en: Farmer Chen drove his lorry down the hill with wood and tools.
sentences.zh: 陈农夫开着他的卡车，载着木料和工具从山上下来。

sentences.en: Madame Rose boiled a big kettle of tea for the workers.
sentences.zh: 罗斯夫人烧了一大壶茶给干活的人喝。

sentences.en: Aunt Hua brought a jar of honey and a fresh loaf of bread.
sentences.zh: 华婶带来一罐蜂蜜和一条新鲜面包。

sentences.en: Grandpa picked herbs from the hills to treat Mr. Wu's foot.
sentences.zh: 爷爷从山上采来草药，给吴校长治脚。

sentences.en: The children's mothers arrived with mops and buckets.
sentences.zh: 孩子们的妈妈们拿着拖把和水桶赶来了。

sentences.en: Everyone helped to mend the broken windows and doors.
sentences.zh: 大家一起帮忙修理破损的门窗。

sentences.en: Little Dou Dou pulled his mother's hand and cried, 'Mommy, I want to help too!'
sentences.zh: 小豆豆拉着妈妈的手喊道：“妈妈，我也要帮忙！”

sentences.en: Mei wiped her wet eyes with a handkerchief.
sentences.zh: 梅用手帕擦了擦湿润的眼睛。

sentences.en: The storm had also hurt the farms outside the town.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨也破坏了镇外的农田。

sentences.en: Farmer Chen's hens had run away, but their eggs were safe in a warm corner.
sentences.zh: 陈农夫的母鸡跑散了，但鸡蛋安然躺在温暖的角落里。

sentences.en: A week later, ten little chicks began to hatch.
sentences.zh: 一周后，十只小鸡开始破壳而出。

sentences.en: Wild mushrooms grew everywhere after the heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 大雨过后，野蘑菇到处生长。

sentences.en: The flood had damaged the irrigation system, so the farmers repaired it together.
sentences.zh: 洪水冲坏了灌溉系统，农民们便一起修复它。

sentences.en: Luckily, Mr. Wu had insured the school building the year before.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，吴校长前一年给校舍上了保险。

sentences.en: An officer came to inspect the damage and promised money for repairs.
sentences.zh: 一位工作人员前来查看损失，并承诺拨款维修。

sentences.en: Standing water is harmful because mosquitoes grow in it, so they cleaned every pool.
sentences.zh: 积水有害，因为蚊子会在里面滋生，所以他们清理了每一处水洼。

sentences.en: Two weeks later, the school opened its doors again.
sentences.zh: 两周后，学校重新开门了。

sentences.en: The teachers' lounge even had a new microwave for warm lunches.
sentences.zh: 教师休息室甚至添了一台新微波炉，可以热午饭。

sentences.en: The library got a modem, and the children saw the Internet for the first time.
sentences.zh: 图书室装上了调制解调器，孩子们第一次见到了互联网。

sentences.en: A bright red mailbox stood at the gate for letters to parents.
sentences.zh: 校门口立起一个鲜红的邮箱，用来给家长寄信。

sentences.en: In class, Mei taught that a metre has one thousand millimeters.
sentences.zh: 课堂上，梅教孩子们一米等于一千毫米。

sentences.en: They also learned that a big bottle holds one liter, which people may also spell 'litre'.
sentences.zh: 他们还学到，一个大瓶子能装一升水——“升”这个词还有另一种拼法。

sentences.en: Farmer Chen sent a sweet melon that weighed almost two kilos.
sentences.zh: 陈农夫送来一个甜瓜，差不多有两公斤重。

sentences.en: Mei kept it in a box with a heavy lid until lunchtime.
sentences.zh: 梅把它放进一个盖着厚盖子的箱子里，一直存到午饭时间。

sentences.en: The children cheered when she cut it open.
sentences.zh: 她把瓜切开时，孩子们欢呼起来。

sentences.en: One afternoon, a strange rumour spread through the town.
sentences.zh: 一天下午，一个奇怪的传言在镇上传开了。

sentences.en: Someone said that Mei would soon return to the city.
sentences.zh: 有人说梅很快就要回城里去了。

sentences.en: The children began to misunderstand her plans and grew sad.
sentences.zh: 孩子们误解了她的打算，变得难过起来。

sentences.en: 'You are mistaken,' Mei told them gently.
sentences.zh: “你们弄错了，”梅温柔地告诉他们。

sentences.en: 'Never make a judgement before you know the truth.'
sentences.zh: “在弄清真相之前，千万不要下判断。”

sentences.en: 'I will not hesitate to stay here for many, many years.'
sentences.zh: “我会毫不犹豫地在这里待上很多很多年。”

sentences.en: Little Dou Dou interrupted her with a happy shout.
sentences.zh: 小豆豆高兴地大叫一声，打断了她的话。

sentences.en: 'The sea was not merciful this year, but our hearts are strong,' said Mr. Wu.
sentences.zh: “今年大海并不仁慈，但我们的心很坚强，”吴校长说。

sentences.en: In September, the town held a merry festival by the sea.
sentences.zh: 九月，小镇在海边举办了一场欢乐的节日庆典。

sentences.en: The idea was hers; Mei had planned it for weeks.
sentences.zh: 这个主意是她想出来的；梅为此筹划了好几个星期。

sentences.en: That morning, she jogged along the beach to calm her excitement.
sentences.zh: 那天早上，她沿着海滩慢跑，好让激动的心情平静下来。

sentences.en: Paper lanterns hung along every street.
sentences.zh: 每条街道上都挂满了纸灯笼。

sentences.en: Grandpa, who was always handy with tools, built a small stage.
sentences.zh: 爷爷一向擅长使用工具，他搭起了一个小舞台。

sentences.en: The children performed a play about a kangaroo travelling around the world.
sentences.zh: 孩子们表演了一出戏，讲一只袋鼠环游世界的故事。

sentences.en: When the big paper animal jumped, every jaw in the crowd dropped.
sentences.zh: 当那只巨大的纸动物跳起来时，观众们都惊得张大了嘴。

sentences.en: A little girl on the stage waved and called, 'Mummy, look at me!'
sentences.zh: 台上一个小女孩挥着手喊：“妈妈，快看我！”

sentences.en: At the end, the children even invented a new dance for the whole town.
sentences.zh: 最后，孩子们还为全镇的人创造了一支新舞蹈。

sentences.en: When the music ended, Mr. Wu stood up slowly.
sentences.zh: 音乐结束时，吴校长慢慢站起身来。

sentences.en: 'This little school will grow because of all of you,' he said.
sentences.zh: “因为你们所有人，这所小学校会越来越好，”他说。

sentences.en: Mei looked at the warm lights shining over the water.
sentences.zh: 梅望着水面上闪耀的温暖灯光。

sentences.en: Her town was small, but the dream growing here was great.
sentences.zh: 她的小镇虽小，但在这里生长的梦想却很伟大。

sentences.en: She knew, at last, that she was exactly where she belonged.
sentences.zh: 她终于明白，这里正是她的归属之地。

articles.title: The Picnic by the Oval Pond

sentences.en: Last summer, Lily went to stay with her Aunt Rose in a quiet English neighbourhood.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，莉莉去英国一个安静的街区，住在她的罗丝姨妈家。

sentences.en: Lily was a fifteen-year-old pupil from China, and this was her first trip abroad.
sentences.zh: 莉莉是一名来自中国的十五岁学生，这是她第一次出国。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose often said that Lily was her favourite niece.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈常说，莉莉是她最疼爱的外甥女。

sentences.en: The aunt's small house overlooked a lovely back garden.
sentences.zh: 姨妈的小房子俯瞰着一个漂亮的后花园。

sentences.en: Behind the garden lay a quiet oval pond.
sentences.zh: 花园后面是一个安静的椭圆形池塘。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose was a novelist who wrote stories about small-town life.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈是一位小说家，专写小镇生活的故事。

sentences.en: Her rooms were always neat, and her books stood in tidy rows.
sentences.zh: 她的房间总是整整齐齐，书本排列得井井有条。

sentences.en: On the first evening, she gave Lily a silver necklace as a welcome gift.
sentences.zh: 第一天晚上，她送给莉莉一条银项链作为见面礼。

sentences.en: Lily felt at home at once.
sentences.zh: 莉莉立刻感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: Every morning, Aunt Rose cooked warm porridge for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，罗丝姨妈都会煮热粥当早餐。

sentences.en: On Sundays she made pancakes with honey instead.
sentences.zh: 到了周日，她会改做蜂蜜煎饼。

sentences.en: After eating, she opened her notebook and wrote the outline of a new chapter.
sentences.zh: 吃完饭后，她会打开笔记本，写下新章节的提纲。

sentences.en: Her green parrot sat by the window and repeated funny words.
sentences.zh: 她的绿鹦鹉停在窗边，学说各种有趣的词。

sentences.en: Lily practised her English pronunciation with the bird every day.
sentences.zh: 莉莉每天都和这只鸟一起练习英语发音。

sentences.en: The clever parrot could even pronounce Lily's Chinese name.
sentences.zh: 这只聪明的鹦鹉甚至能念出莉莉的中文名字。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose also taught Lily how English punctuation worked.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈还教莉莉英语标点符号的用法。

sentences.en: "A comma can change everything," she laughed.
sentences.zh: “一个逗号能改变一切。”她笑着说。

sentences.en: The street itself was full of interesting people.
sentences.zh: 这条街上住满了有趣的人。

sentences.en: Next door lived Mr. Chen, a retired pianist with gentle hands.
sentences.zh: 隔壁住着陈先生，一位手指灵巧的退休钢琴家。

sentences.en: Across the road, Mrs. Diaz worked as a painter of garden scenes.
sentences.zh: 马路对面的迪亚兹太太是一位专画花园风景的画家。

sentences.en: People of almost every nationality seemed to live there.
sentences.zh: 这里似乎住着来自各个国家的人。

sentences.en: The friendly postman, Sam, knew everybody's name.
sentences.zh: 友善的邮递员萨姆认识每个人的名字。

sentences.en: Each morning he pushed his bicycle along the pavement.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨，他推着自行车走在人行道上。

sentences.en: A polite young policeman named Tom often stopped to chat.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫汤姆的年轻警察彬彬有礼，常常停下来聊天。

sentences.en: Lily thought the street felt like one big family.
sentences.zh: 莉莉觉得这条街就像一个大家庭。

sentences.en: One day, Aunt Rose had an idea for a summer outing by the water.
sentences.zh: 一天，罗丝姨妈想出了一个在水边举办夏日出游活动的主意。

sentences.en: "Let's organise a big picnic for everyone," she said.
sentences.zh: “我们来为大家组织一场大野餐吧。”她说。

sentences.en: Lily, who was outgoing and cheerful, offered to help at once.
sentences.zh: 性格外向开朗的莉莉立刻主动提出帮忙。

sentences.en: They wrote a short questionnaire to ask what food people wanted.
sentences.zh: 她们写了一份简短的问卷，询问大家想吃什么。

sentences.en: There was also some boring paperwork for the town office.
sentences.zh: 还要给镇政府办一些枯燥的文书手续。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose stayed optimistic even when the forms took hours.
sentences.zh: 即使填表花了好几个小时，罗丝姨妈依然保持乐观。

sentences.en: "Games will be optional, so shy people can simply watch," she explained.
sentences.zh: “游戏是自愿参加的，害羞的人可以只在旁边看。”她解释道。

sentences.en: Lily promised to organize activities for the younger children.
sentences.zh: 莉莉答应为小孩子们组织活动。

sentences.en: Soon the whole street was talking about the plan.
sentences.zh: 很快，整条街的人都在谈论这个计划。

sentences.en: But one neighbour, old Mr. Grant, was strongly against the idea.
sentences.zh: 但有一位邻居——年迈的格兰特先生——强烈反对这个主意。

sentences.en: He was an outspoken man who lived alone with an overweight dog.
sentences.zh: 他说话直来直去，独自和一条超重的狗生活在一起。

sentences.en: "A noisy crowd will ruin my quiet mornings," he shouted.
sentences.zh: “吵闹的人群会毁了我安静的早晨！”他喊道。

sentences.en: He said the town should prohibit parties near the water.
sentences.zh: 他说镇上应该禁止在水边举行聚会。

sentences.en: He and Aunt Rose had a loud quarrel at the garden gate.
sentences.zh: 他和罗丝姨妈在花园门口大吵了一架。

sentences.en: "No offence, but I oppose this silly plan," he added coldly.
sentences.zh: “无意冒犯，但我反对这个愚蠢的计划。”他冷冷地补充道。

sentences.en: He even wanted them to postpone the picnic forever.
sentences.zh: 他甚至想让她们把野餐永远推迟下去。

sentences.en: Some people whispered that his anger came from prejudice against newcomers.
sentences.zh: 有人私下议论，说他的怒气源于对新来住户的偏见。

sentences.en: Lily felt this was not the whole truth.
sentences.zh: 莉莉觉得事情并非如此简单。

sentences.en: The next afternoon, Lily knocked on his door with a peach and a pear.
sentences.zh: 第二天下午，莉莉带着一个桃子和一个梨去敲他的门。

sentences.en: "Pardon me for coming without warning," she said softly.
sentences.zh: “请原谅我不请自来。”她轻声说。

sentences.en: The old man with the grey moustache gave a slow nod and let her in.
sentences.zh: 留着灰白胡子的老人缓缓点了点头，让她进了门。

sentences.en: His outward manner was cold, but his eyes looked lonely.
sentences.zh: 他外表冷淡，眼神里却透着孤独。

sentences.en: Old photos of the sea occupied every wall of his sitting room.
sentences.zh: 客厅的每面墙上都挂满了关于大海的老照片。

sentences.en: He told her he had once been a physicist.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，自己曾经是一名物理学家。

sentences.en: He had worked on offshore platforms, testing petrol and gas equipment.
sentences.zh: 他曾在近海平台上工作，检测汽油和天然气设备。

sentences.en: "I was a pioneer in my field," he said quietly.
sentences.zh: “我曾是这个领域的先驱。”他轻声说。

sentences.en: "Now nobody asks about my qualification or my work."
sentences.zh: “如今再没有人问起我的资历和工作了。”

sentences.en: "It is a pity to sit here alone," Lily said gently.
sentences.zh: “一个人这样孤单地坐在这里，太可惜了。”莉莉温和地说。

sentences.en: "One should not shut oneself away from the world."
sentences.zh: “人不应该把自己与世界隔绝开来。”

sentences.en: Lily worked hard to persuade him to join the picnic.
sentences.zh: 莉莉努力劝说他参加野餐。

sentences.en: "You could show the children your primitive old sea maps," she suggested.
sentences.zh: “您可以给孩子们看看那些古老原始的航海地图。”她建议道。

sentences.en: "You could even give them a preview of your best stories."
sentences.zh: “您还可以先给他们讲一小段您最精彩的故事。”

sentences.en: Mr. Grant was silent for a long moment.
sentences.zh: 格兰特先生沉默了许久。

sentences.en: Then his thin hands began to quake with feeling.
sentences.zh: 然后，他瘦削的双手因激动而颤抖起来。

sentences.en: "Nobody has asked me for anything in ten years," he whispered.
sentences.zh: “十年了，从没有人向我请求过什么。”他低声说。

sentences.en: "If you promise it will not be wild, I will come."
sentences.zh: “如果你保证不会闹得太疯，我就来。”

sentences.en: Lily ran home with the happy news.
sentences.zh: 莉莉带着好消息跑回了家。

sentences.en: The next day, Lily and her aunt went shopping for the food.
sentences.zh: 第二天，莉莉和姨妈去采购食物。

sentences.en: They bought fresh mutton and a jar of yellow mustard for sandwiches.
sentences.zh: 她们买了新鲜的羊肉和一罐做三明治用的黄芥末酱。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose picked up an onion and a bag of green peas.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈拿了一个洋葱和一袋青豌豆。

sentences.en: Lily chose a sweet pineapple and a packet of biscuits.
sentences.zh: 莉莉挑了一个甜菠萝和一包饼干。

sentences.en: She also found some popcorn for the children.
sentences.zh: 她还给孩子们找了一些爆米花。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose added instant noodles for anyone who wanted hot food.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈又添了些方便面，给想吃热食的人准备。

sentences.en: At the till, she opened her purse and counted out the coins.
sentences.zh: 在收银台，她打开钱包，一枚枚数出硬币。

sentences.en: "Nothing costs a few pence anymore," she sighed.
sentences.zh: “现在再没有几便士就能买到的东西了。”她叹了口气。

sentences.en: A kind porter helped them carry the heavy boxes outside.
sentences.zh: 一位热心的搬运工帮她们把沉重的箱子搬到外面。

sentences.en: They also ordered a pint of fresh milk from the local farm.
sentences.zh: 她们还从当地农场订了一品脱鲜牛奶。

sentences.en: That farm kept a huge brown ox that Lily loved to visit.
sentences.zh: 那个农场养着一头莉莉很喜欢去看的棕色大公牛。

sentences.en: On Friday, everyone helped to prepare the area by the water.
sentences.zh: 周五，大家一起动手布置水边的场地。

sentences.en: Mr. Chen set up a ping-pong table on the grass.
sentences.zh: 陈先生在草地上支起了一张乒乓球桌。

sentences.en: Little children from the nursery painted a colourful welcome sign.
sentences.zh: 幼儿园的小朋友们画了一块五颜六色的欢迎牌。

sentences.en: Tom cleared the small playground beside the pond.
sentences.zh: 汤姆清理了池塘边的小游乐场。

sentences.en: Mrs. Diaz checked the ground and removed a poisonous mushroom.
sentences.zh: 迪亚兹太太检查了地面，清除了一株毒蘑菇。

sentences.en: "Cover the food well, or pests will get into it," she warned.
sentences.zh: “把食物盖好，不然害虫会钻进去。”她提醒道。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose brought a portable radio for music.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈带来了一台便携式收音机放音乐。

sentences.en: Lily repaired a torn flag with a needle and thread.
sentences.zh: 莉莉用针线缝补了一面破旗子。

sentences.en: Her fingers went numb after an hour of careful sewing.
sentences.zh: 细心缝了一个小时后，她的手指都麻了。

sentences.en: By evening, everything was ready.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，一切都准备就绪。

sentences.en: On Saturday, the morning mist cleared, leaving a bright sky overhead.
sentences.zh: 周六早晨，薄雾散去，头顶露出一片明亮的天空。

sentences.en: Everyone wanted to spend the whole day outdoors.
sentences.zh: 所有人都想在户外待上一整天。

sentences.en: Happy pedestrians filled the street, all heading towards the water.
sentences.zh: 街上满是兴高采烈的行人，都朝着水边走去。

sentences.en: Even a curious passer-by stopped and decided to join the fun.
sentences.zh: 连一位好奇的路人也停下脚步，决定加入这场欢乐。

sentences.en: Children took turns to paddle small boats across the pond.
sentences.zh: 孩子们轮流划着小船穿过池塘。

sentences.en: A little girl hugged her toy panda and laughed loudly.
sentences.zh: 一个小女孩抱着她的玩具熊猫，笑得很大声。

sentences.en: Local performers sang old songs under the trees.
sentences.zh: 当地的表演者在树下唱着老歌。

sentences.en: Mrs. Diaz wore her best perfume and a wide summer hat.
sentences.zh: 迪亚兹太太喷了她最好的香水，戴着一顶宽边夏帽。

sentences.en: On the main table, sandwiches were stacked like a small pyramid.
sentences.zh: 主桌上，三明治堆得像一座小金字塔。

sentences.en: Nobody stayed hungry that afternoon.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，没有一个人饿着肚子。

sentences.en: At noon, Mr. Grant finally appeared, carrying his old sea maps.
sentences.zh: 中午，格兰特先生终于出现了，手里拿着他的旧航海地图。

sentences.en: The children promised to obey his one rule: listen quietly.
sentences.zh: 孩子们答应遵守他唯一的规矩：安静地听。

sentences.en: He told stories of storms and stars, and nobody made a sound.
sentences.zh: 他讲起风暴与星辰的故事，没有人发出一点声音。

sentences.en: "Life should not punish a man just for growing old," he said.
sentences.zh: “生活不该仅仅因为一个人变老就惩罚他。”他说。

sentences.en: His long anger was no longer a puzzle to Lily.
sentences.zh: 对莉莉来说，他多年的怒气不再是一个谜。

sentences.en: He had simply been forgotten, and now he was found again.
sentences.zh: 他只是被人遗忘了，而现在，他重新被大家找了回来。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose shook his hand warmly, and their quarrel was over.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈热情地握了握他的手，两人的争吵就此化解。

sentences.en: From that day, he greeted everyone with a smile.
sentences.zh: 从那天起，他见到每个人都会微笑问好。

sentences.en: Before flying home, Lily bought a postcard with a picture of the pond.
sentences.zh: 回国之前，莉莉买了一张印着池塘风景的明信片。

sentences.en: She wrote her address carefully, including the postcode.
sentences.zh: 她仔细地写下自己的地址，包括邮政编码。

sentences.en: Aunt Rose helped her pay the postage at the post office.
sentences.zh: 罗丝姨妈在邮局帮她付了邮资。

sentences.en: Lily also sent a parcel of small gifts to her parents.
sentences.zh: 莉莉还给父母寄了一个装满小礼物的包裹。

sentences.en: Inside it she placed a soft pillow that she had sewn herself.
sentences.zh: 包裹里放着一个她亲手缝制的柔软枕头。

sentences.en: With a pencil, she wrote one last line in her diary.
sentences.zh: 她用铅笔在日记里写下了最后一句话。

sentences.en: "One kind visit can change a whole street" became her new motto.
sentences.zh: “一次善意的拜访能改变整条街”成了她新的座右铭。

sentences.en: The friends by the water would stay in her heart forever.
sentences.zh: 水边的这些朋友，将永远留在她心中。
