sentences.en: Old Lin was a sailor who had spent forty years at sea.
sentences.zh: 老林是一名水手，在海上度过了四十年。

sentences.en: On a rainy morning, he returned to his seaside hometown.
sentences.zh: 一个下雨的早晨，他回到了海边的家乡。

sentences.en: The rainfall was heavy, and the streets were quiet.
sentences.zh: 雨量很大，街道十分安静。

sentences.en: He wore a thick scarf around his neck.
sentences.zh: 他脖子上围着一条厚厚的围巾。

sentences.en: A seagull cried above the grey water.
sentences.zh: 一只海鸥在灰色的水面上鸣叫。

sentences.en: He could hardly recognise the old harbour.
sentences.zh: 他几乎认不出旧日的港口了。

sentences.en: The houses looked shabby, and many shops were closed.
sentences.zh: 房子看上去破旧不堪，许多商店都关门了。

sentences.en: He gave a deep sigh, full of sadness.
sentences.zh: 他深深地叹了口气，满心悲伤。

sentences.en: Still, the scenery of the bay touched his heart.
sentences.zh: 然而，海湾的风景仍然打动了他的心。

sentences.en: He walked into a small hotel by the port.
sentences.zh: 他走进港口边的一家小旅馆。

sentences.en: There was a short queue at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 前台前排着一条短短的队。

sentences.en: The receptionist smiled and checked his reservation.
sentences.zh: 接待员微笑着核对了他的预订。

sentences.en: She gave him a receipt and a warm cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 她递给他一张收据和一杯热茶。

sentences.en: In his room, a soft quilt lay on the bed.
sentences.zh: 房间里，床上铺着一床柔软的被子。

sentences.en: A small refrigerator hummed in the corner.
sentences.zh: 角落里一台小冰箱嗡嗡作响。

sentences.en: For dinner he ate salty fish and seaweed soup.
sentences.zh: 晚饭他吃了咸鱼和海带汤。

sentences.en: The simple meal helped refresh his tired body.
sentences.zh: 简单的一餐让他疲惫的身体恢复了精神。

sentences.en: He fell asleep listening to the waves.
sentences.zh: 他听着海浪声入睡了。

sentences.en: The next day, his grandchildren came to see him.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他的孙子孙女来看他。

sentences.en: Ming was a lively schoolboy of eleven.
sentences.zh: 小明是个活泼的十一岁男学生。

sentences.en: His sister Hua was a quiet schoolgirl of nine.
sentences.zh: 他的妹妹小华是个安静的九岁女学生。

sentences.en: People said the boy really did resemble his grandfather.
sentences.zh: 人们都说这男孩长得真像他的爷爷。

sentences.en: Ming rode a skateboard and wore bright sneakers.
sentences.zh: 小明踩着滑板，穿着亮色的运动鞋。

sentences.en: Hua wore a blue skirt and long white socks.
sentences.zh: 小华穿着蓝色的裙子和长长的白袜子。

sentences.en: Grandpa made a funny remark about their city clothes.
sentences.zh: 爷爷对他们的城市打扮说了句有趣的评论。

sentences.en: Then he asked them a riddle about the sea.
sentences.zh: 然后他给他们出了一个关于大海的谜语。

sentences.en: The answer was hidden in an old fisherman's rhyme.
sentences.zh: 答案藏在一首老渔夫的押韵歌谣里。

sentences.en: They laughed together for a long time.
sentences.zh: 他们一起笑了很久。

sentences.en: Later, the children showed him their school.
sentences.zh: 后来，孩子们带他去看他们的学校。

sentences.en: A great storm had hit the town last month.
sentences.zh: 上个月一场大风暴袭击了小镇。

sentences.en: Broken desks and rubbish covered the playground.
sentences.zh: 破桌子和垃圾铺满了操场。

sentences.en: The wooden doors had started to rot in the wet air.
sentences.zh: 木门在潮湿的空气中开始腐烂。

sentences.en: Inside, Hua found her ruler and scissors under a desk.
sentences.zh: 在教室里，小华在课桌下找到了她的尺子和剪刀。

sentences.en: Ming drew a rectangle on the wall to mark a new window.
sentences.zh: 小明在墙上画了一个长方形，标出新窗户的位置。

sentences.en: 'We can recycle the old wood,' Grandpa said.
sentences.zh: “我们可以回收利用这些旧木头，”爷爷说。

sentences.en: He picked up a spade and cleared the garden.
sentences.zh: 他拿起一把铲子，清理了花园。

sentences.en: 'In spring we will sow flowers here,' he promised.
sentences.zh: “春天我们要在这里播种花籽，”他许诺道。

sentences.en: A little sparrow watched them from the fence.
sentences.zh: 一只小麻雀在栅栏上看着他们。

sentences.en: But there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 可是出现了一个问题。

sentences.en: A salesman from the city wanted to buy the school land.
sentences.zh: 一个从城里来的推销员想买下学校的地。

sentences.en: His company planned to build a tall skyscraper there.
sentences.zh: 他的公司打算在那里建一座高高的摩天大楼。

sentences.en: Many parents were sceptical about his sweet words.
sentences.zh: 许多家长对他的甜言蜜语持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: The town had a restriction on new buildings by the shore.
sentences.zh: 小镇对海边的新建筑有限制规定。

sentences.en: But the man was rigid and refused to listen.
sentences.zh: 但那个人非常固执，拒绝倾听。

sentences.en: He tried to seize the land with clever papers.
sentences.zh: 他想用巧妙的文件夺取这块土地。

sentences.en: The head teacher almost decided to resign in anger.
sentences.zh: 校长气得差点辞职。

sentences.en: 'We must speak sincerely to everyone,' Grandpa said.
sentences.zh: “我们必须真诚地和大家谈，”爷爷说。

sentences.en: So they invited a scholar to hold a seminar in the town hall.
sentences.zh: 于是他们请了一位学者在镇公所举办研讨会。

sentences.en: At the meeting, Grandpa told the town's story.
sentences.zh: 会上，爷爷讲起了小镇的故事。

sentences.en: He played an old recorder with voices of past fishermen.
sentences.zh: 他放了一台旧录音机，里面有过去渔民的声音。

sentences.en: He would rewind the tape again and again.
sentences.zh: 他一遍又一遍地倒带。

sentences.en: The first settler here built his house with his own hands, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，这里的第一位移民是亲手盖起自己的房子的。

sentences.en: Early people fished with a simple spear, like a primitive tool.
sentences.zh: 早先的人们用简单的长矛捕鱼，就像原始的工具。

sentences.en: Grandpa showed a long scar on his arm from a storm.
sentences.zh: 爷爷露出手臂上一道风暴留下的长长伤疤。

sentences.en: 'The sea gave me this, and it gave me a home,' he said.
sentences.zh: “大海给了我这个，也给了我一个家，”他说。

sentences.en: Even the old smoker in the back row wiped his eyes.
sentences.zh: 连后排那位老烟民都擦了擦眼睛。

sentences.en: In the end, the people stood up to salute the old sailor.
sentences.zh: 最后，人们起立向这位老水手致敬。

sentences.en: The man from the city left quietly and never returned.
sentences.zh: 那个城里人悄悄离开，再也没有回来。

sentences.en: The whole town began to rebuild the school together.
sentences.zh: 全镇的人开始一起重建学校。

sentences.en: Neighbours worked in a relay, passing bricks hand to hand.
sentences.zh: 邻居们像接力一样干活，把砖块一手传一手。

sentences.en: Grandpa fixed a broken socket in the classroom wall.
sentences.zh: 爷爷修好了教室墙上一个坏掉的插座。

sentences.en: He used a rag to clean the dusty windows.
sentences.zh: 他用一块抹布擦干净落满灰尘的窗户。

sentences.en: Ming helped sharpen the old pencils for the little pupils.
sentences.zh: 小明帮忙给小学生们削铅笔。

sentences.en: Dust made Hua sneeze again and again.
sentences.zh: 灰尘让小华一个劲儿地打喷嚏。

sentences.en: A curious dog came to sniff the fresh paint.
sentences.zh: 一只好奇的狗跑来嗅新刷的油漆。

sentences.en: Nobody was allowed to spit on the new sidewalk.
sentences.zh: 谁都不许往新人行道上吐痰。

sentences.en: One tired worker grew sleepy and leaned sideways against the door.
sentences.zh: 一个疲惫的工人犯困了，斜靠在门上。

sentences.en: Everyone laughed and sent him home to rest.
sentences.zh: 大家笑着送他回家休息。

sentences.en: The women cooked lunch for the workers every day.
sentences.zh: 妇女们每天为工人们做午饭。

sentences.en: They served roast chicken and thick sausage.
sentences.zh: 她们端上烤鸡和粗粗的香肠。

sentences.en: Tea came in white cups, each on a small saucer.
sentences.zh: 茶盛在白瓷杯里，每个杯子下都有一个小茶托。

sentences.en: The plums from the garden were still sour, not yet ripe.
sentences.zh: 园子里的李子还是酸的，尚未成熟。

sentences.en: A proud rooster walked around the tables.
sentences.zh: 一只骄傲的公鸡在桌子间踱步。

sentences.en: Grandpa used a razor every morning to shave before work.
sentences.zh: 爷爷每天早晨都用剃刀刮脸再去干活。

sentences.en: 'A clean face, a clean start,' he liked to say.
sentences.zh: “脸干净，开工也干净利落，”他喜欢这样说。

sentences.en: In the evening, they rested on an old sofa outside the shop.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，他们坐在店外一张旧沙发上休息。

sentences.en: The smog of the far city never reached this clean air.
sentences.zh: 远方城市的雾霾从未飘到这片干净的空气里。

sentences.en: By autumn, the school opened its doors again.
sentences.zh: 到了秋天，学校重新开门了。

sentences.en: The pupils began their revision for the first test.
sentences.zh: 学生们开始为第一次考试复习。

sentences.en: Their teacher gave them a short science quiz.
sentences.zh: 老师给他们做了一个简短的科学小测验。

sentences.en: One question was about radioactive rocks deep in the earth.
sentences.zh: 有一道题是关于地底深处有放射性的岩石。

sentences.en: Hua could recite every answer without her notes.
sentences.zh: 小华不看笔记就能背出每一个答案。

sentences.en: The teacher tried to simplify the hard ideas for the class.
sentences.zh: 老师尽量把难懂的概念给全班讲得简单些。

sentences.en: In history class, they read about socialism and the country's past.
sentences.zh: 历史课上，他们读到了社会主义和国家的过去。

sentences.en: Ming dreamed of flying a spaceship one day.
sentences.zh: 小明梦想有一天驾驶宇宙飞船。

sentences.en: 'Then bring me a star as a souvenir,' Grandpa joked.
sentences.zh: “那就给我带一颗星星当纪念品吧，”爷爷开玩笑说。

sentences.en: Winter came, and the first snowy morning covered the roofs.
sentences.zh: 冬天来了，第一个下雪的早晨盖白了屋顶。

sentences.en: Grandma taught Hua to sew a button on her sleeve.
sentences.zh: 奶奶教小华在袖子上缝一颗扣子。

sentences.en: 'Wash wool with care, or it will shrink,' she warned.
sentences.zh: “洗羊毛要小心，不然会缩水，”她提醒道。

sentences.en: That winter, an old friend of Grandpa died of a sudden sickness.
sentences.zh: 那年冬天，爷爷的一位老朋友因一场急病去世了。

sentences.en: Grandpa seldom cried, but that night he began to sob.
sentences.zh: 爷爷很少哭，但那天夜里他开始抽泣。

sentences.en: The children sat with him and shared his sorrow.
sentences.zh: 孩子们陪着他，分担他的悲痛。

sentences.en: 'Sadness passes, but love stays,' he told them softly.
sentences.zh: “悲伤会过去，爱会留下，”他轻声告诉他们。

sentences.en: In spring, the town held a festival by the harbour.
sentences.zh: 春天，小镇在港口边举办了节日庆典。

sentences.en: An artist made a stone sculpture of a fishing boat.
sentences.zh: 一位艺术家做了一座渔船的石雕。

sentences.en: Visitors came for sightseeing and filled the small streets.
sentences.zh: 游客们前来观光，挤满了小小的街道。

sentences.en: Some city guests were skeptical that this small town had changed so fast.
sentences.zh: 一些城里来的客人不太相信这个小镇能变化得这么快。

sentences.en: Children learned to skate on the smooth new square.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在平整的新广场上学滑冰。

sentences.en: Grandpa acted as referee for the running games.
sentences.zh: 爷爷在跑步比赛中当裁判。

sentences.en: Cars moved slowly around the new roundabout near the gate.
sentences.zh: 汽车绕着大门附近新修的环岛慢慢行驶。

sentences.en: The bright day seemed to satisfy every heart in town.
sentences.zh: 明媚的一天似乎让镇上每颗心都感到满足。

sentences.en: Grandpa stood by the sea and smiled at the noisy, happy children.
sentences.zh: 爷爷站在海边，微笑着看孩子们吵吵闹闹地玩耍。

sentences.en: 'This town,' he said, 'is my greatest treasure.'
sentences.zh: “这座小镇，”他说，“是我最大的财富。”

sentences.en: Old Mr. Lin lived in a small town beside a narrow strait, where the sea wind never rested.
sentences.zh: 老林先生住在一条狭窄海峡边的小镇上，那里的海风从不停歇。

sentences.en: For thirty years he had worked as a translator in the capital.
sentences.zh: 三十年来，他一直在首都做翻译。

sentences.en: Now he kept a quiet guesthouse and typed his memories on an old typewriter.
sentences.zh: 如今他经营着一家安静的小旅馆，用一台旧打字机敲下自己的回忆。

sentences.en: One spring morning, a young traveller stepped off the old tram at the corner.
sentences.zh: 一个春天的早晨，一位年轻的旅行者在街角走下那辆旧电车。

sentences.en: She carried a heavy suitcase and wore a bright red sweater.
sentences.zh: 她提着一只沉重的行李箱，穿着一件亮红色的毛衣。

sentences.en: Her name was Maya, and she worked as a private tutor in the big city.
sentences.zh: 她叫玛雅，在大城市里做私人家教。

sentences.en: "I need a quiet room for two weeks," she said in a straightforward way.
sentences.zh: “我需要一间安静的房间，住两个星期。”她直截了当地说。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin smiled and led her up the narrow wooden stairs.
sentences.zh: 林先生微笑着，领她走上狭窄的木楼梯。

sentences.en: The room upstairs was small but wonderfully tidy.
sentences.zh: 楼上的房间虽小，却整洁得令人愉快。

sentences.en: Warm sunlight poured through the window and fell across the desk.
sentences.zh: 温暖的阳光透过窗户洒在书桌上。

sentences.en: A clean white towel hung neatly beside the bed.
sentences.zh: 床边整齐地挂着一条干净的白毛巾。

sentences.en: In the bathroom, a new toothbrush stood waiting in a glass.
sentences.zh: 浴室里，一支新牙刷立在玻璃杯里等着她。

sentences.en: Beside it lay a small tube of mint toothpaste.
sentences.zh: 旁边放着一小管薄荷牙膏。

sentences.en: Maya hung up her spare trousers and put her underwear in a drawer.
sentences.zh: 玛雅挂好备用的长裤，把内衣放进抽屉。

sentences.en: A pair of warm stockings went into the same drawer.
sentences.zh: 一双暖和的长筒袜也放进了同一个抽屉。

sentences.en: From the window she watched swallows fly over the red roofs.
sentences.zh: 她从窗口望着燕子飞过红色的屋顶。

sentences.en: A grey squirrel ran along the garden wall and disappeared into a tree.
sentences.zh: 一只灰色的松鼠沿着花园的墙跑过，消失在树里。

sentences.en: That evening, Mr. Lin cooked supper on his old iron stove.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，林先生用他那台旧铁炉子做晚饭。

sentences.en: He fried a thick steak and cut up a fresh tomato.
sentences.zh: 他煎了一块厚厚的牛排，切了一个新鲜的西红柿。

sentences.en: The kitchen shelves shone with pots of stainless steel.
sentences.zh: 厨房的架子上，不锈钢锅具闪闪发亮。

sentences.en: He handed Maya a spoon for the soup and a plate of warm toast.
sentences.zh: 他递给玛雅一把喝汤的勺子和一盘热吐司。

sentences.en: "This is superb," Maya said after the first bite.
sentences.zh: “太棒了。”玛雅咬了第一口就说。

sentences.en: "Hotel food always seems tasteless to me, but this is truly tasty."
sentences.zh: “酒店的饭菜在我看来总是淡而无味，可这个真的很好吃。”

sentences.en: For dessert there was strawberry ice cream in little glass bowls.
sentences.zh: 甜点是盛在小玻璃碗里的草莓冰淇淋。

sentences.en: She drank cold juice through a paper straw and felt at home.
sentences.zh: 她用纸吸管喝着冰果汁，感觉像在家一样。

sentences.en: They sat on the old sofa and talked late into the night.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在旧沙发上聊到深夜。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, Maya learned the old man's story.
sentences.zh: 接下来的几天里，玛雅了解了这位老人的故事。

sentences.en: In his youth he had translated speeches for a famous statesman.
sentences.zh: 年轻时，他曾为一位著名的政治家翻译演讲稿。

sentences.en: Later he became the spokesman for the national science museum.
sentences.zh: 后来他成了国家科学博物馆的发言人。

sentences.en: His wife, a stout and cheerful woman, had been its spokeswoman.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子是一位健壮开朗的女人，曾担任那里的女发言人。

sentences.en: She had died three years before, and her tomb lay on the hill behind the town.
sentences.zh: 她三年前去世了，坟墓就在镇后的山坡上。

sentences.en: Every Sunday, Mr. Lin climbed the steep path to visit her.
sentences.zh: 每个星期天，林先生都会爬上陡峭的小路去看她。

sentences.en: He would sweep the fallen leaves from the stone with slow, careful hands.
sentences.zh: 他会用缓慢而细心的手，把落叶从石碑上扫去。

sentences.en: "Sorrow never fully leaves," he said, "but I am thankful for our years together."
sentences.zh: “悲伤永远不会完全离开，”他说，“但我感激我们共度的岁月。”

sentences.en: One afternoon, they walked together to the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 一天下午，他们一起走去超市。

sentences.en: On the way, an old tractor rolled past with a flat tyre.
sentences.zh: 路上，一辆旧拖拉机拖着瘪了的轮胎驶过。

sentences.en: Farmers stood by the road, selling their surplus vegetables.
sentences.zh: 农民们站在路边，卖着他们多余的蔬菜。

sentences.en: A tortoise, the pet of the shop owner, slept in a sunny corner by the door.
sentences.zh: 店主养的一只乌龟在门边阳光充足的角落里睡觉。

sentences.en: Maya liked to tease Mr. Lin about his careful shopping list.
sentences.zh: 玛雅喜欢拿林先生那份仔细的购物清单打趣他。

sentences.en: "You plan everything like a train timetable," she laughed.
sentences.zh: “你把一切都安排得像火车时刻表一样。”她笑道。

sentences.en: "A systematic life is not a tiresome one," he answered with a wink.
sentences.zh: “有条理的生活并不无聊。”他眨眨眼回答。

sentences.en: In the evenings, he watched the stars through a small telescope on the roof.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，他会在屋顶上用一架小望远镜看星星。

sentences.en: Sometimes they listened to a symphony on his old radio.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会用他的旧收音机听交响乐。

sentences.en: On the tenth day, the radio warned that a typhoon was coming.
sentences.zh: 第十天，收音机警告说台风要来了。

sentences.en: The town had a tendency to flood whenever heavy rain fell.
sentences.zh: 每逢大雨，这座小镇总有被淹的倾向。

sentences.en: People grew tense, and many were uncertain whether to stay or go.
sentences.zh: 人们变得紧张起来，许多人拿不定主意是走还是留。

sentences.en: In the quiet house, the clock seemed to tick louder than ever.
sentences.zh: 安静的屋子里，钟表的滴答声似乎比以往任何时候都响。

sentences.en: Dark clouds began to surround the hills like a grey army.
sentences.zh: 乌云开始像一支灰色的军队一样包围群山。

sentences.en: A cold wind made the shop signs tremble and swing.
sentences.zh: 一阵冷风吹得商店的招牌颤抖摇晃。

sentences.en: Maya packed a small bag and set her umbrella by the door.
sentences.zh: 玛雅收拾了一个小包，把伞放在门边。

sentences.en: But Mr. Lin was unwilling to leave the house his wife had loved.
sentences.zh: 但林先生不愿离开妻子深爱过的这栋房子。

sentences.en: "I am too old and unfit to run," he said in a stubborn voice.
sentences.zh: “我太老了，身体也不行，跑不动。”他用固执的语气说。

sentences.en: That night, a violent thunderstorm broke over the town.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，一场猛烈的雷暴袭击了小镇。

sentences.en: Rain fell in sheets, and the river began to swell.
sentences.zh: 大雨倾盆而下，河水开始上涨。

sentences.en: The screaming of the wind was almost unbearable.
sentences.zh: 风的呼啸声几乎让人无法忍受。

sentences.en: In the darkness, a thief crept into the empty houses along the street.
sentences.zh: 黑暗中，一个小偷溜进了街边空无一人的房子。

sentences.en: He was a young man close to starvation, stealing only food.
sentences.zh: 他是个濒临饿死的年轻人，偷的只是食物。

sentences.en: At the guesthouse, he tried to squeeze through the kitchen window.
sentences.zh: 在小旅馆，他试图从厨房的窗户挤进去。

sentences.en: He slipped on the wet floor and knocked himself unconscious.
sentences.zh: 他在湿滑的地板上摔倒，把自己摔昏了过去。

sentences.en: Maya heard the crash and ran down with a lamp in her hand.
sentences.zh: 玛雅听到响声，提着灯跑下楼。

sentences.en: For a long moment, she could only stare at the thin figure on the floor.
sentences.zh: 好一会儿，她只能盯着地上那个瘦削的身影。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin did not call the police at once.
sentences.zh: 林先生没有立刻报警。

sentences.en: Instead, he gently wiped the blood stain from the stranger's forehead.
sentences.zh: 相反，他轻轻擦去陌生人额头上的血迹。

sentences.en: When the young man woke, his first words were about his terrible thirst.
sentences.zh: 年轻人醒来时，开口说的第一句话就是他难忍的口渴。

sentences.en: They watched him swallow three cups of water, one after another.
sentences.zh: 他们看着他一连喝下三杯水。

sentences.en: "I would rather steal than starve," he whispered, full of shame.
sentences.zh: “我宁愿偷也不愿饿死。”他满怀羞愧地低声说。

sentences.en: His shaking hands showed every symptom of hunger and cold.
sentences.zh: 他颤抖的双手显示出饥饿与寒冷的种种症状。

sentences.en: Mr. Lin brought him hot soup and a thick slice of bread.
sentences.zh: 林先生给他端来热汤和一厚片面包。

sentences.en: "This town does not tolerate stealing," the old man said quietly, "but tonight you are my guest."
sentences.zh: “这个镇子不容忍偷窃，”老人平静地说，“但今晚你是我的客人。”

sentences.en: By morning, the river had risen almost to the top of its banks.
sentences.zh: 到了早上，河水几乎涨到了岸顶。

sentences.en: There was unrest in the streets as frightened families argued about what to do.
sentences.zh: 街上一片骚动，惊慌的人家为该怎么办争论不休。

sentences.en: The mayor asked every taxpayer, young and old, to help build a wall of sandbags.
sentences.zh: 镇长请每一位纳税人，无论老少，都来帮忙筑起沙袋墙。

sentences.en: "Only teamwork can save our town," she shouted through the rain.
sentences.zh: “只有团队合作才能救我们的镇子。”她在雨中大喊。

sentences.en: Soon a troop of soldiers arrived to join the fight against the water.
sentences.zh: 不久，一队士兵赶来加入抗洪。

sentences.en: The young thief, whose name was Deng, worked harder than anyone.
sentences.zh: 那个名叫小邓的年轻小偷干得比谁都卖力。

sentences.en: He offered to undertake the most troublesome jobs at the water's edge.
sentences.zh: 他主动承担了水边最麻烦的活儿。

sentences.en: People passed sandbags along a human chain, hand over hand.
sentences.zh: 人们排成人链，一袋一袋地传递沙袋。

sentences.en: The wall curved like a great triangle around the lowest streets.
sentences.zh: 那道墙像一个巨大的三角形，围住了地势最低的几条街。

sentences.en: Slowly, the whole town began to unite behind one simple goal.
sentences.zh: 慢慢地，整个小镇为了一个简单的目标团结了起来。

sentences.en: By evening, the rain grew weak and the water stopped rising.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，雨势减弱，水位不再上涨。

sentences.en: The clouds broke, and a pale light moved upward from the sea.
sentences.zh: 云层裂开，一道淡淡的光从海面向上升起。

sentences.en: Tired people lifted their faces upwards and cheered.
sentences.zh: 疲惫的人们仰起脸，欢呼起来。

sentences.en: A steward from the ferry company carried hot tea to everyone on the bank.
sentences.zh: 渡轮公司的一位乘务员给岸上的每个人送来热茶。

sentences.en: The tailor opened his little shop and handed out dry clothes.
sentences.zh: 裁缝打开他的小店，分发干衣服。

sentences.en: Later, a farmer offered Deng honest work outside the town.
sentences.zh: 后来，一位农民给小邓提供了镇外一份正经的工作。

sentences.en: His answer was tentative at first, but then he accepted with tears in his eyes.
sentences.zh: 他起初回答得犹犹豫豫，但随后含着泪答应了。

sentences.en: "My help is unconditional," Mr. Lin told him; "repay me by living well."
sentences.zh: “我的帮助是无条件的，”林先生对他说，“好好生活就是对我的报答。”

sentences.en: On her last evening, Maya sat with Mr. Lin on the roof.
sentences.zh: 在她住的最后一个晚上，玛雅和林先生坐在屋顶上。

sentences.en: "Was I right about people," he asked, "or is kindness only a subjective idea?"
sentences.zh: “我对人的看法是对的吗？”他问，“还是说善良只是一种主观的想法？”

sentences.en: Maya thought about the storm and gave him a thorough answer.
sentences.zh: 玛雅回想着那场风暴，给了他一个周全的回答。

sentences.en: "No textbook could teach what you showed this town," she said.
sentences.zh: “没有哪本教科书能教会你为这个镇子做的一切。”她说。

sentences.en: They agreed to swap addresses and write to each other every month.
sentences.zh: 他们说好交换地址，每个月互相写信。

sentences.en: She admitted the storm had given her a strange thrill, like living inside a thriller.
sentences.zh: 她承认那场风暴给了她一种奇异的兴奋，就像活在一部惊险小说里。

sentences.en: "This town's story is now partly mine and partly theirs," she said, pointing at the lights below.
sentences.zh: “这个小镇的故事如今一部分属于我，一部分属于他们。”她指着下面的灯火说。

sentences.en: "It has been a splendid visit," she added softly.
sentences.zh: “这真是一次极好的造访。”她轻声补充道。

sentences.en: The next morning, the happy traveler waved goodbye from the window of the tram.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，这位快乐的旅行者从电车窗口挥手告别。

articles.title: The Village Waitress Who Crossed the Sea

sentences.en: Mei grew up in a small village at the foot of an old volcano.
sentences.zh: 梅在一座老火山脚下的小村庄里长大。

sentences.en: On every weekday she worked as a waitress in her uncle's restaurant.
sentences.zh: 每个工作日，她都在叔叔的餐馆里当服务员。

sentences.en: Her uncle had been a waiter for years before he became the shopkeeper.
sentences.zh: 她叔叔当了多年侍者，后来才成为店主。

sentences.en: The villagers loved the little restaurant.
sentences.zh: 村民们都很喜欢这家小餐馆。

sentences.en: They said the dumplings there were really yummy.
sentences.zh: 他们说那儿的饺子真的很好吃。

sentences.en: Mei liked to add a spoonful of vinegar to hers.
sentences.zh: 梅喜欢在自己的饺子里加一勺醋。

sentences.en: She ate them with wooden chopsticks while the soup was still hot.
sentences.zh: 趁着汤还热，她用木筷子把饺子吃掉。

sentences.en: In her free time she practised the violin near the vegetable garden.
sentences.zh: 空闲的时候，她在菜园旁练习小提琴。

sentences.en: She dreamed of becoming a violinist, but life had other plans.
sentences.zh: 她梦想成为小提琴家，但生活另有安排。

sentences.en: Mei was hard-working, but she had one shortcoming.
sentences.zh: 梅很勤劳，但她有一个缺点。

sentences.en: She was forgetful and often lost small things.
sentences.zh: 她很健忘，经常弄丢小东西。

sentences.en: Once she searched a whole hour for the broken zipper of her old schoolbag.
sentences.zh: 有一次，她为了旧书包上坏掉的拉链找了整整一个小时。

sentences.en: Inside the bag she kept an old eraser and a pencil sharpener.
sentences.zh: 书包里放着一块旧橡皮和一个卷笔刀。

sentences.en: She also found a dried walnut from her school days.
sentences.zh: 她还找到一颗上学时留下的干核桃。

sentences.en: The bag brought back vivid memories of her schoolmates.
sentences.zh: 这个书包唤起了她对同学们的鲜活回忆。

sentences.en: Their teacher used to give dictation every morning.
sentences.zh: 他们的老师过去每天早上都会听写。

sentences.en: After class, the students had to retell short stories in English.
sentences.zh: 下课后，学生们要用英语复述小故事。

sentences.en: Mei would underline new words to build her vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 梅会在生词下面画线，来扩大自己的词汇量。

sentences.en: She even learned a new idiom every week.
sentences.zh: 她甚至每周学一个新习语。

sentences.en: The old headmistress always said that learning English was worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 老校长总是说，学英语是值得的。

sentences.en: One windy afternoon, a minibus stopped outside the restaurant.
sentences.zh: 一个刮风的下午，一辆小巴停在了餐馆外面。

sentences.en: A tall woman in a grey overcoat and a woolen scarf stepped out.
sentences.zh: 一位穿灰色大衣、戴羊毛围巾的高个子女士走了下来。

sentences.en: She carried a thermos of tea and a leather bag.
sentences.zh: 她带着一个装茶的保温瓶和一只皮包。

sentences.en: Her name was Madam Zhao, a famous businesswoman from the city.
sentences.zh: 她叫赵女士，是城里一位有名的女商人。

sentences.en: She was the chairwoman of a large clothing enterprise.
sentences.zh: 她是一家大型服装企业的女董事长。

sentences.en: Her company made warm clothes from fine wool.
sentences.zh: 她的公司用上等羊毛制作保暖衣物。

sentences.en: It sold woollen coats in many foreign markets.
sentences.zh: 公司在许多海外市场销售羊毛大衣。

sentences.en: That week she was driving westwards to visit an oilfield her brother managed.
sentences.zh: 那一周，她正驱车向西去看她哥哥管理的一处油田。

sentences.en: The changeable mountain weather had forced her to stop and rest.
sentences.zh: 山里多变的天气迫使她停下来休息。

sentences.en: Mei served her hot tea from a small blue teapot.
sentences.zh: 梅用一把蓝色的小茶壶给她倒了热茶。

sentences.en: The girl who served her was quick and skilful with every order.
sentences.zh: 招待她的这个姑娘手脚麻利，做每样活儿都很熟练。

sentences.en: Madam Zhao was astonished when Mei greeted her in clear English.
sentences.zh: 当梅用清晰的英语向她问好时，赵女士大为吃惊。

sentences.en: In a shy whisper, Mei explained that she studied by herself every night.
sentences.zh: 梅害羞地低声解释说，她每天晚上都自学。

sentences.en: 'My office needs a new typist,' Madam Zhao said with a smile.
sentences.zh: “我的办公室需要一名新打字员，”赵女士微笑着说。

sentences.en: 'Come to the city for an interview next Monday.'
sentences.zh: “下周一来城里参加面试吧。”

sentences.en: 'The salary is fair, and my team is friendly.'
sentences.zh: “薪水公道，而且我的团队很友好。”

sentences.en: Mei's uncle was so excited that he nearly knocked over a flower vase.
sentences.zh: 梅的叔叔激动得差点碰倒一只花瓶。

sentences.en: 'Do not give a vague answer, child—say yes!' he laughed.
sentences.zh: “孩子，别含含糊糊的——快答应啊！”他大笑着说。

sentences.en: Mei's heart beat fast under her thin cotton vest.
sentences.zh: 在薄薄的棉背心下，梅的心怦怦直跳。

sentences.en: She agreed, and the old dog wagged its tail as if it understood everything.
sentences.zh: 她答应了，老狗摇着尾巴，仿佛什么都听懂了。

sentences.en: On Monday morning, Mei rose before the sun.
sentences.zh: 周一清晨，梅在太阳升起前就起床了。

sentences.en: She packed her beddings and a yellow raincoat.
sentences.zh: 她收拾好铺盖，还带上一件黄色雨衣。

sentences.en: She also took a white seashell that her mother had given her for luck.
sentences.zh: 她还带上了妈妈送她保平安的一枚白色贝壳。

sentences.en: At the gate, her grandmother held her hands, and Mei felt the warmth of home.
sentences.zh: 在门口，奶奶握着她的手，梅感受到了家的温暖。

sentences.en: The old woman's face was full of wrinkles, but her smile was young.
sentences.zh: 老人满脸皱纹，笑容却依然年轻。

sentences.en: 'Do not weep, my girl—go and be brave,' she said.
sentences.zh: “别哭，我的孩子——勇敢地去吧。”她说。

sentences.en: The bus rolled down a narrow sideroad toward the highway.
sentences.zh: 汽车沿着一条狭窄的小路驶向公路。

sentences.en: Mei watched fields of ripening watermelons pass by the window.
sentences.zh: 梅望着窗外一片片正在成熟的西瓜地掠过。

sentences.en: A greengrocer waved at the bus from his stand.
sentences.zh: 一个蔬菜水果商从摊位上向汽车挥手。

sentences.en: In the city, Mei changed to a crowded trolleybus.
sentences.zh: 到了城里，梅换乘了一辆拥挤的无轨电车。

sentences.en: A kind policewoman showed her the way to the office gate.
sentences.zh: 一位和善的女警察给她指了去办公楼大门的路。

sentences.en: She was punctual and arrived ten minutes early.
sentences.zh: 她非常守时，还提前了十分钟到达。

sentences.en: The questions were not hard, and Mei answered with care.
sentences.zh: 问题并不难，梅认真地一一作答。

sentences.en: Madam Zhao asked her to type a letter and weigh some sample packages.
sentences.zh: 赵女士让她打一封信，并称一些样品包裹的重量。

sentences.en: Each package had to be measured to the last centimetre.
sentences.zh: 每个包裹都必须精确测量到最后一厘米。

sentences.en: 'A single millimetre matters in our business,' the manager told her.
sentences.zh: “在我们这一行，一毫米都很重要。”经理告诉她。

sentences.en: Mei measured cloth samples that were ninety centimeters wide.
sentences.zh: 梅测量了宽九十厘米的布料样品。

sentences.en: She got the job that very afternoon.
sentences.zh: 当天下午她就得到了这份工作。

sentences.en: A friendly salesgirl named Hua showed her around the building.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫华的友善女售货员带她参观了大楼。

sentences.en: 'The washroom is upstairs, and the dustbin is behind the door,' Hua said.
sentences.zh: “盥洗室在楼上，垃圾箱在门后面。”华说。

sentences.en: Hua had once sold electric shavers to a barbershop.
sentences.zh: 华曾经向一家理发店推销过电动剃须刀。

sentences.en: Now she was the best saleswoman in the whole company.
sentences.zh: 如今她是全公司最出色的女销售员。

sentences.en: At noon they shared hotdogs and a cup of yoghurt in the park.
sentences.zh: 中午，她们在公园里分享热狗和一杯酸奶。

sentences.en: But that autumn, trouble came.
sentences.zh: 然而那年秋天，麻烦来了。

sentences.en: A bigger firm cut its prices, and sales fell fast.
sentences.zh: 一家更大的公司降价，销量急剧下滑。

sentences.en: The pressure on Madam Zhao grew heavier every day.
sentences.zh: 赵女士身上的压力一天比一天重。

sentences.en: Next year's budget looked thin and uncertain.
sentences.zh: 来年的预算看起来既紧张又充满变数。

sentences.en: The only hope was a big buyer far away in Oceania.
sentences.zh: 唯一的希望是远在大洋洲的一位大买家。

sentences.en: Madam Zhao decided to fly there and negotiate a new contract.
sentences.zh: 赵女士决定飞去那里，谈判一份新合同。

sentences.en: 'Mei, you will come with me,' she said.
sentences.zh: “梅，你和我一起去。”她说。

sentences.en: 'Your English is clear, and honesty is your greatest virtue.'
sentences.zh: “你的英语清楚明白，而诚实是你最大的美德。”

sentences.en: The idea terrified Mei and excited her at the same time.
sentences.zh: 这个想法让梅既害怕又兴奋。

sentences.en: She had never made such a long voyage before.
sentences.zh: 她从没经历过这么远的航程。

sentences.en: 'Whichever way it ends, this trip is a real chance,' Hua told her.
sentences.zh: “不管结果如何，这次旅行都是一个真正的机会。”华对她说。

sentences.en: They flew out on a rainy Friday.
sentences.zh: 一个下雨的星期五，她们出发了。

sentences.en: A polite stewardess helped Mei fasten her seat belt.
sentences.zh: 一位礼貌的空姐帮梅系好了安全带。

sentences.en: Mei bit a fingernail as the plane began to zoom down the runway.
sentences.zh: 飞机在跑道上呼啸加速时，梅紧张地咬着指甲。

sentences.en: Far below, the city lights spread outwards like stars.
sentences.zh: 远远的下方，城市的灯火像星星一样向外铺展开去。

sentences.en: Hours later, over the deep sea, Mei saw a whale rise and blow.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，在深海上空，梅看见一头鲸鱼浮出水面喷水。

sentences.en: She almost gave a yell of joy.
sentences.zh: 她高兴得差点喊出声来。

sentences.en: Madam Zhao only smiled and covered a tired yawn.
sentences.zh: 赵女士只是微微一笑，掩住一个疲倦的哈欠。

sentences.en: To calm herself, Mei read a science article about radium.
sentences.zh: 为了让自己平静下来，梅读了一篇关于镭的科学文章。

sentences.en: Another page said that careless ships pollute the sea near big ports.
sentences.zh: 另一页写道，粗心的船只会污染大港口附近的海域。

sentences.en: 'Our factory must never do that,' Madam Zhao said quietly.
sentences.zh: “我们的工厂绝不能那样做。”赵女士轻声说。

sentences.en: They landed in a bright coastal city.
sentences.zh: 她们在一座明亮的海滨城市降落。

sentences.en: The air was warm, about thirty degrees centigrade.
sentences.zh: 空气很温暖，大约有摄氏三十度。

sentences.en: Near the port, their car waited at a zebra crossing full of tourists.
sentences.zh: 在港口附近，她们的车在挤满游客的斑马线前等候。

sentences.en: Mei got sunburnt after just one afternoon outside.
sentences.zh: 只在外面待了一个下午，梅就被晒伤了。

sentences.en: In the evening she wandered along the beach alone.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，她独自沿着海滩漫步。

sentences.en: Boys played volleyball on the sand, and a whistle started each game.
sentences.zh: 男孩们在沙滩上打排球，每场比赛都以一声哨响开始。

sentences.en: An old fisherman showed her a fat worm he used for fishing.
sentences.zh: 一位老渔夫给她看他钓鱼用的一条肥虫子。

sentences.en: Before bed, Mei sent a letter home by airmail.
sentences.zh: 睡觉前，梅用航空邮件给家里寄了一封信。

sentences.en: She also called her grandmother on the hotel videophone.
sentences.zh: 她还用酒店的可视电话给奶奶打了电话。

sentences.en: 'Do not stay out too late,' the old woman scolded her gently.
sentences.zh: “别在外面待得太晚。”老人温和地数落她。

sentences.en: The next morning, the talks began.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，谈判开始了。

sentences.en: The buyers sat in a semicircle around a long table.
sentences.zh: 买家们围着一张长桌，坐成一个半圆。

sentences.en: Their leader was Mrs. Ali, a respected Moslem trader.
sentences.zh: 他们的领头人是阿里夫人，一位受人尊敬的穆斯林商人。

sentences.en: People said she was as calm and wise as a stateswoman.
sentences.zh: 人们说她像女政治家一样沉着而睿智。

sentences.en: Beside her sat a retired ambassadress who advised the group.
sentences.zh: 她身边坐着一位退休的女大使，为他们出谋划策。

sentences.en: At first, every effort seemed to be in vain.
sentences.zh: 起初，一切努力似乎都是徒劳的。

sentences.en: The buyers' price was so low that it would violate the rules agreed earlier.
sentences.zh: 买家出的价格低到会违反先前商定的规则。

sentences.en: Madam Zhao had to wrestle with every number in her head.
sentences.zh: 赵女士不得不在脑子里与每一个数字苦苦较量。

sentences.en: Worse, she had woken up that day with a terrible toothache.
sentences.zh: 更糟的是，那天她一醒来就牙疼得厉害。

sentences.en: So Mei had to speak for the company at the table.
sentences.zh: 于是，梅不得不在谈判桌上替公司发言。

sentences.en: Her voice shook, and she pressed her folder tight against her waist.
sentences.zh: 她的声音发颤，把文件夹紧紧地贴在腰间。

sentences.en: Then she remembered her grandmother's words and stood up straight.
sentences.zh: 然后她想起了奶奶的话，挺直了身子。

sentences.en: Mei described the cloth in simple, honest words.
sentences.zh: 梅用朴实诚恳的语言介绍了布料。

sentences.en: She explained how village women wax the thread to make it strong.
sentences.zh: 她解释说，村里的妇女如何给线上蜡，让它更结实。

sentences.en: 'Every coat has a strong zip that will last ten years,' she added.
sentences.zh: “每件大衣都有一条能用十年的结实拉链。”她补充道。

sentences.en: Mrs. Ali listened and slowly began to smile.
sentences.zh: 阿里夫人听着听着，脸上慢慢露出了笑容。

sentences.en: Just then a phone rang with news from home: the old volcano had started to erupt.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，电话铃响了，传来家乡的消息：那座老火山开始喷发了。

sentences.en: Mei went pale, but the report soon proved small—only smoke, no danger.
sentences.zh: 梅的脸一下子白了，但很快证实情况不严重——只是冒烟，没有危险。

sentences.en: 'You love your village, and you tell the truth,' Mrs. Ali said.
sentences.zh: “你爱你的村庄，而且你说的都是实话。”阿里夫人说。

sentences.en: 'People like you will never cheat us.'
sentences.zh: “像你这样的人绝不会欺骗我们。”

sentences.en: She signed the contract, and the room filled with warm congratulations.
sentences.zh: 她签下了合同，房间里响起了热烈的祝贺声。

sentences.en: A month later, their plane carried them westward across the quiet sea.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，飞机载着她们向西飞越平静的大海。

sentences.en: The company was safe, and Mei was given a better salary.
sentences.zh: 公司安然无恙，梅也得到了更高的薪水。

sentences.en: Back in the village, a happy wedding was waiting.
sentences.zh: 回到村里，一场喜庆的婚礼正等着他们。

sentences.en: Her cousin was getting married, and the bridegroom was Mei's old schoolmate.
sentences.zh: 她的表姐要结婚了，新郎正是梅的老同学。

sentences.en: At the feast, grandmother had kept a vacant seat beside her just for Mei.
sentences.zh: 喜宴上，奶奶特意在身边给梅留了一个空座位。

sentences.en: Mei played her violin, and the whole village danced under the moon.
sentences.zh: 梅拉起了小提琴，全村人在月光下翩翩起舞。

sentences.en: She finally understood that courage and honest work can carry anyone far from home—and safely back again.
sentences.zh: 她终于明白，勇气和诚实的劳动能带人走得很远——也能带人平安归来。
